title: Site Operations Leader, OneMHS
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Refrigeration Trade School certificate
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
- Experience with performance metrics such as OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), downtime, throughput, or quality
- Experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments

title: Certified Pharmacy Technician, Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the medications they need when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service support and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online pharmacy.

We are looking for a Certified Pharmacy Technician to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they need to get and stay healthy!

This position offers a unique blend of on-the-road independence and in-pharmacy teamwork! In this role, you will be responsible for both kiosk management and working within our pharmacy operations, including driving from the Pharmacy to our Kiosk locations, refilling inventory and maintaining Pharmacy Kiosk Machines in regionalized areas. You will also be working in the physical Pharmacy location preparing orders
for customer shipments.

#everydaybetter

Key job responsibilities
-Drive from physical Pharmacy locations to our remote Pharmacy Kiosk locations with company provided vehicle
-Refill Pharmacy Kiosks with medication, paper, clean machine, and collect discarded inventory for return
-Prepare inventory shipments for Kiosk replenishment
-Assist pharmacist in filling prescription items, as permitted by the state board of pharmacy
-Maintain a safe and clean pharmacy by complying with procedures, rules and regulations
-Work daily with Leadership to ensure the right medications are put in the right orders
-Run automated machinery required to pre-sort and package medications
-Fill exception trays with appropriate medication
-Transition Amazon Pharmacy orders through different workflow stages from initial dispense through quality control
-Count and fill prescription vials and affix labels on bulk prescription items
-Pack and ship completed orders including printing and affixing appropriate labels on dispenser, shipping boxes

title: Electrical Integration Leader - Power Distribution & Infrastructure, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution & Infrastructure to drive the successful installation of electrical power systems for automation and material handling equipment across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides field-based electrical installation leadership focused specifically on heavy wire pulls, power distribution infrastructure, conduit and raceway systems, control panel placement, and high-voltage terminations in complex industrial environments. The Electrical Installation Lead – Power Distribution will directly manage installation crews
responsible for all electrical infrastructure that feeds power to MHE systems. This includes
conduit installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels and equipment, cable tray routing, heavy wire pulling (480V 3-phase), control panel placement, disconnect installation, junction box and pull box placement, grounding systems, and wire terminations. You will ensure all power distribution work is executed safely, in compliance
with NEC/NFPA codes, and to Amazon's quality and schedule standards. This role reports to the Site Deployment Manager and works in close coordination with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — your team must complete power infrastructure in each zone before device installation crews can mobilize. This sequencing makes schedule discipline and quality critical to overall project success.

Key job responsibilities
Power Distribution Installation Leadership:
• Lead and manage electrical installation crews focused on power distribution infrastructure for MHE systems across North American facilities
• Oversee conduit and raceway installation from Main Distribution Panels (MDPs) to sub-panels, disconnects, and equipment locations
• Manage heavy wire pulling operations through conduit including 480V 3-phase power feeders, ensuring proper cable sizing, labeling, and termination
• Direct control panel placement and mounting at designated locations per engineering drawings, ensuring proper clearance and accessibility
• Oversee installation of cable tray systems, junction boxes, pull boxes, and wireways
• Manage installation of disconnects, motor starters, overloads, and related power distribution components
• Direct grounding system installation and bonding connections per NEC requirements
• Ensure proper wire terminations with correct torque values, lugging, and labeling at all connection points
• Oversee cable management including wire bundling, cable supports, strain relief,
and routing compliance

Drawing Interpretation & Field Execution:
• Review and interpret electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, cable schedules, and electrical installation details
• Verify field installation matches engineering drawings and identify conflicts requiring resolution
• Partner with engineering teams to clarify drawings, resolve field conflicts, and validate installation intent
• Maintain accurate field documentation including redlines, punch lists, installation status reports, and turnover documentation
• Coordinate with mechanical installation teams on shared routing paths, penetrations, and structural supports

Quality, Safety & Compliance
• Ensure all electrical power distribution work is completed in accordance with NEC/NFPA codes, project specifications, and Amazon standards
• Perform and oversee quality inspections on conduit installations, wire pulls, terminations, panel connections, and grounding systems
• Verify conduit fill ratios, bend radius compliance, and proper support spacing per code requirements
• Manage electrical punch list identification and repair for all power infrastructure scope
• Drive achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned zones
• Ensure lockout/tagout compliance and electrical safety practices during all installation activities

Coordination & Communication
• Coordinate electrical infrastructure installation with mechanical teams, controls engineering, construction, vendors, and operations stakeholders
• Manage zone handoff sequencing with the Low Voltage Devices & Controls lead — power infrastructure must be complete before device installation begins
• Track electrical installation progress, risks, blockers, and quality issues, escalating when support is needed
• Participate in project-level technical reviews, installation readiness reviews, and punch walks
• Manage relationships with electrical contractors, OEMs, vendors, and internal project stakeholders
• Participate in daily business reviews with installation progress updates
• Support development and continuous improvement of electrical installation standards, field checklists, and scalable deployment processes

A day in the life
Your day starts at the site coordination meeting where you review which zones have completed mechanical steel installation and are ready for electrical infrastructure mobilization. You walk the floor with your conduit crew — verifying raceway runs from MDPs to sub-panels against engineering drawings, checking conduit supports and fill
ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. You oversee wire pulling operations in active zones, ensuring proper cable sizing, bend radius compliance, and pull tension limits are respected. Mid-morning you inspect control panel placements, verifying mounting locations match drawings, checking clearance requirements, and confirming grounding connections. You validate junction box and disconnect installations, review wire terminations for proper torque values and labeling, and address any field conflicts that require engineering clarification. By afternoon, you're tracking installation progress against the schedule, coordinating with the device installation lead on upcoming zone handoffs, and documenting redlines for as-built updates. You close out at the daily business review with progress updates and flag any material or access risks for the next
day.

About the team
The OMHS Installation & Deployment team supports the deployment and integration of automation and material handling systems across Amazon's operations network. The team works cross-functionally with engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendors, and field execution partners to deliver safe, scalable, and reliable systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering including a supervisory role managing people
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 5+ years of experience in industrial electrical installation, electrical construction,
- power distribution, or a similar technical environment
- Experience leading or supervising electrical installation crews, contractors, or field execution teams
- Experience reading and interpreting electrical drawings including one-line diagrams, panel schedules, conduit schedules, and wiring diagrams
- Experience with industrial power distribution systems including 480V 3-phase, motor control circuits, disconnects, and related infrastructure
- Experience with conduit installation, raceway systems, cable tray, wire pulling, and termination practices
- Experience working in fast-paced industrial, logistics, manufacturing, or construction environments
- Ability to travel up to 50% domestically; travel may exceed 50% in some instances with short notice

Preferred qualifications

- Prior experience managing journeyman electricians, electrical contractors, or industrial electricians on large-scale installation projects
- Prior experience working for a material handling integrator
- Prior experience installing power distribution infrastructure for conveyor or sortation systems
- Experience with 480V 3-phase systems, motor control centers (MCCs), VFD power wiring, and transformer installations
- Journeyman electrician license, master electrician license, or state electrical license
- Knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical, Bluebeam, BIM 360, or equivalent drawing review software
- Experience with NEC/NFPA compliance in industrial or construction environments
- Experience managing third-party electrical contractors and subcontractors
- Experience with punch list management, redlines, installation quality inspections, and turnover documentation
- Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, or related project management certifications

ratios, and confirming proper routing around obstructions. day.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Mechanical Integration Lead to drive the successful installation, integration, and deployment of material handling equipment (MHE) across multiple greenfield and brownfield fulfillment center sites. This role provides hands-on mechanical engineering leadership in complex automation environments, ensuring projects meet Amazon's safety, timeline, cost, and quality standards. The Mechanical Integration Lead will directly manage mechanical installation crews deploying conveyor systems, sortation equipment, and associated structural systems across North America. Reporting to the Site Deployment Manager, you will lead sub-teams responsible for structural steel installation, conveyor prep and placement, mechanical connections and belting, side guide and netting installation, pneumatic systems, and mechanical quality control and commissioning. You will collaborate across engineering, supply chain, and operations to implement scalable solutions, resolve technical issues in the field, and deliver high-impact results across large, multi-site programs.

Key job responsibilities
Mechanical Installation Leadership:
• Directly manage and lead mechanical installation crews deploying MHE across North American facilities
• Oversee structural header steel installation including hanging steel, prebuilding supports, and anchoring to building structure
• Lead conveyor prep and placement operations — rigging, lifting, staging, and setting conveyor sections into final positions on installed supports
• Manage conveyor connections and belting crews — ensuring proper mechanical alignment, bed connections, squaring, leveling, and hardware tightening
• Direct side guide and netting installation ensuring proper alignment and tension
• Oversee belt crew operations including belting and lacing installation on aligned conveyor sections
• Manage pneumatic/air systems installation including air connections to conveyor components, pressure testing, and leak verification
• Coordinate with the logistics and receiving team to ensure materials are inventoried, staged, and distributed to work zones on schedule

Quality Control & Commissioning:
• Lead mechanical QC and commissioning activities including alignment verification, hardware inspections, and match-mark verification
• Oversee conveyor run-in testing, belt tracking verification, and belt tension checks
• Manage mechanical punch list identification and repair
• Verify IOQ checks and ensure all mechanical systems meet specifications before handoff to electrical teams
• Ensure proper match-marking of nuts/bolts to verify tightness across all connections

Technical Leadership & Standards:
• Provide mechanical engineering expertise for automation initiatives across assigned sites
• Implement technical solutions and lead project-level decisions within the mechanical scope
• Follow and help develop mechanical installation standards and best practices

- Experience in a supervisory role managing installation crews, maintenance technicians, or tradespeople
- Experience with the project management of technical projects in fast-paced, automated industrial environments
- Experience delivering technical projects in active construction environments
- Ability to travel up to 50% domestically; travel may exceed 50% in some instances with short notice

title: Sr. Customer Solutions Manager, AGS Brazil FSI
descriptionHtml:
As an AWS Customer Solutions Manager, you'll guide customers through their multi-year cloud transformation journey, ensuring seamless collaboration across AWS teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. You'll serve as a trusted advisor, orchestrating strategy and execution while solving complex cloud adoption challenges at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with customers to understand their cloud adoption goals and guide them through each phase of their transformation journey, from initial planning through operational excellence.
- Coordinate across AWS teams to ensure aligned execution, breaking down silos between sales, support, solutions architecture, and professional services to deliver integrated customer solutions.
- Develop and manage customer engagement plans that translate strategic objectives into actionable milestones, tracking progress and adjusting approaches based on business outcomes.
- Lead customer business reviews and executive briefings that communicate progress, address challenges, and identify opportunities for expanded AWS adoption and innovation.
- Identify and advocate for new AWS services and solutions that address customer needs, bringing creative approaches and tools to solve complex technical and operational challenges.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll work directly with customers navigating their cloud adoption, helping them understand the operational, educational, and governance aspects of their AWS journey. You'll coordinate across multiple AWS teams—including sales, support, solutions architecture, and professional services—to plan and support large-scale workload migrations. Your day might include translating strategic customer initiatives into executable plans, leading business reviews and executive briefings, or facilitating knowledge-sharing sessions that align technical solutions with business goals. You'll also identify opportunities to introduce new AWS services and tools that address emerging customer challenges, working collaboratively with your peers to drive innovation and operational excellence.

About the team
We're a global team dedicated to helping customers succeed in their cloud transformation. Our vision is to make cloud adoption accessible, efficient, and impactful for organizations of all sizes. We work closely with customers across industries, understanding their unique business challenges and helping them unlock the full potential of cloud technology. You'll collaborate with a diverse group of technical experts, account leaders, and customer teams who are committed to delivering exceptional outcomes. We value inclusive perspectives, continuous learning, and a culture where everyone contributes to our shared success. Our team embraces flexibility and supports a healthy balance between work and personal life, recognizing that our best work happens when we're energized and supported both professionally and personally.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Mental Health and Well-Being (MHW), Glamazon, and Women at Amazon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience in customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
- Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience

Preferred qualifications

- PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
- Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar

title: Overnight Staff Pharmacist , Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that
prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the
medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided
customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service
support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products
that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online
pharmacy.

We are looking for a Staff Pharmacist to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for
customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they
need to get and stay healthy!


#everydaybetter


Key job responsibilities
• Perform clinical data review, prescription verification, and virtual patient consultations in
compliance with state and federal regulations
• Manage end-to-end prescription fulfillment process, including dispensing medications
using automated systems (Parata Max2) and manual fill
• Package and prepare prescriptions for shipment or site injection, including handling of
specialized medications (refrigerated and bulk items)
• Maintain strict quality standards and safety protocols while meeting Critical Pull Times
(CPT) and production targets
• Split time effectively between prescription verification and fulfillment duties based on
operational needs and customer centric volume
• Perform thorough DUR (Drug Utilization Review) and ensure accurate documentation in
pharmacy systems
• Monitor, receive, and manage pharmacy inventory effectively and compliantly
• Work collaboratively with pharmacy technicians and other pharmacists to maintain
efficient workflow
• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced
environment
• Support operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement efforts
• Identify and report quality or safety concerns promptly while maintaining compliance with
all regulatory requirements
• Complete daily operational tasks including processing returns, medication rejects,
therapeutic substitutions, and canister approvals

Physical Requirements:
During Peak/high demand, shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 8-10 hours)
• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists
• Walking throughout the Amazon building for various reasons such as injections and inventory receive

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Science, or Doctor of Pharmacy in PharmD, or Doctor of Pharmacy
- Knowledge of pharmacy laws and federal/state regulations concerning patient care
- Can demonstrate proficiency with basic computer functions and pharmacy systems
- Can have an active and unrestricted pharmacist license in your state of employment (additional licenses may be required)

Preferred qualifications

- Exemplary interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality

Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Have you ever wanted to be part of a team who is building industry changing technology? Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a Principal Optical Quality Engineer, you will own the quality of optical communication systems between satellites. You will develop, drive and optimize mechanisms for quality assurance and control activities the supply chain for these optical components and assemblies.

The ideal candidate is a systems thinker with excellent analytical abilities, strong technical skills, effective written and verbal communication, and most importantly, a passion for developing suppliers to produce high-quality, mission-critical hardware in volume production.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead the quality elements in the design, build, and qualification of optical system and metrology for build, test, and manufacturing of optical Inter-satellite Link systems.

- Champion the development of new and improvement of existing optical measurement methods, leveraging metrology equipment such as interferometers, cameras, imaging systems, and Hartmann sensors for optical module integration, alignment, and testing.
- Lead the quality elements in development of measurement processes and procedures for volume manufacturing.
- Collaborate with engineering, suppliers, supply chain, and manufacturing to optimize Design for Excellence.
- Move quality checks upstream and eliminate the need to inspect quality into the product by achieving high process capability.
- Foster a culture of quality, improvement and learning with Leo.

This role is an individual contributor and is the quality lead for Leo's optical communication systems between satellites. This role must identify and solve problems within a supply chain while coaching teams and developing mechanisms to consistently deliver high-quality products.

You will be challenged with solving problems that have never been tackled before at scale. We guarantee that you will get to work some of the smartest people in the industry, learn a lot, have fun and have the chance to positively impact the life of millions of people.

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

- Experience with mirrors, lenses, filters, lasers, detectors, modulators, optical fiber and devices, testing and characterization
- Experience with optical metrology (e.g. interferometers and profilometers) for component and system test, qualification, and failure analysis
- Experience with various optical thin film coating methodologies, failure modes, and processes
- Bachelor's degree in Optical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Must be able to visually inspect and distinguish fine scratch / dig requirements in precision optical/mechanical components
- Experience in physical and geometric optics, Gaussian beam propagation, and detection, with the ability to guide team members and review technical work in these domains.
- Experience in performing process audits, product audits, and QMS audits.
- 7+ years' experience with manufacturing & assembly of optical components and complex optical systems
- Proficient in ISO 10110-7 / ISO 9211 / MIL-PRF-14830 / MIL-C-48497
- Proficient in ISO 9001 / AS9100 / IATF 16949 requirements

- Master's degree or PhD in Optical Engineering, Physics, Electronics, or related discipline, or equivalent experience

We are seeking a Lab Engineer to run day-to-day lab operations and support production and hardware testing. You'll build and maintain test fixtures, manage lab resources and equipment, and make sure measurements are accurate and traceable. You'll work hands-on with hardware, electrical harnesses, and precision measurement tools, and you'll work closely with design, test, and production teams.

As a Lab Engineer, you will support development, readiness, and operation of solar production area and test systems infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to translate test needs into safe, reliable, and repeatable test setups.
You will improve current test setups, integrate instrumentation and equipment, perform equipment checkout and commissioning activities, execute complex testing, troubleshoot hardware and test system issues.
This is a highly hands-on engineering role that combines mechanical engineering, test system development, production operations, troubleshooting, and testing.

• Develop and execute preventative maintenance plans for mechanical equipment.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks

- Knowledge of and experience with measurement and inspection devices (torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, multimeters, oscilloscopes, DAQ systems).
- Experience developing, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical harnesses.
- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with calibration management systems.
- Experience with CAD tools for fixture design.
- Experience applying DFM principles and tolerance analysis to design manufacturable parts and functional assemblies.
- Experience creating engineering drawings for machining.
- Experience with harness design tools or documentation (wiring diagrams, pin-out and connector specifications, harness build drawings).

title: Finance Manager, Fulfillment by Amazon - AI Native Finance Analytics & Controls
descriptionHtml:
Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA) Finance is seeking a Finance Manager who can do two things simultaneously: ensure the integrity of Amazon's largest seller fee revenue base AND turn that clean data foundation into profitability intelligence that drives fee strategy decisions.

This is not a traditional finance role — it's a hybrid that combines end-to-end FBA analytics and how we protect our fee revenue base, heavily powered by AI and automation,

You will own the connection between FBA fee revenue at the shipment level and operational costs across Amazon's fulfillment network — producing the fee-level P&L that tells leadership whether we're happy or sad with FBA economics and that our financial controls are working. You'll also own the GL reconciliation, revenue assurance, and quarterly inspection mechanisms that ensure those numbers are trustworthy. The controllership work is the foundation; the analytics work is the payoff.
This role sits at the intersection of all fee verticals, providing the consolidated profitability view that no single vertical can see alone. You'll partner across FP&A, Fee Strategy, Fee Technology, and Accounting.

The vision: Within 6 months, 80%+ of the controllership inspection work is automated through AI agents and intelligent workflows. Your time shifts from manual reconciliation to proactive anomaly detection, cross-fee profitability analysis, and producing the analytics that shape FBA's fee strategy.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end fee-level P&L: connect FBA revenue (by fee type, ASP band, size tier) to operational costs across the fulfillment network
- Build and maintain AI-powered variance decomposition and profitability reporting across fee activities (Supply Chain, Storage, Selling, Value Recovery)
- Perform key GL reconciliations to ensure complete, accurate, and timely financial reporting across multiple marketplaces
- Design and automate controllership inspection mechanisms — shifting from reactive audit to proactive, AI-driven anomaly detection
- Partner with Fee Strategy, Accounting, and Fee Technology teams to ensure fees are accurate, timely, and aligned with seller communication and internal strategy
- Deliver recurring revenue analytics with proactive signals for leadership; produce cross-fee margin analysis that informs fee strategy decisions
- Build AI agents and automated workflows targeting significant automation of routine controllership inspections — develop repeatable patterns the broader finance team can adopt
- Perform recurring and ad-hoc audits of fee revenues; manage seller transaction adjustments and revenue assurance
- Provide support for external/internal audit inquiries; act as subject matter expert for controllership and FBA profitability analytics


A day in the life
Your morning starts with an AI-generated anomaly report you built — replacing hours of manual reconciliation. You investigate a fee variance, trace it to a calculation edge case, and partner with Fee Tech to resolve it before close. By afternoon, you're building the monthly fee-level P&L, decomposing variances into rate and mix effects, and drafting the narrative for leadership. Between deep dives, you're refining automated workflows that turn weekly controllership checks from multi-hour manual pulls into minutes-with-exceptions. You hold both lenses — "are the numbers right?" and "what do they mean?" — which makes you the person leadership trusts for both.

About the team
You will be joining a high-performing, fast-paced Finance team whose mission is to be the trusted strategic advisor to the business, driving profitable growth and scale through innovation. Is a highly visible role within the finance team and requires a strong leader and open communicator. You will have direct impact on top and bottom lines with the ability to deliver improvements for our teams. You will be part of a growing, fast paced, and fun team. You will have ownership for the implementation of your work and you will see direct business improvements based on the results of your work.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 5+ years of leading cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS Transactional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Transactional Services team builds some of the most foundational distributed systems that underpin and power many large AWS services. We build and own a high performance, highly available replicated log service used by a range of AWS services as a commit log and for streaming data.

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to own and a build major part for our control plane. Your work will be critical to the scalability and availability of the service. Working on a foundational service, your work can have a large, positive impact for AWS customers.

Job responsibilities include:

* Designing, developing, and operating highly available and scalable control plane services that manage the lifecycle, placement, and metadata of one of AWS's largest distributed systems — handling hundreds of millions of operations per second.
* Improving service quality, operational excellence, and reliability — building monitoring, automation, and operational tooling that prevents customer impact.
* Providing input to project plans and delivery commitments and developing quality features in line with those commitments.
* Working with a talented team, gaining and sharing knowledge through code reviews and design reviews.
* Mentoring other engineers.
* Driving technology, product and process improvements.

The role involves end-to-end ownership, from requirements to design, implementation, deployment and ongoing production support. You will have the opportunity to work with senior and principal software engineers on a daily basis.

In joining our team, you'll enjoy a competitive salary, great benefits, and a creative and comfortable work environment. Our team has multiple opportunities for growth on technical and leadership frontiers, with variety of project types on our roadmap to fit your personal career growth path.

For more information on Amazon Web Services please visit: http://aws.amazon.com

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Preferred qualifications

title: Data Center Materials Associate, Corporate IT Logistics, Operations, IT, & Support Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover anything they want to buy online. We hire the world's brightest minds, offering them an environment in which they can relentlessly improve the customer experience. Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment. Every day we solve complex technical and business problems with ingenuity and simplicity. We're making history and the good news is we've only just begun.

Amazon's IT Logistics and Imaging Team (ITS-LIT) operates a warehouse-scale production floor that images, provisions, and manages the lifecycle of every corporate laptop and device deployed to Amazonians across the United States. Our team at SEA124 (Ouroboros) in Renton, WA processes thousands of devices weekly — supporting new hire onboarding, device refreshes, inventory management, reverse logistics, and data destruction.

We are seeking a Data Center Materials Associate to join our warehouse operations team. In this role, you will support daily inventory and logistics work — receiving and inducting IT assets, picking, packing, shipping, and processing returns. You'll follow standard procedures, work through assigned tasks as priorities shift during the day, and focus on accuracy and quality in every transaction. You'll also help keep IT areas clean, organized, and audit-ready.

This is a hands-on warehouse environment where your work directly supports Amazon's ability to deliver devices to employees on Day 1.

Our team approaches work as seeing no job as too small and no challenge as too big!

Key job responsibilities
- Support daily inventory operations, including receiving, induct, storage, picking, packing, and shipping of IT assets and peripherals
- Complete assigned tasks across queues and programs, following daily priorities set by the team
- Restock IT inventory locations, vending machines, and supply stores, and report low stock to your lead
- Process returned IT assets following compute reuse, reverse logistics, and disposal procedures
- Prepare IT assets for transportation in line with IT and InfoSec policies, including safe handling and destruction of IT media
- Assist with removal and recovery of IT assets from campus locations as required
- Prepare new hire equipment kits and support campus IT staff during new hire orientation
- Follow standard operating procedures and flag issues or errors to your lead
- Complete assigned work within SLA and record progress in ServiceNow
- Work with teams across the warehouse (IT Support, Returns, Stock Cart, Imaging) to keep orders moving

A day in the life
You arrive at our warehouse in Renton, WA and check the day's work: inbound shipments to receive, outbound orders to pick and pack, and returns to process. Your lead sets the day's priorities, and you move between tasks as they shift. Some days you're building new hire kits for Monday onboarding. Other days you're processing returned assets, restocking vending machines across campus, or helping with a bulk removal from a decommissioned floor. You follow standard procedures, flag issues to your lead, update ServiceNow, and make sure every asset is accounted for. Your accuracy helps make sure every Amazonian has the equipment they need on Day 1.

About the team
We're Amazon's primary imaging center for North America — a warehouse team that prepares and ships every corporate laptop before an employee's first day. We process thousands of devices weekly across multiple imaging lanes and shifts. You'll work alongside engineers, technicians, and operations specialists who build their own tools, write their own procedures, and own their programs end-to-end. Our culture is hands-on, direct, and team-first. We value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and look for ways to improve how things work. Every day brings something different.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work 10 hour shifts as needed
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds

Preferred qualifications

- Can show strong verbal and written communication skills
- Experience maintaining inventory, including receiving, storage, and auditing
- Experience with a ticketing system such as ServiceNow
- Self-motivated and customer-focused
- Able to manage multiple requests at once and prioritize based on team objectives

title: Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapid growth of AWS business and customers 24x7. We commit to maintain the critical facility infrastructure of AWS and ensure the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency and cost. The DCEO Team is seeking individuals who are motivated, self-starters, eager to learn, passionate and committed to join us. As part of the Infrastructure Operations Team, you will have the chance to work on the most advanced technologies in a dynamic environment. If you enjoy working in a strong, close-knit and diverse team, Infrastructure Operations Team is the place to be!

Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the primary business interface with the Colocation provider’s technical and facility teams to address day-to-day operational requirements within the Availability Zone (AZ);
• Supervise the on-site Colocation providers and respective contractors, to ensure all works performed is complied with established practices, procedures & local legislation;
• Manage Colocation suppliers to conduct routine maintenance, and respond to emergency services for critical systems including switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.;
• Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for Data Center facility;
• Engage in non-office on-call responsibilities and respond promptly to emergency situations or incident, such as power failures or natural disasters, and review to refine the established Emergency Operations Procedures to effectively handle these situations;
• Deeply involve with Colocation provider and contractors to resolve infrastructure engineering issues and conduct root cause analysis for operational issues;
• Establish comprehensive English documentation to business & facility operations in partnership with the Colocation provider;
• Constantly explore and recommend improvements to enhance the data center safety, security and availability;
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Data Center infrastructure inventory through related matrices and internal dashboards
• Take charge of the installation of the racks and conduct the rack space, power/cooling assessment;
• Lead new build and expansion projects to improve the operations efficiency, including the design, implementation, and commissioning phases;
• Assist in internal recruitment including conducting interviews and assisting with onboarding.


A day in the life
Also expected from the DCEO is the ability to execute small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve moderate amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in controlled environments. The DCEO will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results. The goals of such projects are to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

• Providing timely escalation for all facilities-related issues within the data center

• Completion of assigned project tasks and managing associated reporting metrics

• Ensuring compliance of AWS Data Center safety and security protocols
• Involve in day-to-day data center facility operations work including facility change management
• Involve in vendor management and technical consultation work
• Review emergency and standard operating procedures
• Participate in facility event analysis
• Participate in emergency drills and emergency facility event response
• Participate in local and global facility operations-related projects
• Participate in multiple cross-team trainings
• Be provided an opportunity to drive operational excellence and better customer experience.

Diverse Experiences

title: Program Manager, EF Planning, External Fulfillment
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Program Manager for the External Fulfillment (EF) Planning Team within Amazon Japan's Operations Division.

 EF handles order processing and shipping operations at fulfillment centers operated by 3PL (third party logistics) or vendors, rather than at Amazon Fulfillment Centers. These centers primarily handle large items, heavy items, and temperature-controlled products. EF team contributes to the company's growth by expanding this service, offering a wide product selection with remarkably fast delivery speeds, thereby enriching our customers' shopping experience.

 This position will be responsible for managing network capacity based on medium demand forecasts and executing the launch of new logistics centers to support business growth.

 For this position that will lead the expansion of the EF business, we welcome applications from individuals with diverse industry backgrounds and experiences.
 ====
 アマゾンジャパンのオペレーションズ部門のEF（ External Fulfillment）プランニングチーム にて、プログラムマネージャーを募集いたします。

 EFは、Amazonのお客様が注文された商品の注文処理・配送業務を自社の物流拠点（Amazon Fulfillment Center）ではなく、メーカー/卸売企業や協力会社の運営する物流拠点で行うセンターで、大型品や重量品、温度管理品などを中心に取り扱っています。EFチームは、そのサービスを成長させ、豊富な品揃えと圧倒的な配送スピードを実現し、お客様の購買体験をより豊かにすることで会社の成長に貢献しています。
 本ポジションは、その役割を果たすべく、ビジネスの成長をサポートする新規物流センターの立上計画を実行することに責任を持ちます。

 EFビジネスの拡大をリードいただける当ポジションでは、様々な業界や経験をお持ちの方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

Key job responsibilities
■Planning and Execution of Mid and long-term Launch Plans for New EF Sites
 Manage medium and long term demand forecasts and EF site capacity, while creating and executing launch plans for new EF sites to support business growth. We collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders both internally and externally, and swiftly execute logistics network changes proposed in response to business environment shifts based on the latest demand forecasts.

 ■Cost Planning and Control
 We create and manage cost plans for executing new EF site launch plans. We collaborate with Finance, Operations, and partner companies to develop and implement necessary action plans.

 ■Warehouse Performance Data Management and Analysis
 To support the creation of medium- to long-term plans and decision-making for their execution, we collect and aggregate appropriate data from operational logistics facilities, and manage both historical and current information. Additionally, we analyze this data and transform it into information that enables accurate decision-making.
 ====
 ■新規EF拠点の中長期立上計画の実行
 中長期的な需要予測とEF拠点のキャパシティを管理し、ビジネスの成長をサポートする新規EF拠点の立上計画を実行します。社内外問わず多くのステークホルダーと部門横断的に協力し、最新の需要予測をベースにビジネス環境の変化から提案された物流ネットワークの変更を、スピード感を持って実行します。

 ■コスト計画の作成とコントロール
 新規EF拠点の立上計画を実行するにあたりコスト計画を作成、管理します。ファイナンス、オペレーションズや協力会社とも連携し、必要なアクションプランを策定、実行を進めます。

 ■倉庫実績データの管理および分析
 中長期計画の作成とその実行判断のサポートの為、稼働中の物流拠点の適切なデータを収集/集計し、過去及び最新情報を管理します。また、そのデータを分析し、正しい意思決定判断ができる情報に加工します。

title: Sr. Silicon & Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:

This is an exciting opportunity to join Amazon in contributing to its next generation SOC’s for the machine learning enabled consumer products.

As a Sr. Silicon & Systems Engineer, in Silicon Validation team, you will play a pivotal role in deploying SOCs in development and production phases of products by collaborating with multi-functional teams and leading the RCA (Root Cause Analysis) activities for failures pointing to silicon. You will be responsible for developing, maintaining test code/methodology to debug silicon/SOC issues and drive root cause failure analysis.

- - Experience with SOC bring-up and post-silicon validation.

title: DataCenter Technician , Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a skilled Data Center Technician with a passion for technology to help us expand our cloud to the next level. You may be the primary point of contact for both internal teams (such as Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, and Software Developers) and external partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, and Service Providers). You'll be working in large-scale, high-density data centers where you'll help change the face of cloud technology in the region.

At AWS, career progression is part of our culture. Whether your path leads to Systems, Network, or Database Engineering, Software Development, AWS Support, Technical Operations, or Project Management, we'll work with you to create a development plan that helps you reach your goals — starting from Day One.

Please apply with your updated CV in English.


Key job responsibilities
Problem Solving
• Maintain high system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently
• Serve as an escalation point and technical troubleshooter for systems and network hardware issues
• Investigate and resolve complex Linux server issues
• Troubleshoot virtualization service problems

Technical
• Troubleshoot technical issues across systems, networking, and power/mechanical domains
• Remediate physical layer outages in systems and networks, including power-related problems
• Participate in data center power and cooling events

Operations
• Work rotating shifts to meet 24/7 on-call requirements
• Install and configure server racks per internal SLAs
• Triage and resolve trouble tickets for all devices in the assigned region
• Act as the data center point of contact for high-severity issues
• Replace server and network device components as needed
• Ensure correct rotation of spare parts
• Contribute to uptime improvement metrics
• Enforce Amazon's security best practices
• Collaborate with third-party vendors, contractors, and remote support teams

Project Management
• Participate in and deliver high-impact small to mid-scale projects
• Attend team meetings for metric analysis and project status updates
• Contribute to building the world's largest cloud infrastructure

Mentoring
• Share knowledge and support team members in developing their technical skills and best practices


A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician, no two days are the same. You might start your morning reviewing support tickets and prioritizing the day's interventions. From there, you could be installing new servers in racks, diagnosing a network issue, or performing preventive maintenance on critical equipment.

You'll work at the heart of our infrastructure, collaborating with cross-functional teams — network engineers, operations managers, and vendors. Each day brings new technical challenges that allow you to grow your skills and have a direct impact on the reliability of AWS services used by millions of customers worldwide.

You'll also have the opportunity to mentor colleagues, contribute to continuous improvement projects, and help shape the evolution of our practices and team. AWS provides assistive lifting equipment to support the physical aspects of the role, ensuring a safe and comfortable working environment for everyone.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating. That's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
