title: Books supply chain advisor (書籍事業部 在庫・物流戦略アドバイザー), EIS, Enhanced Instock Service
descriptionHtml:
日本の紙書籍の流通は、既存物流網に対する新たな制約やコスト増、読者の嗜好の多様化、経済状況や購買行動の変化といった、新たな課題に次々と直面しています。こうしためまぐるしく変化するビジネス環境の中であっても、Amazon 書籍事業部の Strategic Supply Chain Management チームは、社内外のステークホルダーと協力し、「読みたい本が、読みたいときに手に入る」というミッションの実現に向けて日々奮闘しています。

当チームは、社内の様々なチームに加え、出版社・取次会社・倉庫・物流会社といった社外のステークホルダーと協働し、紙書籍の在庫・物流に関する戦略立案と実行を担っています。そのうち、今回募集する Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager は、出版社の在庫管理を専門に支援するチームに所属し、アサインされた出版社（1人あたり3〜4社）に寄り添いながら、在庫・物流を中心としたサプライチェーン上の課題を特定し、解決策の設計から実行までを一気通貫で担うコンサルタント職です。社内の多様なチームと協業し、お客様の購買体験と出版社のビジネスの双方を改善します。なお、本ポジションは原則として電子書籍を業務スコープに含みません。

この職種の魅力:

在庫、需要予測、物流のデータを自ら分析し、改善施策を企画から実行までオーナーシップを持って進められます
欠品の削減、発売日のお届け、配送スピードなど、お客様が実感できる成果に直結します
日本の出版流通という業界構造そのものに向き合い、出版社の意思決定層と直接議論する機会があります
前例のない課題に、自分の分析と行動で最初に取り組めます
変化を脅威ではなく機会ととらえ、自ら課題を見つけて動けるリーダーをお待ちしています。

Japan's print book supply chain meets new challenges one after another: new constraints and rising costs across the existing logistics network, broadening reader preferences, and shifts in the economy and in how people buy. Even in this fast-changing environment, the Strategic Supply Chain Management team in Amazon's Books organization works with stakeholders inside and outside Amazon, every day, to deliver on one mission: readers get the book they want, when they want it.

Our team sets and executes the strategy for print book inventory and logistics. We work across Amazon and with external stakeholders including publishers, distributors, warehouses, and transportation providers. As an Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager, you will join a team dedicated to supporting publishers' inventory management. You will work closely with an assigned group of publishers (three to four per role), identify supply chain problems centered on inventory and logistics, and own the solution end to end, from design through execution. You will collaborate with teams across Amazon to improve both the customer buying experience and our publishers' business. As a rule, this position does not include eBooks in its scope.

Why you will love this role:

You analyze inventory, forecasting, and logistics data yourself, and own improvement initiatives from idea through execution.
Your work connects directly to outcomes customers feel: fewer out-of-stock titles, delivery on release day, and faster shipping speed.
You engage with the structure of Japan's book distribution industry, and discuss decisions directly with publisher leadership.
You are first to take on problems with no precedent, where your own analysis and action move the result.
We are looking for a customer-focused, driven, and analytical leader who sees change as an opportunity rather than a threat, and who finds and acts on problems without being asked.

Key job responsibilities
Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager は、担当する出版社（1人あたり3〜4社）の在庫戦略にオーナーシップを持ち、商品セレクションの拡充、欠品の削減、サプライチェーンの効率化を通じて、お客様にとって最良の購買体験と事業の収益性の双方を高めます。担当出版社の在庫計画と運用管理のすべての側面を担うことが、この職種の業務の基盤です。加えて、そこで得た知見や経験をもとに、チーム全体が追う欠品率などの指標の改善、重要プロジェクト、事業部全体を横断する取り組みにも携わります。

主な職務内容:

担当出版社の需要予測、発注、在庫水準の計画を立案し、欠品の削減と在庫回転率の改善を主導します
出版社のサプライチェーン上の課題を特定し、改善施策を設計から実行まで一気通貫で担います
納品リードタイム、受注対応、在庫情報の連携など、出版社側のオペレーション改善を支援します
効率的で拡張性のあるサプライチェーンを構築し、固定費・変動費の削減に貢献します
Amazon 社内の購買・発注の仕組みとシステムを理解し、活用および改善提案を行います
データ分析、自動化、継続的な改善により、業務の精度とスピードを高めます
当チームでは、担当範囲の線引きにとらわれず、チームの成果のために必要なことへ自ら手を伸ばすことを期待しています。Amazon のリーダーは「それは私の仕事ではありません」とは決して口にしません。チームおよびプログラムの状況に応じて、担当出版社の枠を越えた指標の改善、重要プロジェクト、上記以外の業務を、一時的または継続的に担当することがあります。自ら職務範囲を広げていける方にとって、成長の機会が多い環境です。

As an Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager, you will own the inventory strategy for an assigned group of publishers (three to four per role). You will grow selection, reduce out-of-stock titles, and drive supply chain efficiency, so that customers get a best-in-class buying experience and the business grows revenue and margin. Covering all aspects of inventory planning and operational management for your publishers is the foundation of this job. Building on what you learn there, you will also help improve the metrics the whole team owns, such as out-of-stock rate, and take part in key projects and in initiatives that run across the Books organization.

Key job responsibilities:

Build demand forecasting, ordering, and inventory level plans for your publishers, and drive improvement in out-of-stock rate and inventory turns.
Identify supply chain problems at your publishers, and own improvement initiatives from design through execution.
Support your publishers in improving their operations, including delivery lead time, order confirmation, and inventory data exchange.
Build efficient and scalable supply chain operations that reduce fixed and variable costs.
Understand and apply Amazon's internal buying and ordering systems and processes, and propose improvements to them.
Raise the accuracy and speed of your work through data analysis, automation, and Kaizen.
On this team, we expect you to look past the boundaries of your assigned scope and reach for whatever the team's results require. Leaders at Amazon never say "that's not my job." Depending on team and program circumstances, you may take on metric improvements beyond your assigned publishers, key projects, or work outside the scope described above, either temporarily or on an ongoing basis. For someone who wants to widen their own remit, this is an environment with a lot of room to grow.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

A day in the life
日々の業務は担当出版社との対話と、その背後にあるデータの分析を往復しながら進みます。直接のクライアントは担当出版社ですが、最終的なお客様は本を待っている読者です。業務の中心は担当出版社ですが、週の一部は、チーム全体が追う指標の改善や、事業部を横断する取り組みに充てることもあります。

出版社側のカウンターパートは、在庫・物流・営業の担当部門です。Amazon 社内では、同じく出版社を担当するチームメンバーや、Strategic Supply Chain Management チームの各メンバーと最も密に協働します。書籍事業部内では、アカウントマネージャー、売上向上コンサルタント、商品企画担当、マーケティング部門などの各チームと連携します。さらに、フルフィルメントセンター、輸送、需要予測やシステムの関連チーム、ファイナンス、および他国の同職種のチームとも日常的に関わります。

解決する課題は、欠品の発生原因の特定と解消、新刊の発売日に向けた在庫確保、需要予測の精度改善、納品プロセスに潜む非効率の解消などです。

一日・一週間の業務の例:

担当出版社の指標（欠品率、在庫水準、納品実績）を確認し、異常値の原因を特定します
データを抽出して深く掘り下げ、課題を定量化した上で仮説を立てます
仮説に基づきアクションプランとスケジュールを設計し、出版社や社内ステークホルダー向けの資料を作成してレビューを受けます
担当出版社からの問い合わせに対応し、在庫や納品に関する判断を日次で行います
Amazon 社内システム上で、需要予測や発注、在庫に関する設定と実行を行います
出版社との定例ミーティングで改善の進捗を共有し、次に取り組むことを合意します
担当出版社の枠を越え、チーム全体が追う指標の改善に向けた分析や施策の検討に取り組みます
事業部を横断するプロジェクトや、チーム内の業務プロセスの改善・自動化に参加します

Your days move back and forth between conversations with your publishers and analysis of the data behind them. Your direct clients are the publishers you are assigned to, and your ultimate customers are the readers waiting for their books. Your publishers are the center of the work, though part of your week may also go to improving the metrics the whole team owns and to initiatives that run across the Books organization.

At your publishers, your counterparts are the teams responsible for inventory, logistics, and sales. Inside Amazon, you work most closely with the other members who cover publishers and with the members of the Strategic Supply Chain Management team. Within the Books organization, you work with account managers, sales growth consultants, merchandising and product planning, and Marketing. You also engage day to day with our fulfillment centers, Transportation, forecasting and technology teams, Finance, and your counterparts in other countries.

The problems you solve include finding and removing the causes of out-of-stock titles, securing inventory ahead of new release dates, improving forecast accuracy, and taking inefficiency out of the delivery process.

A typical day or week:

Review metrics for your publishers, including out-of-stock rate, inventory levels, and delivery performance, and identify the cause of anything that looks off.
Extract data and run a deep dive analysis to quantify the problem and form a hypothesis.
Design an action plan and schedule from that hypothesis, draft the materials for your publishers and internal stakeholders, and take them through review.
Respond to inquiries from your publishers, and make day-to-day decisions on inventory and delivery.
Configure and run demand forecasting, ordering, and inventory settings in Amazon's internal systems.
Share progress in regular meetings with your publishers, and agree on what to tackle next.
Work on analysis and initiatives that improve the metrics the whole team owns, beyond your own publishers.
Take part in projects that run across the Books organization, and in improving and automating how the team works.

About the team
書籍事業部について

読書は健全な社会にとって必須であるという信念のもと、読者がより手軽に本を読み、読書からより多くを得られるようにすることが私たちの使命です。

本ポジションが所属する Strategic Supply Chain Management チームのミッションは、お客様が読みたい書籍を、読みたいタイミングでお届けすることです。そのために、適切な商品を、適切な数量で、適切な場所に、適切なタイミングで揃えることに取り組んでいます。

日本の紙書籍のサプライチェーンは、いま転換点にあります。従来の延長線上の改善では解決できない構造的な課題が増えており、業界全体で大きな変革が必要だという認識が共有されつつあります。それは同時に、お客様のための改善に取り組む機会が豊富にあることを意味します。特に、AI モデルなどの技術を活用してサプライチェーンや在庫管理の業務を自動化し、お客様への提供価値を高める余地が大きく残されています。

当チームの働き方には3つの特徴があります。1人が担当出版社のオーナーとして意思決定を任されること、議論の土台を感覚ではなくデータに置くこと、そして担当や職種の境界を越えて互いに助け合うことです。

紙書籍という、当たり前に存在するように見えて実は大きな課題を抱えるビジネスを、持続可能なかたちで続けていくために、前向きな姿勢と強いオーナーシップ、そしてチームワークをもって取り組んでいます。

About the Books organization

We believe reading is essential for a healthy society. Our mission is to inspire readers by making it easy to read more and to get more out of reading.

The mission of the Strategic Supply Chain Management team, where this role sits, is to deliver the books our customers want, at the time they want them: the right products, in the right quantities, in the right place, at the right time.

Japan's print book supply chain is at a turning point. Structural problems are growing that incremental improvement alone will not solve, and a shared view is forming across the industry that significant change is needed. That also means there is no shortage of opportunity to improve things for customers. In particular, much room remains to use technology such as AI models to automate work across supply chain and inventory management, and to raise what we deliver to customers.

Three things define how our team works. Each of us owns the decisions for our own publishers. We put data, not instinct, at the base of our discussions. And we help each other across the boundaries of assignments and job families.

This is work that takes a business most people assume will always be there, but which in fact faces real structural challenges, and turns it into something sustainable. We are looking for someone who will take that on with a positive outlook, strong ownership, and teamwork.

Basic qualifications

・工学、ビジネス、または関連分野における学士号
・2年以上の社会人経験
・日本語が母国語、もしくは、JPLTN1 / N2 ビジネスレベルの英語
・基礎的なOffice操作 (Excelによる分析、Powerpointによるスライド作成、Wordによるドキュメント作成）
・KPIなどのメトリック作成・改善の経験、および、生データからインサイトを抽出する分析力

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or related field
- 2+ years of professional non-internship experience.
- Native Japanese or JPLT N1/N2 and business level English required
- Basic capability for MS Office (analysis using Excel, slide creation using Powerpoint, document creation using Word)
- Experience with reporting technologies and analytics. Capable of turning raw data into information and insights

Preferred qualifications

・4年以上の社会人経験
・事業会社における経営企画/サプライチェーン関連の業務経験又はコンサルティング会社におけるアナリスト/コンサルタント経験
・出版業界における経営企画/サプライチェーン関連又は営業に関連する経験
・優れた意思決定力、書面および口頭でのコミュニケーション力、実践的で常識的なアプローチに基づく実行力
・優れた分析能力と問題解決能力。 大規模で複雑なデータを処理する能力と、統計学またはその他の分析手法に精通している
・優先順位付け、スケジュール管理、時間管理、期限の遵守などの優れた実行力
・カイゼン、リーン生産方式、シックスシグマなどのプロセス改善の経験

- 4+ years of professional non-internship experience.
- Job experience for business planning/supply chain-related field or analyst/consultant experience at a consulting firm
- Job experience for business planning/supply chain-related field or sales experience in the publishing industry
- Possess excellent business judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and a practical, common sense approach to getting things done.
- Strong analytical abilities and problem solving skills. Ability to work with large, complex data sets and familiarity with statistics or other analytical techniques.
- Strong organizational skills including prioritizing, scheduling, time management and meeting deadlines.
- Experience with improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma.

title: Operations & Logistics Internship MXP6-Agognate
descriptionHtml:
****This position is based in MXP6-Agognate. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided. Applying to the talent pool is non-binding and does not guarantee a specific start date or offer.****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.


A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.


About the team
Intern Community:
• As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
Support:
• The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
Learning Sessions:
• Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
Opportunities:
• Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.
Internship Start Dates across the year:
• We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through July 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

Basic qualifications

- Currently in your penultimate (graduating in 2028) or last year, and working towards a university degree in Supply Chain, Business/Management, Engineering or another related field.
- Eligible to complete a full-time internship (40hours/week) of 3-6 months with a start date between January and July 2027.
- Highly proficient in both spoken and written English and the local language of the country you are applying for (Common European Framework of Reference C1).

Preferred qualifications

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others.
- Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The minimum gross base salary for this position is listed below. The base salary listed corresponds to working on a full-time basis. For part-time hours, the salary will be pro-rated.

Amazon's package may include further pay components where applicable. Your recruiting team will share final salary, depending on requirements.

In addition to statutory benefits, company supplementary benefits may apply subject to further terms.

See below the minimum gross base salary for this position:



Agognate, ITA - 1,800.00 EUR Monthly

title: Product Designer III, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon OpenSearch Service is how customers search, analyze, and make sense of their data at massive scale — powering application search, log analytics, observability, and increasingly AI-powered and agentic investigation workflows. It's a product where the data is enormous, the queries are complex, and the users range from developers running their first search cluster to SRE and security teams triaging an incident at 2 a.m. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the experience for a core part of OpenSearch and make that complexity feel effortless.

Search itself is being reinvented. With Winnow, OpenSearch is moving from keyword-and-query mechanics toward agentic search — where a customer expresses intent and an AI agent plans, retrieves, reasons, and returns answers rather than ten blue links. That shift rewrites the design problem: the interface is no longer a search box and a results list, but a conversation with a system that acts on the customer's behalf, shows its reasoning, and has to earn trust with every answer. You'll help invent what that experience looks like.

This isn't a role where design hands off mockups and walks away. Our designers are end-to-end builders — embedded in OpenSearch builder pods, shaping product decisions, prototyping in real code, shipping to production, and measuring what happens. You'll own your problem space from framing through launch, ground your decisions in research that actually feeds the roadmap, and help push OpenSearch into its next chapter — agentic search and observability where the design challenge is as much about trust and verification

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the end-to-end design for a core OpenSearch experience — from problem framing and research through interaction design, visual craft, production implementation, and post-launch measurement.
2. Help define the experience for Winnow / agentic search: how a customer expresses intent, how the agent's planning and reasoning are surfaced, how results and their provenance earn trust, and how the customer stays in control.
3. Embed in a builder pod with product and engineering as a true end-to-end builder: shape what gets built and in what order, not just how it looks.
4. Design for genuine complexity — search relevance, vector and semantic search, log analytics, dashboards, observability workflows, alerting, and root-cause investigation — and make dense, high-volume data feel clear and navigable.
5. Help define the experience for agentic observability alongside agentic search, where interfaces surface agent reasoning, findings, and remediation — and where earning the customer's trust is the core design problem.
6. Run research that ships: structured research cycles, trust-calibration studies, and competitive signal capture that feed directly into the roadmap rather than sitting in a deck.
7. Contribute to and extend the OpenSearch design system (OUI) so patterns are consistent, accessible, and scale across the product.
8. Partner daily with PMs and engineers to balance customer needs, deep technical constraints, and business goals.
9. Raise the design bar across the team through critique, mentorship, and reusable patterns.

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review where you present a systems-level concept to product and engineering partners, walking through how a new interaction pattern scales across multiple surfaces. After lunch, you shift into hands-on craft work in Figma, refining a prototype informed by recent research findings. Later, you facilitate an alignment session with cross-functional stakeholders who have competing priorities, helping the group converge on a shared path forward. Throughout it all, you mentor fellow designers, write persuasive strategy documents, and use AI tools to rapidly explore ideas.

About the team
We're the design team behind Amazon OpenSearch Service, and we work differently: six designers embedded directly in OpenSearch builder pods, owning the experience from problem framing through production. We're designing OpenSearch's shift to agentic search and observability so the work is net-new: inventing the patterns for how customers trust a system that searches, reasons, and acts for them. We operate on three principles: end-to-end builders (we shape, build, ship, and measure), research that ships (structured research and trust-calibration work that feeds the roadmap directly), and a self-learning design system (OUI, evolving toward agentic patterns). We treat design as a competitive weapon, not a line item. We're a senior, tight-knit group that gives designers genuine ownership of their problem space, invests in craft and research, and cares deeply about raising each other's work.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience

Preferred qualifications

- Have an available online portfolio

title: AWS Commercial Sales Internship
descriptionHtml:
The internship starts mid-April 2027 (24 weeks). You need to be enrolled in University, graduating from a Bachelor's or Master's degree in 2027 (desired) or 2028.

Mandatory languages: Swedish and English



We're on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will grow into the high-impact, visionary person you know you're ready to be, taking on new challenges and developing new skills every day in our AI-first cloud environment.

Would you like to be part of a team that helps customers across EMEA adopt AWS cloud solutions and accelerate their digital transformation.

If you are passionate about cloud technologies, AWS is developing the next generation of commercial leaders. Our Commercial Sales Internship Program offers a structured roadmap of in-depth learning and hands-on practice across AWS services and solution selling, preparing you for a future Sales role while you deliver long-term impact through a real business project.

AWS offers a dynamic and motivating environment where you will advance your career, support the growth of AWS customers, and help shape the future of emerging cloud and AI technologies. As you build customer-readiness, the role becomes partly external-facing, giving you real exposure to customers.

This paid internship gives you the chance to take on a real business project, developed in a team connected to Amazon Global Sales. You'll work with a range of stakeholders across AWS, making a tangible impact and building and innovating in the Amazonian way. Throughout, you'll be supported by our EMEA internship community, working in agile teams with access to mentoring, learning, and shadowing opportunities.

Key job responsibilities
What Makes You Future-Ready:
• Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach
• Digital innovation mindset with genuine curiosity about AI and emerging cloud technologies
• Showcasing resilience and adaptability in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
• Customer and stakeholder focus with strong communication skills
• Cross-functional collaboration capabilities to work across different teams and business units

The program includes comprehensive training on AWS services, cloud computing concepts, AI-first methodologies, and hands-on practical exercises to solidify your learning. You'll develop strategic thinking capabilities, GenAI proficiency, and stakeholder management skills essential for success in our rapidly evolving AI environment.
The successful candidate will be interested in a career in cloud technology, demonstrating learning agility, comfort with digital tools, and the ability to think strategically while remaining adaptable to new challenges and technologies that drive and grow AWS footprint with our customers.


A day in the life

• Learn about the AWS solution portfolio (including earning certifications like the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and AWS Certified AI Practitioner) and the Amazon culture, with strong focus on AI services and innovative cloud solutions
• Rotation assignments across different business units and teams, collaborating with various team members to innovate
• Work within agile methodologies to deliver impactful business projects
• Build an understanding of customer challenges, requirements, and the potential value that can be delivered by AWS
• Differentiate and understand various IT roles and responsibilities in modern AI-first organizations


If you're insatiably curious and eager to learn, then you've come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, the following benefits may be available to you as an intern:
• Competitive pay
• Impactful project and internship deliverables with rotation opportunities
• Agile team collaboration and innovative project work
• Networking opportunities with fellow interns across different EMEA locations
• Internship events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions, and AI technology workshops
• Mentorship and career development


About the team
Successful applicants will be invited to an online assessment. If successful and selected by the hiring team, you'll be invited for a first virtual interview. If you progress through this stage, you'll then be invited for a final round of interviews consisting of a combination of interviews and case studies, focusing on our Leadership Principles and your ability to work in Agile, innovative environments. Please note that this selection process is subject to change and may vary depending on the role and location.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

- Work full time
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish (at C1 level or above) and English

descriptionHtml:
****This position could be based in FCO1-Passo Corese. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.


A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.


About the team
Intern Community:

You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Opportunities:

title: Kierownik zmiany / Kierownik obszaru / Kierownik logistyki / Area Manager Operations
descriptionHtml:
Proszę pamiętać, że ta rola jest w pełni stacjonarna w Sosnowiec.



Dział operacyjny to serce firmy Amazon. Ten kluczowy segment naszej działalności zapewnia, że realizujemy i wysyłamy zamówienia w sposób efektywny, dzięki czemu nasi klienci otrzymują swoje zakupy na czas. Osoba na stanowisku Area Manager dokłada wszelkich starań, aby centrum logistyczne, w którym pracuje działało sprawnie, co pozwala nam wychodzić naprzeciw oczekiwaniom klientów. Kieruje zespołem, który troszczy się o zachowanie bezpieczeństwa, wydajności i wysokiej jakości naszych działań, a także podejmuje się realizacji wielu projektów w całej naszej sieci, mających na celu zwiększenie wydajności.

Key job responsibilities
Tworzenie, nadzorowanie i promowanie kultury bezpieczeństwa i zadowolenia z pracy
Analizowanie i wdrażanie modyfikacji w celu zapewnienia jakości i wydajności na stałym, wysokim poziomie
Nadzorowanie projektów mających na celu usprawnienie procesów, optymalizację wydajności i podniesienie jakości usług dla klientów w obrębie swojego obszaru odpowiedzialności
Analizowanie wydajności zmiany w stosunku do stosownych celów biznesowych i wprowadzanie działań mających na celu osiągnięcie doskonałości operacyjnej
Współpraca z innymi managerami w celu standaryzacji procesów na zmianach



A day in the life
Osoba na tym stanowisku pracuje w systemie zmianowym w jednym z naszych centrów logistycznych, zapewniając jego najwyższą możliwą wydajność. Głównym zadaniem Area Managera jest kierowanie i napędzanie kultury bezpieczeństwa oraz utrzymywanie jakości i standardów wydajności na zmianach. Area Manager nadzoruje również usprawnienia procesów w swoim obszarze i napędza ich wdrażanie. Typowy dzień jest tutaj niezwykle zróżnicowany i obejmuje rozmaite czynności, od rutynowego zarządzania zespołem i codziennych obowiązków operacyjnych, po doskonalenie procesów i szeroko zakrojone zadania operacyjne w sytuacjach awaryjnych. Osoba ta jest również mentorem dla nowych managerów.


About the team
Centrum logistyczne to miejsce, w którym firma Amazon stawiała swoje pierwsze kroki. Ze skromnego zespołu sprzedawców książek przekształciło się ono w wysokorozwiniętą korporację o zasięgu ogólnoświatowym, która każdego dnia obsługuje ponad 1,5 miliona zamówień. Osoby pracujące w centrach logistycznych stanowią fundament naszej działalności, a ich wysiłki pomagają nam w ekspansji naszej firmy na nowe rejony oraz w rozszerzeniu wachlarza świadczonych przez nas usług. Korzystając z najnowszych technologii, stale poszukujemy sposobów na zwiększenie i udoskonalenie gamy oferowanych przez nas produktów – dostarczanych szybko i tanio.
Nasze zespoły w centrach logistycznych są pierwszym ogniwem w łańcuchu dostaw przyczyniającym się do realizacji zamówień klientów w tempie, z którego tak słyniemy. Pracujemy w centrach logistycznych, które stanowią serce prężnej sieci operacyjnej firmy Amazon i określane są niekiedy jako „pierwszy kilometr”, ponieważ to właśnie tutaj większość przesyłek rozpoczyna swoją podróż. Pomagamy również zarządzać dynamicznie zmieniającymi się składami magazynowymi i umożliwiamy realizację szybkich dostaw 24 godziny na dobę.
W naszych centrach logistycznych pracuje wiele różnych osób, bo oferujemy perspektywy dla osób o każdym poziomie umiejętności i wykształcenia. Niektórzy z nas zajmują się bezpośrednio towarami, inni analizują dane, pomagając wszystkim w firmie w podejmowaniu trafnych decyzji.

Minimalne wynagrodzenie podstawowe dla tego stanowiska jest wymienione poniżej. Jako firma oferująca całościowe wynagrodzenie, pakiet Amazon może obejmować dodatkowe składniki wynagrodzenia, takie jak premia za podpisanie umowy oraz uprawnienie do uczestnictwa w programie ograniczonych jednostek akcyjnych (RSU) prowadzonym niezależnie przez Amazon.com Inc. w USA. Twój zespół rekrutacyjny podzieli się ostatecznym wynagrodzeniem podstawowym oraz wszelkimi odpowiednimi elementami całkowitego wynagrodzenia w zależności od umiejętności i wymagań.
Uznaniowe, dodatkowe świadczenia firmowe podlegają dalszym warunkom, w tym plany emerytalne, ubezpieczenie zdrowotne, ubezpieczenie na życie i od niezdolności do pracy, ubezpieczenie podróży służbowych, karta MultiSport, kod rabatowy dla pracowników i program (EDC/Extras), świadczenia dojazdowe tam, gdzie mają zastosowanie, oraz Program Wsparcia Pracowników (prywatne i poufne doradztwo oraz usługa skierowań wspierająca zdrowie i dobre samopoczucie).
Minimalne wynagrodzenie podstawowe dla tego stanowiska wynosi 9 683 PLN miesięcznie.

Basic qualifications

- Wykształcenie wyższe
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w kierowaniu zespołem
- Wcześniejsze doświadczenie w komunikacji z szerokim gronem partnerów biznesowych, w tym ze współpracownikami i z przełożonymi
- Umiejętność wykorzystywania danych analitycznych i empirycznych do podejmowania decyzji i rozwiązywania problemów
- Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego i polskiego w mowie i piśmie

Preferred qualifications

- Preferowane kwalifikacje nie są wymagane do starania się o stanowisko w Amazon. Z przyjemnością zapoznamy się z kandydaturą osób, które posiadają wszystkie wyżej wymienione kwalifikacje podstawowe.
- Doświadczenie z narzędziami Lean, Six Sigma i technikami Kaizen
- Doświadczenie nabyte w innym środowisku logistycznym

title: Technicien/ne Sécurité au Travail
descriptionHtml:
Ce poste est proposé dans le cadre d'un contrat à durée déterminée (CDD) d'une durée de 12 mois à compter de la date de prise de fonction.

Assurer la sécurité et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs au travail est une priorité absolue chez Amazon. Nos Techniciens de Sécurité jouent un rôle essentiel dans ce domaine. Ce poste est l'occasion de débuter votre carrière dans la sécurité au travail et de vous développer au sein d'une entreprise internationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos experts pour surveiller votre site, ce qui vous permettra de constater chaque jour l'impact de votre travail sur le bien-être de chacun.

Key job responsibilities
- Effectuer des évaluations de risques et des audits.
- Surveiller le site pour s'assurer que les processus sont conformes aux procédures de sécurité d'Amazon.
- Créer et mettre à jour des rapports sur les indicateurs de sécurité pour vos collègues.
- Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles et d'autres services sur des tâches liées à la sécurité et offrir des conseils sur les processus.
- Soutenir la mise en place de nouvelles mesures de sécurité.

A day in the life
Vous travaillerez sur l'un de nos sites. Cela signifie que vous pourrez suivre de près ce qui se passe et que les collaborateurs pourront facilement vous poser des questions pendant leurs postes. Ce rôle consiste avant tout à repérer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent. Vous passerez beaucoup de temps à vérifier le site et à comprendre comment les collaborateurs utilisent les équipements. En comprenant le fonctionnement de chaque tâche et de chaque machine, vous serez en mesure de trouver la meilleure façon de garantir la sécurité des processus. Vous serez également l'une des personnes chargées de mettre en œuvre les changements en matière de sécurité, ce qui signifie que vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreuses personnes. En plus de vos tâches quotidiennes et hebdomadaires, vous apporterez votre soutien à notre équipe Operations sur des missions ponctuelles liées à la sécurité. La sécurité est primordiale chez Amazon, et vous nous aiderez à recueillir les données essentielles qui nous permettent de maîtriser nos processus et d'anticiper tout problème. Vous partagerez également ces données avec les équipes de l'entreprise et collaborerez avec d'autres services pour vous assurer que la sécurité reste la priorité.

About the team
L'équipe Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) joue un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bien-être mental et physique de nos collaborateurs au travail. Notre équipe travaille avec les responsables, les associés et les administrations locales sur l'ensemble de nos sites, en assurant le respect des politiques d'Amazon et des réglementations légales, et en garantissant la sécurité de nos environnements de travail. L'équipe offre une variété d'opportunités, des Techniciens de Sécurité aux Responsables de Programmes. Quel que soit votre poste, vous contribuerez au développement et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de sécurité sur l'ensemble du réseau.

Basic qualifications

- DUT HSE (Hygiène, Sécurité, Environnement) ou BUT (Licence) en HSE.
- Expérience pertinente dans l'utilisation de l'analyse de données pour générer et expliquer des indicateurs.
- Connaissance de la législation française en matière de santé et sécurité au travail.
- Maîtrise du français et connaissances de base en anglais (A2), à l'écrit et à l'oral.

Preferred qualifications

- Les qualifications préférées ne sont pas requises pour postuler chez Amazon. Si vous possédez toutes les qualifications de base ci-dessus, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.
- Expérience avec les méthodologies Lean, 5S ou Kaizen.
- Expérience dans la planification ou la gestion d'initiatives écoresponsables.
- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. descriptionHtml:
****This position could be based in DLY1-Cisterna Di Latina. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.

Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

title: Data Center Manager - Nights, DCO
descriptionHtml:
Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!

AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:
- Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
- Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
- Developing Career Paths for the employees and making updates in our internal tools.
- Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
- Ensure effective and efficient management of day-to-day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics
- Fast learn or act as the subject matter expert across all aspects in data center operations
- Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured and met
- Inspire and guide improvement in team process, technology innovation and automation
- Manage Large Scale Events (outages) and act as the call leader
- Manage and improve the workflows and through-put for data centers operations
- Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs
- Maintain the on-call schedule coordinating absence and vacations
- Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided, and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of in a management or team lead function experience
- 2+ years of people management experience
- 2+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware experience, including troubleshooting and repairing experience
- Experience in technical writing in a relevant field
- certification in an applicable field like A+, Net+, Sec+, CCNA, LPIC, Linux+, AWS certification, or A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+
- Experience with system management tools and client/server environments

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability, and scaling) new and existing systems. Experience programming with at least one software programming language: Java, Python, or TypeScript. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU Member state.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building and operating scalable, high-availability production systems, and owning their operational excellence. Experience developing with SQL and NoSQL databases, and with cloud technologies (AWS). Experience quickly prototyping new systems and solutions. Familiarity with security automation, threat detection, or incident response tooling (a plus, not required). Excellent written and oral communication skills. Meets/exceeds Amazon's leadership principles requirements for this role. Meets/exceeds Amazon's functional/technical depth and complexity for this role.

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Sr. Product Manager, Tech, Prime Video Global App Experience
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech who is passionate about building world-class customer experiences beyond the Prime Video app. In this role, you'll own and shape the strategic direction for how millions of WW customers discover, engage with, and return to Prime Video through outbound marketing channels, messaging apps, and emerging AI surfaces.

You'll obsess over the end-to-end customer experience — designing communication programs that feel premium, intuitive, and worthy of the Prime Video brand. You'll develop a deep understanding of customer behavior across email, push notifications, WhatsApp, and new surfaces like AI platforms, then translate those insights into communication programs that feel timely, relevant, and delightful. You'll be highly informed by data and experimentation but apply high judgment to anticipate where customer attention is shifting and position Prime Video to meet them there.

Key job responsibilities
- Vision & Strategy: Drive the long-term vision and strategy for Prime Video's off-app customer experience — defining how we show up across outbound channels, conversational surfaces, and emerging AI platforms
- Customer Understanding: Develop a comprehensive understanding of customer lifecycle patterns, content consumption behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we reach customers
- Leadership & Influence: Set the bar for product thinking across the team — mentor PMs, influence cross-org priorities, and represent the off-app experience perspective in senior leadership forums
- Experience Design: Design and implement customer communication experiences that are premium, contextual, and consistent with the in-app experience — across email, push, WhatsApp, and new surfaces
- Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Prime Video ahead of shifting customer behavior
- Marketing Automation: Build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer journeys without engineering dependency
- Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
- Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams to bring experiences to market in a complex, fast-paced environment

About the team
Our vision is to establish Prime Video as the premium entertainment brand regardless of where customers engage with us. We meet customers where they are by expanding touchpoints across out-of-app surfaces, delivering compelling experiences that showcase our content and brand, and creating a seamless transition to stream. We contribute to the Prime Video vision by driving high-intent customer engagement into the Prime Video app and strengthening the Prime Video brand in off-app surfaces.

We oversee the Prime Video experiences across customer touchpoints off-app, including: organic & AI surfaces (traditional search and AI), conversational surfaces (WhatsApp), outbound (email and push notifications), A.com and social.

- 2+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

title: Data Center Security Manager (Saudi National Only), Infrastructure Physical Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking to hire a highly motivated, customer-obsessed professional to provide hands-on support to our Data Center Security team across Saudi Cluster.

As a Data Center Security Manager (DSM), you will be tasked with running day-to-day data center security operations, supporting and executing security projects and programs, as well as assuring audit compliance with AWS policies and procedures.

Key job responsibilities

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Ads Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future with us! What unites all Amazonians (across teams and geographies) is that we are all striving to delight customers and make their lives easier, whoever that customer may be. In pursuit of delighting customers, Amazonians have developed many products and services that transformed the way our customers live their lives and run their businesses. Together, we are building the future, one innovative product, service, and idea at a time.

Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, publishers, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions—including retail media, display, video, DSP, measurement, and ad tech solutions—leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys.

We're seeking a strategic and customer-obsessed Product Marketing Manager to join our Ads Product Marketing team. In this role, you'll serve as a critical bridge between product development and go-to-market execution, translating complex advertising solutions into compelling narratives that resonate with advertisers and drive product adoption at scale.

As a Product Marketing Manager, you'll partner closely with Product Management, Go-to-Market, and cross-functional stakeholders to shape product strategy through deep customer insights and competitive intelligence. You'll own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle—from informing the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research to crafting positioning and messaging that differentiates our solutions in market. Your work will directly influence how thousands of advertisers discover, adopt, and maximize value from Amazon Ads products.

The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor with creative storytelling, thrives in ambiguous environments, and has a proven track record of launching products that achieve measurable business impact. You'll need to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, moving seamlessly from conducting advertiser research to developing sales enablement materials to presenting product vision to senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
1. Collaborate with Product Managers to align on customer research priorities that will inform the product roadmap.
2. Conduct in-depth research and competitive analysis to identify the most promising opportunities for Amazon Ads products.
3. Communicate the product vision and direction to internal and external stakeholders to drive buy-in and adoption, establishing a regular cadence of stakeholder engagement.
4. Partner with Product Managers to recommend customer feedback prioritization, support effective Alpha/Beta testing, and refine the strategic roadmap.
5. Align GTM strategy to the product roadmap, translate complex product information into simple and clear language, and continue to gather customer feedback post-launch to inform future iterations.
6. Develop single-source-of-truth documentation to enable sales and marketing with positioning, messaging, product availability, best practices, implementation guides, and FAQs.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the latest campaign performance data and customer feedback, then shift into a working session with product managers to refine messaging for an upcoming launch. After lunch, you could be presenting a go-to-market strategy to senior leaders, gathering input, and aligning on next steps. Later, you'll connect with sales and partner teams to ensure enablement materials are landing effectively. Throughout it all, you're asking the right questions, simplifying complexity, and keeping cross-functional teams moving toward a shared goal.

About the team
The Ads Product Marketing team within Amazon Ads is the strategic connective tissue between product innovation and market impact. We don't just launch products, we shape how advertisers discover, understand, and derive value from Amazon's advertising solutions across the full funnel.

The Commerce pod sits at the heart of this mission, owning product marketing for some of Amazon Ads' core solutions: Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Brand Stores. Together, these products serve millions of advertisers globally from small businesses running their first campaign to the large brands.

This role is part of the Sponsored Products & Sponsored Brands (SPB) product marketing team. We are evolving the PMM function beyond traditional launch communications to earning a seat at the table to directly influence the product roadmap through voice-of-customer research, competitive intelligence, and deep advertiser insights. Our work spans the full marketing lifecycle: from shaping what gets built, to how it's positioned in market, to driving adoption and measuring impact post-launch.

You'll join a collaborative, fast-paced team that partners daily with Product Management, Go-to-Market, Sales Enablement, and cross-functional leadership. We operate with a builder mentality by testing, learning, and iterating to deliver solutions that move the needle for advertisers and for the business. If you're passionate about translating complex ad tech into compelling stories that drive real outcomes, this is the team for you.

Basic qualifications

- 9+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with creating GTM initiatives at scale
- Experience working cross-functionally across marketing, product management, analytics, UX, and research

title: Snr Instock & Supply Chain Manager (French speaker) - Fixed Term Contract, FR Books
descriptionHtml:
Français:
Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un contrat à durée déterminée de 14 mois à partir de mars 2026, et que le poste peut être basé à Paris, au Luxembourg ou à Londres.

Aimez-vous les livres et la lecture? Chez Amazon Books, nous pensons que la lecture est essentielle pour une société saine; notre mission est d'inspirer les lecteurs en facilitant la lecture et en tirant le meilleur parti de la lecture. Cheque membre dans notre équipe a un impact significatif sur le plaisir des lecteurs.

L'équipe Amazon Books recherche un(e) Instock & Supply Chain Manager talentueux(euse), intelligent(e) et hautement analytique. Nous recherchons des candidat(e)s passionné(e)s par l'innovation, les actions à fort impact opérationnel, l’amélioration continue et avec un fort esprit entrepreneurial.

Le/la candidat(e) retenu(e) à ce poste se concentrera sur l’amélioration des processus en collaboration avec nos fournisseurs, tout en s’assurant que les indicateurs opérationnels de la catégorie et de l'entreprise sont bien respectés et sous contrôle.

Vous devez être prêt(e) à remettre en question le statu quo et d’améliorer les processus existants afin d'améliorer l'expérience client.

Vos responsabilités:
- Offrir une disponibilité maximale des produits dans la catégorie Livres, garantissant un niveau d'inventaire sain et une organisation optimale de la chaîne d'approvisionnement.
- Améliorer les systèmes / processus en collaboration avec les équipes techniques, les opérations des fournisseurs et la gestion des stocks.
- Travailler avec les responsables des fournisseurs et les autres membres de l'équipe pour exécuter des campagnes promotionnelles et optimiser l'approvisionnement.
- Préparer et analyser les indicateurs de suivi pour améliorer la gestion de l’inventaire.
- Soyez un leader au-delà des propres catégories et travaillez conjointement avec les équipes d'ingénierie d'Amazon.
- Gérez les données à grande échelle pour guider la prise de décision.
- Gérez plusieurs projets - hiérarchisation, planification et délégation des tâches appropriées.


English:
Please note that this is a fixed-term contract of 14 months starting March 2026, and that the position can be based in Paris, Luxembourg or London.

Our mission is simple: Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online.

At Amazon Books we believe reading is essential for a healthy society; our mission is to inspire readers by making it easy to read more and get more out of reading. Everyone in our team has a meaningful impact on delighting our customers.

We are looking for a talented, smart and highly analytical Senior Instock & Supply Chain Manager with passion to secure product availability, large scale impact and operational improvements, with a strong entrepreneurial spirit. The candidate must be fluent in French and English.

You will be responsible for Vendors' Operational Excellence, Product Availability and Inventory Health. Your key responsibilities will include:
- Drive maximum product availability while trading-off between healthy inventory levels and delivery speed
- Analyze both supply chain related processes and large data sets, identify improvement potentials and system enhancement opportunities to make clear recommendations for business actions and own the implementation of changes
- Drive and own the development of metrics and analytics: audit existing metrics and suggest new KPIs to track continuous improvement; be responsible for reporting to senior leadership
- Join forces and collaborate with multiple different stakeholders, including Tech teams, Vendor Management and Operations, as well as external Vendors
- Force-multiply solutions in a worldwide organization collaborating across geographies while considering local peculiarities

Basic qualifications

- Expérience professionnelle d’au moins 5 années dans l'un des domaines suivants: Supply Chain, Operations, Gestion de Stock, Planification, Consulting.
- Diplôme d’école d’ingénieur ou de commerce de premier rang requis, idéalement dans une discipline technique ou analytique.
- Profil très analytique, flexible, orienté vers l'action et les résultats, autonome, à l'aise avec les bases de données et les outils informatiques.
- Un communicateur efficace travaillant avec certains des partenaires et fournisseurs les plus importants d'Amazon, ainsi qu'avec des équipes internes.
- Capacité à opérer clairement dans un environnement ambigu; forte capacité d'influence.
- __
- University degree required, ideally in a technical or analytical discipline, industrial engineering or business administration
- 5+years of track record in Supply Chain Management, Logistics or Consulting, ideally in a global context
- Proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
- Expert knowledge of Excel
- Fluent English and French languages, excellent verbal and written communication

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience dans le secteur du retail et/ou du e-commerce
- Expérience avec des outils de Business Intelligence (BI), par exemple Tableau et QuickSight, ainsi qu’en reporting de gestion
- Capacité à rédiger des requêtes SQL
- MBA ou MSc
- Formation en amélioration des processus ou en assurance qualité, notamment Kaizen ou Six Sigma
- ________________________________
- Experience in Retail and/or eCommerce
- Experience in BI tools e.g. Tableau, Quicksight and management reporting
- Ability to write SQL queries
- MBA or MSc
- Trained in process improvement or quality assurance, Kaizen or Six Sigma

title: Quality Control Engineer, AWS Integrated Project Quality (IPQ)
descriptionHtml:
The Quality Control Engineer (QCE) plays an essential role in AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery’s (DCCD) Integrated Project Quality (IPQ) program. This position is responsible for overseeing and executing quality assurance and control (QAQC) processes throughout the lifecycle of data center construction projects, ensuring that all work meets AWS's high standards for quality, safety, and performance.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.



Key job responsibilities
1. Lead the implementation of QAQC processes throughout data center construction projects, from pre-design to turnover phases and beyond.

2. Review design documents and provide feedback on constructability, maintainability, and quality assurance measures.

3. Develop, review, and maintain quality control plans, factory/field inspection checklists, and relevant documentation.

4. Coordinate with third-party Quality Control Agents/Vendors (QCA) to ensure comprehensive QAQC.

5. Facilitate regular QC meetings with stakeholders to review and address quality-related issues.

6. Identify, document, and track quality defects or non-conformances, ensuring timely resolution.

7. Conduct final quality reviews and walkthroughs with key stakeholders prior to project handover.

8. Facilitate knowledge transfer to end customers on QAQC processes and lessons learned.

9. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing quality data and proposing process enhancements.

10. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Construction Management, Commissioning, and Data Center Engineering Operations to ensure seamless project execution.

11. Stay current with industry best practices and AWS-specific quality standards, incorporating them into quality control processes.

12. Willingness to travel up to 75% of the time to various manufacturer and project sites across North and South America

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#DCCD_AMER

- 4+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, SharePoint, and PowerPoint)
- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment

title: Systems Engineer, Controls Fleet, DC Capacity Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Are you experienced in managing IT systems with a passion for building highly-available infrastructure at massive scale? Join us in driving cloud innovation and automation, deploying mission-critical systems that power global operations.

AWS Infrastructure Services designs, delivers, and operates the global infrastructure that keeps AWS running. We manage the critical data center components — from servers and networking to power and cooling — that ensure continuous service for our customers. Within this organization, the Controls Fleet team builds and supports critical infrastructure services that power the world's premier e-commerce and cloud computing environments.

We are seeking a passionate and motivated Systems Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll deploy infrastructure, develop automation tools, and manage large-scale environments supporting data center operations. Strong communication skills, project management aptitude, and the ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders are essential to success in this role.
