title: Benefits Manager, Global Retirement and Investments Team (GRIT)
descriptionHtml:
​​Amazon's Global Retirement & Investments team is looking for a Benefits Manager to oversee the end-to-end management of retirement benefits across multiple international jurisdictions. You will own the design, governance, operational management, and continuous improvement of pension and retirement schemes that serve many thousands of Amazon employees, partnering with trustees, providers, investment advisors, payroll, HR, finance, legal, and benefits teams to ensure these programs run smoothly and deliver a strong employee experience. You will also develop and maintain risk management frameworks that protect plan integrity, monitor regulatory developments across your assigned jurisdictions, and drive operational excellence through data-driven reporting and process improvement. This high-impact role combines strategic benefits management with hands-on oversight, sitting at the intersection of employee experience, ongoing management, compliance, and corporate and plan governance.​

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee the end-to-end administration and governance of retirement programs across assigned markets (e.g., UK pension schemes), partnering with trustees, investment advisors, and third-party administrators to deliver well-run plans and a positive member experience.
- Lead investment oversight for your portfolio — fund-lineup monitoring, performance review against benchmarks, and preparation of investment-governance materials.
- Lead vendor reviews, RFPs, and plan-design benchmarking; manage plan and vendor costs against budget, delivering savings through fee negotiation and confirming value for money.
- Monitor regulatory developments from local pension authorities (e.g., The Pensions Regulator), conduct compliance assessments (e.g., UK auto-enrolment), and manage cyclical governance activities to keep programs compliant.
- Coordinate with payroll, HR, finance, legal, compliance, and benefits teams to ensure seamless data flows, accurate reporting, and timely issue resolution.
- Own member-facing retirement content and communications — deliver annual campaigns and drive participation against enrollment and satisfaction targets; build data-driven dashboards and papers for governance committees and leadership reviews.
- Support expansion into new international markets, and contribute to broader Global Retirement & Investments initiatives and cross-country governance standards.

A day in the life
​​Your day might begin by reviewing retirement program operations across your assigned markets — checking enrollment data, contribution accuracy, and flagging any issues for resolution with payroll or your third-party administrators. Mid-morning, you could be joining a call with trustees or investment advisors to discuss plan governance or upcoming regulatory changes in one of your jurisdictions. After lunch, you might shift to analyzing plan performance data and updating dashboards that track operational health and risk indicators, before connecting with HR and benefits colleagues on employee queries or upcoming compliance cycles. No two days are the same — you will move between hands-on operational oversight, stakeholder collaboration, and longer-term strategic work like process improvements or supporting the expansion of retirement programs into new international markets.​

About the team
Sitting within Amazon's broader Benefits organization, the Global Retirement & Investments team is a collaborative group of retirement and benefits professionals committed to delivering exceptional employee experiences through well-designed, well-run pension and retirement benefits. Our vision is to build scalable, compliant retirement programs that serve Amazon employees across multiple countries and adapt to evolving regulatory landscapes. We work across geographies and business units — partnering with HR, benefits, compensation, technology, payroll, and operations teams — to ensure our programs remain employee-focused, operationally sound, and compliant. We're excited to welcome someone who shares our commitment to excellence and understands the importance of protecting our employees' retirement security.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field
- Experience managing pension or retirement benefits programs, including scheme administration, governance, design, and vendors.
- ​​Knowledge of pension or retirement plan frameworks in at least one major market (e.g., UK auto-enrolment, defined contribution/defined benefit structures)
- Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders such as trustees, advisors, payroll, and HR teams
- Experience managing concurrent workstreams such as implementations, vendor transitions, and regulatory projects, managing competing deadlines, dependencies, and stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

- ​​Professional pension or benefits certification (e.g., PMI, IIPM, CFA, or local equivalent)​
- ​​Experience with a variety of retirement plan structures across different markets (e.g., UK master trusts, defined benefit schemes, or equivalent international programs)​
- Managing and influencing senior stakeholders, including trustee boards.
- Experience building or improving operational processes, reporting frameworks, or benefits program governance
- Familiarity with risk management principles as applied to pension or benefits programs
- Experience working across multiple countries or jurisdictions on retirement or benefits programs
- Comfort with data visualization tools or analytics platforms for operational reporting; interpreting benefit data and applying critical judgment skills to inform design, operational and governance decisions.

title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Tech - Security and Growth , AWS Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to decide where a fast-growing business places its next marketing bet — and prove whether it paid off? Enterprise security is one of the fastest-growing areas at Amazon Web Services (AWS), and it is a place where we form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and learn quickly what works and what does not. In this role you own the analysis behind those decisions: you measure how our marketing initiatives perform, diagnose which ones are moving the business, and recommend where we should invest to get the greatest return.

You pull together signals from customer research, campaign and web data, and product usage to build a data-based view of what is working, and then partner with product management, finance, go-to-market, and sales teams to pressure-test that view and turn it into a recommendation: where to double down, where to stop, what to test next, and what net-new initiatives we should design and launch. You move between deep analysis and initiative design, turning data and customer insight into a point of view that shapes how we grow. If you thrive at the intersection of marketing, data, and technology and want to shape how AWS grows its security business, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Partner with product management and go-to-market teams to develop portfolio-level strategy and guide prioritization of marketing investment across the security and observability portfolio.

Measure how marketing initiatives perform, and diagnose which ones are driving pipeline, awareness, and revenue.

Analyze and synthesize data from multiple sources, including direct customer feedback, to identify what is working, where to invest for the greatest return, and where to stop.

Design experiments and measurement plans that test marketing hypotheses, and validate those hypotheses through customer research and direct customer engagement.

Partner with our technical PMMs to turn your insights into positioning and messaging that clearly articulates the value of the portfolio to customers and helps drive demand.

Partner with engineering, finance, go-to-market, and sales teams to build a shared view of what is working and what is not, and translate it into growth plans and recommendations for leaders.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 5+ years of direct experience working with customers on cloud technology adoption OR 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud architectures in technical domains
- Demonstrated experience creating technical content and delivering technical presentations to diverse audiences

- MBA, or Master's degree
- Experience developing go-to-market strategies for technical products
- Track record of creating compelling technical demonstrations and reference architectures
- Strong data analysis skills with ability to synthesize insights from multiple source
- Experience presenting to executive-level audiences and industry analysts

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Finance Operations, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to support the Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership team at Amazon. We’re looking for someone who can take lead in understanding complex FinOps processes and identify the full range of risks related to processes, regulatory compliance, organization, policy, and technology. This individual will ensure FinOps processes stay ahead of risks associated with process design, internal control effectiveness, computer system integration, and other relevant areas.
As a Senior Risk Manager on the FORGE team, you won't just find problems, you'll architect solutions. You will lead high-impact audits and risk programs across Finance Operations (FinOps), with a primary focus on Global Real Estate & Facilities. Your work will directly strengthen the control environment, protect Amazon from material risk, and drive the kind of operational excellence that lets Finance scale with confidence.

In this role, you will lead and oversee projects, such as inspections, risk assessments, and advisory services, that shape process and control design to mitigate risk and drive a continuous controllership culture. Responsibilities will also include preparation of findings and engagement with stakeholders to complete action items. Your subject matter expertise is critical to develop strong working knowledge of processes, current initiatives, and organizational changes.

This role requires strong leadership skills to influence others and/or self-serve in order to achieve critical inspection objectives. You will be expected to identify risks in our processes and work with the appropriate owners to mitigate risks. You will need to dive deep to understand Amazon’s disparate and complex processes and related applications and work through ambiguity to deliver results.

Key job responsibilities
Successful candidates must be eager to dive deep into processes and have a proven record of delivering meaningful risks and recommendations to the business. The candidate should have strong auditing skills, problem solving skills, systems and process knowledge, and a passion for customer service. Specific core responsibilities are below:
• Perform risk assessments of the organization
• Perform end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, and reporting
• Evaluate design and effectiveness of FinOps controls
• Evaluate policy and process exceptions
• Prepare clear, compelling audit reports, executive narratives, and leadership-ready communications. Present findings, recommendations, and risk trade-offs to senior leaders (Director and above) with precision and confidence
• Provide training that improves and raises the bar on controllership with respect to policies and other requirements
• Support ad hoc inspections, deep dives, and reviews across broader FinOps and upstream business processes as new risks emerge or business needs evolve
• Provide strategic perspective on risk-related business and technology decisions. Help stakeholders see around corners, prioritize the right mitigation investments, and avoid building risk into new processes

A day in the life
• Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits and risk assessments across FinOps processes.
• Own end-to-end lifecycle of high-impact, cross-functional risk programs.
• Identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive sustainable remediation plans.
• Define project objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics.
• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize risk initiatives, influence decisions, and drive execution.
• Develop data-driven audit reports and executive communications presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
• Influence stakeholders to implement scalable, automated controls and eliminate recurring risks.
• Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection and audit efficiency.

About the team
Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)’s mission is to improve controllership across Finance Operations (FinOps) by identifying risks, protecting assets, designing to-be controls, testing existing controls, and as appropriate, assisting process owners with risk mitigation or remediation. In addition, FORGE collaborates with teams within and beyond FinOps on risk assessments, compliance, corporate social responsibility, regulatory, and governance matters. FORGE also serves as FinOps's program manager for the global external audit, provides controllership support for non-integrated subsidiaries, and is the contact for FinOps owned Internal Audit findings.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or equivalent
- Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
- Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
- Experience in relevant finance roles, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

title: Software Development Engineer - 2027
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE-I, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

Key job responsibilities
- Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.

- Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well-defined, solvable components before implementation.

- Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed-systems scope varying by team.

- Conduct code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.

- Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.

- Use GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.

- Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.

- Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.

- Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

Basic qualifications

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields
- Experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript
- Experience with data structure implementation, basic algorithm development, and/or object-oriented design principles

Preferred qualifications

- Experience from previous technical internship(s) or demonstrated project experience
- Experience with one or more of the following: Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), Database systems (SQL and NoSQL), Contributing to open-source projects, Version control systems, Debugging and troubleshooting complex systems
- Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies quickly
- Demonstrated ownership and initiative in seeing work through from design to operation
- Basic understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC)
- Strong problem decomposition, problem-solving, and analytical skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Front End Engineer  II, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a global e-commerce experience for Internet Service Provider (ISP) customers, and we need a Front End Engineer II to help us do it. You will work with React and Next.js to design, build, and ship features that serve customers worldwide. Many of these experiences are built from zero-to-one, so you will regularly move from ambiguous problem to working product. You will own the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with product, marketing, business, and backend engineering partners to deliver accessible, performant interfaces. If you enjoy working with AI-driven development workflows, picking up new frameworks quickly, and turning complex requirements into clean user experiences, this is the role for you.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build front-end features for the Amazon Leo e-commerce platform using React and Next.js, taking projects from concept through deployment and ongoing operation.
- Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, marketing, and backend commerce service teams to translate customer and business needs into accessible, scalable solutions that work across devices and browsers.
- Leverage agentic development workflows and generative AI tools to accelerate feature delivery, and identify opportunities to improve infrastructure using AWS native services.
- Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates while coaching others on front-end best practices, UI design patterns, and maintainable coding standards.
- Write clear documentation for your team's software and train new team members on how it is constructed, tested, and operated.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a pull request from a teammate, suggesting improvements to a React component's accessibility and performance. After standup, you pick up a new feature that doesn't have a clear precedent yet, sketching out an approach with your product manager before writing code. In the afternoon, you pair with a designer to refine interaction details for an upcoming launch, then dig into an operational metric that looks off, tracing it to a rendering edge case you fix before it reaches customers.

About the team
We are part of the Leo Commerce engineering organization at Amazon, building the e-commerce experience for a global ISP customer base. Our team works closely with backend commerce services, product, marketing, and business partners to launch new experiences from scratch. We are scaling the team and investing in AI-based development and operational workflows to meet the growing needs of our customers. If you are looking for a place where you can grow your expertise by tackling new problems regularly alongside an inclusive group of engineers, we would be glad to have you.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience
- 1+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
- Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
- Experience with common front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, and Node

Amazon is looking for a talented, proactive and customer-obsessed professional to drive the development of the Beauty category across Europe, where the company is placing high focus.

The role can be based in Paris, London, Munich, Madrid or Milan, and will involve working in a very international environment with the equivalent teams in other countries.

* Define the vision and business strategy for the category, including North Star metrics and KPI’s

* Be an ambassador and develop a thorough understanding of the industry, macro trends and future trajectory

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager (Indirect), Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world's largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Strategic Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join our team. This role is uniquely positioned at the nexus of business units across Amazon, and offers singular vision into a broad spectrum of cross-company initiatives and strategies on a global scale. Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decisionmaking rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team. Successful candidates must work well in a fast-paced and often ambiguous arena, and will be rewarded by working alongside highly collaborative and entrepreneurial colleagues in an environment that feels much more "startup" than "big company". Spend categories under management include indirect categories such as Logistics, Technology, such as Software, Hardware, Data Purchase, Telecommunication, Cybersecurity, among others. If you are an experienced sourcing professional with a passion for serving customers and for driving change and impact on a global scale, then we would love to talk with you.

Key job responsibilities
- Owning one or more complex (sub-)categories across multiple business units and/or regions, developing and executing (sub-)category strategies
- Developing global sourcing strategies to deliver against business objectives for internal clients, and achieving sustainable relationships with suppliers.
- Managing categories in markets with limited competition and limited pricing transparency, proactively identifying and mitigating supplier, commercial, and ESG risk.
- Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench-marking analysis.
- Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities, including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
- Leading transformational sourcing projects with complex, global scope, coordinating work across team members and regions.
- Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership, and value creation beyond cost savings.
- Presenting sourcing strategies, recommendations, and decisions to senior leaders up to three levels above you.
- Contributing inputs to annual and long-range operating plans (OP1, OP2, and three-year forecast).
- Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon's global policies.
- Preparing and holding business reviews with stakeholders to review vendor performance, future opportunities, and/or challenges.
- Mentoring and sharing best practices with sourcing peers across the global team.


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you're on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You'll close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you'll balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.





About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate & Facilities. We're a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. You'll be joining a team where your work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in an indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- 2+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in categories such as logistics, IT, professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a non-mandated, indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience owning complex sourcing categories across multiple business units and/or regions
- Experience managing categories in markets with limited competition or limited pricing transparency, including proactive supplier risk management
- Experience leading transformational or cross-regional sourcing initiatives with global scope
- Experience advising and presenting sourcing strategy to senior executives and influencing C-level vendor relationships
- Experience contributing to annual or long-range operating plans
- Experience mentoring peers or coordinating sourcing work across a distributed team

title: Senior Controls System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking Controls Systems Engineer to work on the design, programming, commissioning, and sustained operation of controls and automation systems across our manufacturing environment. This is a technical, individual-contributor role: you will architect and program PLC systems, build SCADA/HMI applications, integrate industrial robots and automation cells, and serve as the technical authority for controls integration across the MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA layers.

Working in a fast-paced manufacturing setting, you will operate with high autonomy and a strong bias for action—diving deep into PLC programming, SCADA system design, and controls architecture while ensuring daily production reliability, safety, and performance. Your scope spans pilot operations through high-volume production across diverse processes and lines. You thrive on the practical challenges of the factory floor—troubleshooting live equipment, improving cycle time and uptime, and turning a pilot line into a repeatable, high-yield production system.

Key job responsibilities
Controls Design & Development
- Design and program PLC architecture (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell Studio 5000/ControlLogix), define programming standards, and develop controls design specifications for a scalable framework spanning pilot through high-volume production.
- Enforce controls standards (hardware, software, networking); review and validate that system integrators and vendors deliver in strict compliance.
- Design, deploy, and maintain the SCADA/HMI layer (e.g., Ignition, FactoryTalk, WinCC), providing real-time visibility into line performance, alarms, and production data.
- Implement automation and robot integration (e.g., Fanuc, KUKA, ABB) across assembly and automation cells, ensuring standardized programming, safety compliance, and maintainability.
- Develop functional safety designs (SafetyPLC, safety-rated networks) and apply equipment safety standards for all automated systems, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and Amazon safety requirements.

MES & Systems Integration
- Implement MES integration at the controls layer, bridging MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA systems to ensure seamless data flow from the shop floor to enterprise systems.
- Partner with the Factory Software team on system architecture, data models, and integration—defining clear interface boundaries and supporting coordinated deployment.
- Build traceability, genealogy, and quality data capture at the controls layer to support analytics, yield improvement, and regulatory compliance.
- Apply standards for connectivity protocols (OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET), data historians, and reporting infrastructure that enable data-driven decision making.

Line Deployment, Commissioning & Ramp
- Own the controls engineering scope for line deployment: design review, vendor coordination, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and ramp to high-volume production.
- Coordinate system integrator relationships: define specifications, conduct design reviews, verify adherence to controls standards, and drive issue resolution.
- Lead troubleshooting, optimization, cycle-time improvement, and reliability growth through production ramp to steady-state operations.
- Collaborate with Operations, Process Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure controls solutions meet operational and production requirements.
- Drive root cause analysis on system failures; implement countermeasures and preventive mechanisms to improve reliability and uptime (MTTR/MTBF).
- Develop commissioning playbooks, validation protocols, and startup checklists that enable repeatable, rapid line launches.

Technical Excellence & Sustained Operations
- Support 24/7 production through on-call participation and escalation, diving deep on the factory floor to restore and improve automated systems.
- Create and maintain knowledge management resources, troubleshooting databases, and continuous-improvement mechanisms for controls reliability.
- Own technical documentation for electrical and control systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience with advanced automation controls systems
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 4+ years of hands-on experience in controls engineering, industrial automation, or related disciplines.
- Experience designing and programming PLC architecture (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell Studio 5000/ControlLogix).
- Experience with SCADA/HMI system design, deployment, and management (e.g., Ignition, FactoryTalk, WinCC).
- Experience coordinating with system integrators and verifying vendor compliance with controls standards.
- Working knowledge of MES architecture and integration with ERP, WMS, QMS, and shop-floor systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale
- 6+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
- Experience with industrial robotics
- Experience in automotive, aerospace, battery/energy, or other advanced production environments at scale
- Experience building controls standards and architecture from scratch for a new line or organization
- Knowledge of industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, OPC-UA), OT cybersecurity, IT/OT convergence, data historians, and production analytics
- Experience in high-mix or evolving product environments where controls systems must adapt to frequent design changes
- Familiarity with safety system design (SafetyPLC, safety-rated networks) and compliance with relevant standards (IEC 62443, NFPA 79, ISO 13849)
- Master’s degree in Engineering
- Track record of delivering results in fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environments with strong ownership and bias for action

title: Supply Chain Lead, Amazon Key
descriptionHtml:
As a Supply Chain Lead within the Smart TDR (STDR) Program, you will own end-to-end supply chain planning and execution for Amazon's Smart Trailer Dock and Retrieval technology deployment across the NA fulfillment network. You will have a holistic view of material procurement, vendor operations, and installation logistics across NASC, DC, and CH networks — and be integral in driving large-scale initiatives in material cost optimization, vendor management, PO reconciliation, and installation capacity planning. With a deployment target spanning thousands of doors across multiple networks and fiscal years, there will rarely be a perfect solution — it will be up to you to make data-driven decisions and manage complex vendor and cross-functional stakeholder relationships while planning and executing within a rapidly evolving program.

The Supply Chain Lead will work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment — coordinating across hardware engineering, installation vendors, field operations, finance, and procurement teams — and communicate business conditions and program decisions effectively across multiple levels, from vendor field technicians to Amazon Directors and VPs. In this role, you will seek out supply chain gaps, dive deep into PO and invoice data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that influence program-level financial outcomes. This role blends short-term execution (weekly install schedules, PO tracking, vendor invoicing) with long-term strategic planning (cost-per-door optimization, vendor negotiation strategy, surplus disposition), requiring quick decision-making with incomplete data while also thinking big about the network-wide deployment roadmap. The end goal is to answer the question: how do we deploy STDR technology across Amazon's network faster, at lower cost per door, with zero material waste, and without impacting site operations.



Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities
Demonstrate strong customer focus and ownership of program-level supply chain outcomes
Own end-to-end material planning: demand forecasting against install targets, PO management, vendor coordination, and surplus reconciliation
Drive cross-network PO visibility and reconciliation across NASC, DC, CH, and Pilot programs — ensuring single source of truth for spend and utilization
Lead vendor negotiations (panel sub-vendors, contract manufacturers, GDO suppliers) to optimize cost, manage surplus, and maintain strategic relationships
Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate supply chain defects — including PO deduplication, invoicing gaps, and untracked cross-network procurement
Execute thorough root cause analysis on cost variances and deliver data-backed recommendations to senior leadership
Own programmatic execution at both detailed (weekly PO tracking, invoice validation) and strategic levels (cost-per-door targets, multi-year material strategy)
Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity across hardware, operations, finance, and procurement
Data mine by leveraging SQL/Python to drive key business decisions on material utilization, surplus disposition, and cost optimization
Basic Qualifications
5+ years of program or project management experience
5+ years of supply chain experience, preferably in hardware deployment, construction, or technology installation programs
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience managing vendor relationships and purchase order lifecycles at scale

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- 2+ years of supply chain experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion

- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

title: Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon builds fast—and behind every new Fulfillment Center, Sortation Center, Delivery Station, and capital investment is a critical question: **Are we buying the right solution at the right price?** We're looking for a **Cost & Value Engineering Manager** to partner with Amazon's North America Design & Construction stakeholders, delivering construction cost engineering and value engineering services that optimize design, validate costs, and inform capital investment decisions across Amazon's infrastructure network.

This role is high-impact, high-variety, and technically demanding. You'll develop bottom-up cost estimates, should-cost models, and Value Engineering analyses across a diverse portfolio of building types, material handling equipment (MHE), automation, and capital projects. From multi-site retrofit programs to complex, one-off initiatives, you'll evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and produce defensible cost models that shape sourcing, design, and investment decisions. Working from early concepts through bid-ready construction documents, you'll apply technical expertise to balance cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements.

As part of Amazon's Global Procurement Organization within the Sourcing Excellence pillar, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, and Category teams to ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price. You'll also collaborate with AI and Market Intelligence Solutions, leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, develop scalable cost intelligence, and advance next-generation automation that expands the reach and impact of Cost & Value Engineering across Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
Deliver independent, bottom-up cost estimates for construction, equipment, and capital investment projects across Amazon's global portfolio, spanning retrofit, expansion, new-build, automation, and equipment deployment initiatives.
Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through supplier selection and implementation, adapting methodologies and analytical depth to available project information and design maturity.
Build and maintain scalable estimating models and templates while developing detailed bottom-up cost models for complex, site-specific initiatives requiring advanced analytical judgment.
Perform should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to evaluate design alternatives, optimize specifications, identify cost drivers, and ensure Amazon is buying the right solution at the right price.
Leverage AI-powered tools to automate data gathering, cost modeling, benchmarking, and pattern recognition while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.
Drive the development of scalable AI-enabled cost intelligence solutions by curating project and market data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine analytical activities.
Partner with Engineering, Design, Construction, Procurement, Category Management, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence sourcing and investment decisions.
Peer review cost models, estimates, and Value Engineering recommendations to ensure technical rigor, consistency, and alignment with current market conditions and best practices.

About the team
The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right construction solutions, equipment, and technologies by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what construction projects, equipment, and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across construction, material handling equipment, automation, and other strategic sourcing categories, and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Process Engineer, NA SSD Network, Sub Same Day Process Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building the next generation software, hardware, and processes that will run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many millions of units of inventory, and ensure that customers get what they want faster than ever. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

We are constantly innovating in the ways we are automating and accelerating the delivery of products and packages which includes building custom hardware and applying robotics, autonomy, supply chain optimization, machine learning, manipulation, image processing, and real-time data processing using distributed systems.

Sub Same Day (SSD) Engineering is looking for a Senior Process Engineer with a strong delivery record and proven project management experience to own strategic and tactical, cross-functional operations and technology projects associated with (SSD) facilities.

As a Process Engineer for Amazon, you will work with some of the most talented engineers in the design, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems around the globe.

You will lead initiatives and complex cross-functional projects or programs that focus on the building of new, the alteration of existing, and the closing of end-of-life material handling and technology systems. As a working leader, you are able to take the lead on the implementation and delivery of large system designs and advanced technology in ambiguous and complex problem spaces.

You integrate systems for safety, security, stability, and efficiency. You participate in the full system development life cycle, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and solution quality needs.

You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open collaborative environment. Amazon’s culture encourages innovation and expects engineers to take a high-level of ownership in solving complex problems.

If you are a leader with enhanced focus on Quality, strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills, an ability to influence business and technical leaders in a dynamic environment with the desire to contribute to Amazon's next generation fulfillment technology, this opportunity is for you.

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deploy systems that benefit millions of customers.

The ideal candidate will draw upon exemplary leadership skills, program and project management, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

The candidate should be open to new tasks, innovative, creative, self-directed and a great team player. Candidate should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and development teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

Travel expected between 30% and 50%.


Key job responsibilities

As a Process Engineer, you will work across organizations to find solutions for complex problems, innovating on behalf of our customers. Your experience in conducting root cause analysis, will help in implementation of long-term solutions. You will be traveling (upto 50%) to sites to ensure practical outcomes match theoretical ones.

descriptionHtml:
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Senior Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges and shaping their technology strategy? At Amazon, we're looking for a Solutions Architect who thrives at the intersection of business and technology. In this role, you'll partner directly with customers to design and deliver cloud-based solutions that address real business needs — from reducing costs and mitigating risk to launching new products and transforming legacy platforms. You'll bring both technical depth and practical judgment to every engagement, working to understand each customer's unique context and crafting architectures that are secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-optimized. If you're a curious, collaborative problem-solver who wants to make a measurable impact on how organizations build for the future, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end AI/ML solutions by combining business understanding with deep technical expertise across the ML lifecycle, model training and fine-tuning, inference, and MLOps, ensuring architectures are extensible, secure, reliable, and cost-optimized while balancing short-term needs with long-term business outcomes. Guide customers on generative AI, foundation models, and classical ML, and help them select the right approach (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, or custom model training) for their use case.

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer leadership, building relationships, understanding their data and technology challenges and industry context, and guiding their AI strategy through considered options and clear articulation of trade-offs, risks, and responsible-AI considerations such as governance, bias, security, and cost.

- Lead technical AI/ML solution discussions with customer teams, diving into model selection, data pipelines, training and inference architecture, evaluation, and best practices — proactively identifying high-risk or overly complex approaches (e.g., unnecessary model training, unscalable inference patterns) and engaging the right specialist and service-team resources when needed.

- Develop and deliver technical AI/ML content such as workshops, hands-on labs, presentations, blog posts, and reference architectures that educate customers on generative AI and ML strategy and best practices, applying your depth of experience to create reusable, high-quality artifacts that accelerate adoption.

- Collaborate with internal teams across sales, engineering, professional services, science, and product groups to accelerate AI/ML solution adoption, gather customer feedback on models and services, and translate it into clear requirements that improve the AI/ML product portfolio.

Your morning might start with a deep-dive architecture review alongside a customer's engineering team, working through design decisions for a cloud migration or a new application platform. After lunch, you could be whiteboarding a proof of concept that demonstrates how to simplify a complex workflow, then jumping into a call with product engineers to share feedback you've gathered from recent customer engagements. You'll regularly create and refine technical content, mentor fellow architects, and contribute to patterns that help the broader team deliver better solutions.

The Energy & Water team is looking for a Senior Manager in Public Affairs, to lead how we engage in that conversation.

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to water: you understand industry trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage with the right internal and external stakeholders, and translate that understanding into the right messaging, You are the expert who shows up, engages authentically with community members, organizations, public officials, builds lasting relationships , and contributes to an informed, transparent, and productive public dialogue. Public Representation:
Represent Water in public and community settings — open houses, boot camps, hearings, and stakeholder forums— building trusted relationships with officials, regulators, and community stakeholders.

Engage with regulatory bodies, agency staff, elected officials, and policy stakeholders alongside our Public Policy and Legal teams, representing the Water perspective accurately and with sound judgment.

Field live questions about water use, wastewater — including detailed questions from engaged community members and advocacy groups

Engage authentically on water topics in real time — accurately representing Amazon's approach and genuinely addressing community questions

In this role you bring a public affairs lens to water: you understand industry and sector trends and the regulatory landscape, you engage credibly with regulatory bodies and policy audiences, and you translate that understanding into the right messaging, delivered in the right tone, to the right stakeholders.

Cross-Functional & Team Support

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Associate Corporate Counsel, Health & Safety
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Operations Legal Department to provide strategic legal counsel on workplace health and safety matters across our European operations. You'll advise business leaders on compliance with European safety regulations and navigate regulatory interactions. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-moving, multi-jurisdictional regulatory environment and make a tangible impact on employee safety.

Our lawyers value working alongside and in person with their business clients and local legal teams to solve a constant flow of novel challenges in a growing and exciting business. This position can be based in either our offices in Luxembourg or Madrid. Some regional and international travel will be required.

Key job responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day legal counsel to operations and safety teams on workplace safety regulatory compliance
- Drive the legal response to workplace incidents and escalations, partnering with senior and country-specific counsel as needed
- Assist in managing regulatory interactions, including inspections, investigations, and information requests from national authorities
- Monitor changes in workplace health and safety regulations across jurisdictions and advise on necessary business adaptations
- Support the development and improvement of health and safety compliance policies, procedures, and training materials
- Work cross-functionally with technology teams to implement automated compliance solutions
- Help build and maintain productive relationships with regulatory agencies across Europe

A day in the life
You'll provide real-time advice to operations and safety partners on practical compliance questions, from interpreting local regulations to coordinating the legal responses to regulatory interactions. Expect a mix of independent research, collaborative policy work, and real-time counseling. The work is fast-paced, intellectually challenging, and directly connected to employee safety.

About the team
We are part of Amazon's Worldwide Operations Legal group, supporting regulatory and safety compliance across Europe. Our team works closely with stakeholders to develop industry-leading compliance and safety solutions. Safety is a top priority for Amazon's leadership, giving our work significant visibility at senior levels.

Basic qualifications

- License to practice law in Europe, US or other common law jurisdiction
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- A minimum of 2+ years post-qualification legal experience.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Workplace Safety Law
- Experience in Regulatory Law
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines

title: Technicien en maintenance d’équipements électriques ou mécaniques/Electrical or Mechanical Equipment Maintenance Technician, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Vous aimez résoudre des problèmes concrets, mettre la main à la pâte et assurer le bon fonctionnement d'équipements essentiels ? Rejoignez l'équipe AWS chargée de maintenir des installations critiques, fiables et sécuritaires, 24/7.

En tant que Technicien en maintenance d’équipements électriques ou mécaniques, Installations critiques, électro mécanique, instrumentation vous réaliserez l'entretien préventif, le dépannage et l'amélioration continue d'équipements électriques et mécaniques. Votre travail contribuera directement à la fiabilité des services utilisés par des millions de clients AWS à travers le monde.

Ce poste s'adresse aux personnes ayant une expérience en électricité, électro mécanique, en mécanique, bâtiments, en maintenance industrielle, CVAC, énergie, manufacture ou services publics.

Si vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement technique stimulant, nous vous invitons à postuler.

**************************************

Do you enjoy solving real-world problems, working hands-on, and keeping essential equipment running? Join the AWS team responsible for maintaining critical facilities that are reliable and safe in our data centers 24/7.

As an Electrical or Mechanical Equipment Maintenance Technician, Electro Mechanic, Instrumentation Technician, or critical building mechanics Technician, you will perform preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement on electrical and mechanical equipment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability of services used by millions of AWS customers worldwide.

This role is ideal for individuals with experience in electrical or mechanical fields, buildings,mechanical systems, industrial maintenance, HVAC, energy, manufacturing, or utilities. If you want to grow in a stimulating technical environment, we encourage you to apply.

About the team
À propos d'AWS
Expériences diversifiées
AWS valorise les expériences diversifiées. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les qualifications et compétences énumérées dans la description de poste, nous encourageons les candidats à postuler. Si votre carrière ne fait que commencer, n'a pas suivi un parcours traditionnel ou comprend des expériences alternatives, ne laissez pas cela vous empêcher de postuler.

Pourquoi AWS ?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) est la plateforme infonuagique la plus complète et la plus largement adoptée au monde. Nous avons été les pionniers de l'infonuagique et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover - c'est pourquoi les clients, des entreprises en démarrage les plus réussies aux entreprises du classement Fortune 500, font confiance à notre solide gamme de produits et de services pour alimenter leurs activités.

Mentorat et croissance de carrière
nous montons constamment la barre de notre performance dans notre quête pour devenir le meilleur employeur au monde. C'est pourquoi vous trouverez ici d'innombrables ressources de partage des connaissances, de mentorat et d'autres ressources pour faire progresser votre carrière, afin de vous aider à vous développer en tant que professionnel plus polyvalent.

Équilibre travail-vie personnelle
nous valorisons l'harmonie entre le travail et la vie personnelle. Le succès au travail ne doit jamais se faire au détriment des sacrifices à la maison, c'est pourquoi des horaires de travail flexibles et des arrangements font partie intégrante de notre culture. Lorsque nous nous sentons soutenus au travail et à la maison, il n'y a rien que nous ne puissions accomplir dans le nuage.

//

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth
we’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
we value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 2 ans ou plus d'expérience en maintenance, exploitation ou dépannage d'équipements électriques ou mécaniques.
- Expérience dans au moins un des domaines suivants : bâtiments commerciaux ou industriels, CVAC, plomberie, électricité, manufacture, énergie, transport, services publics ou environnement critique.
- Capacité à lire et interpréter des procédures, schémas et manuels techniques.
- Volonté de participer à des rotations de quart, interventions d'urgence ou système de garde selon les besoins.
- ****************************************************************************************
- 2+ years of experience in maintenance, operations, or troubleshooting of electrical or mechanical equipment.
- Experience in at least one of the following areas: commercial or industrial buildings, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, manufacturing, energy, transportation, utilities, or critical environments.
- Ability to read and interpret procedures, schematics, and technical manuals.
- Willingness to participate in shift rotations, emergency interventions, or on-call systems as required.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Site leader , Super Stores Operations
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Site Leader to manage Super Stores operations in the São Paulo. This role is responsible for end-to-end operational performance under the roof — from inbound transfer receipt from feeder FCs through processing, sortation, and dispatch to last mile — ensuring delivery promises of 3 hours or less are consistently met. The Site Leader will own safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance across multiple dispatch cycles daily, driving a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities
- Safety & Compliance: Own site safety culture, drive zero-incident mindset, ensure compliance with all local labor laws and Amazon safety standards;
- Operational Performance: Manage inbound receipt, processing, sortation, and dispatch operations across 5+ daily dispatch cycles, ensuring on-time readiness (OTR)
- People Leadership: Lead, develop, and engage a team of blue badges and associates; own hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, and shift scheduling
- Cost & Productivity: Drive labor efficiency targets (throughput per hour, bags/minute), manage headcount planning, overtime utilization, and variable cost per package; identify and implement productivity improvement initiatives
- Quality & Defect Management: Own package handling quality, minimize mis-sorts, mis-routes, and damage rates; drive root cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions for defects impacting delivery success
- Stakeholder Coordination: Partner with Transportation, Last Mile, and upstream FC teams to manage inbound flow, dispatch readiness, and route planning; escalate systemic issues with clear - Metrics & Reporting: Monitor real-time operational dashboards, track KPIs (OTR, throughput, labor utilization, defect rates), and provide daily/weekly performance narratives to senior leadership

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience in managing teams
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Experience in a logistics/operations environment
- Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
- Experience in people management
