- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques

title: Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, Global ISV Partner Marketing
descriptionHtml:
This highly visible role will own the Global Partner Marketing Strategy for a dedicated cohort of AWS Software & Technology partners, serving as the primary marketing owner of the partner relationship. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of B2B and partner/alliance marketing, coupled with hands-on experience owning joint marketing plans, managing partner marketing budgets, and building executive-level partner relationships. You will be the subject matter expert on your cohort — accountable for the global co-marketing initiatives with and through those partners across sales segments and geographies.
The role will build and own a joint marketing plan with each partner in the cohort, aligning partner and AWS priorities into a single global co-marketing strategy and plan that drives pipeline and revenue. You will manage the global marketing budget for your cohort partner(s) — including MDF (Market Development Funds) — allocating investment across geographies and activities to maximize pipeline return, and holding partners accountable to agreed goals. You will set the strategy centrally and steer the Geo partner marketing teams to execute regionally, ensuring local activation ladders up to the global plan.
This role requires a proven leader with the demonstrated ability to think strategically and develop compelling joint value propositions and messaging with technology partners. Working closely with partners, partner management, sales, and marketing teams, you will define the joint value narrative — identifying the priority use-cases, customer personas, and industry verticals — and ensure that value prop is consistently carried into every co-marketing motion across the cohort.
The ideal candidate will be a strong relationship manager with analytic, data-driven judgment and a proven track record of building partner marketing strategies that drive pipeline and revenue. Critically, you will lead a v-team of Geo partner marketers — in addition to influencing key stakeholders across product, field, sales, and brand — coordinating them toward your cohort's marketing goals without direct authority. The ability to communicate and influence across both technical and non-technical audiences is essential. You should be organized, comfortable with ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities, and able to manage multiple partner relationships at once. A solid understanding of the cloud landscape and software providers is critical to this role.
At AWS we prize innovation, agility and a builder mentality. The organization is purposefully flat to enable fast decision-making and we are empowered to resolve issues, deliver new ideas and optimize existing ones that serve our customers. This is an individual contributor role that is both strategic and tactical: you will own the strategy, the joint plan, and the budget for your cohort, while orchestrating a v-team and partner stakeholders to execute — leading through influence as the composer who also knows the score.
This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in an incredibly fast-growing business where you will work with some of the leading technology providers. AWS gives customers secure, scalable, global cloud infrastructure while paying only for what they use. Scaling through partners is a key part of how we help customers move to cloud services that power strategic workloads. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, a history of success owning partner marketing strategy and budgets, experience managing large ISV partner relationships, and love helping partners reach their full potential, this position might be just for you.


Key job responsibilities
Own the Global Partner Marketing Strategy for a dedicated cohort of AWS Software & Technology partners, serving as the primary marketing owner of each partner relationship across sales segments and geographies.
Build and own the joint marketing plan with each cohort partner, aligning partner and AWS priorities into a single global co-marketing agenda that drives pipeline and revenue.
Manage the global marketing budget, including MDF (Market Development Funds), for cohort partner(s): allocating investment across geographies and activities to maximize pipeline return and holding partners accountable to agreed goals.
Develop joint value propositions and messaging with partners: defining the priority use-cases, customer personas, and industry verticals, and ensuring that value prop carries consistently into every co-marketing motion.
Lead a v-team of Geo partner marketers and influence key cross-functional stakeholders across product, field, sales, and brand, coordinating them toward the cohort's marketing goals without direct authority.
Steer regional execution and measure performance, ensuring local activation ladders up to the global plan and optimizing investment against pipeline and revenue goals.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 7+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

descriptionHtml:
AWS Compliance & Security Assurance is looking for an experienced Governance Specialist to support our Global Product Compliance (GTPC) team business on a broad range of regulatory compliance matters. You will interact with AWS Security, Datacenter Engineering, AWS Services, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Legal, Tax, and other internal businesses and external stakeholders to drive operation policies and controls that provides oversight of AWS's product compliance posture. AWS is at the forefront of providing a broad set of global cloud-based services including compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, deep Machine learning, robotics, and enterprise applications, to help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale.

This is a dynamic business within Amazon.com, and one of the world's fastest growing and evolving companies, with a team of exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. GTPC is responsible for ensuring that the infrastructure equipment necessary to support the AWS services are imported/exported in a compliant manner across the multiple countries where AWS operates and will expand.



Key job responsibilities
Design and implement governance controls, SOPs, and policy frameworks governing Regulatory Operations processes — regulatory research, intelligence management, agency engagement, change monitoring, records management, and compliance auditing — ensuring each control is traceable to a defined risk or compliance requirement.

Define and execute country-level and product-level regulatory research methodology across all target markets. Establish and maintain a regulatory intelligence database with intake workflows, data quality standards, and refresh cadences that embed intelligence into hardware program decision-making.

Design engagement protocols and stakeholder maps for managing government regulatory contacts and agency relationships across all operating jurisdictions. Build and operate the process for monitoring regulatory changes; develop impact assessment frameworks quantifying risk to market access and program timelines.

Design and enforce documentation and records retention controls satisfying post-deployment audit requirements. Execute ongoing compliance audits and post-shipment surveillance obligations; develop audit checklists, sampling methodologies, and reporting templates ensuring consistent execution across markets.

Leverage compliance data and regulatory intelligence to identify emerging risks, maintain readiness dashboards, and present risk insights supporting leadership decision-making.

This position reports to the Sr. Manager for Product Compliance Operations as apart of the AWS Global Trade and Product Compliance ('GTPC') function. This person reviews regulatory change alerts, updates the intelligence database, assesses compliance risks against active hardware programs, refines governance controls based on audit findings, coordinates with government agency contacts, and ensures documentation archives remain audit-ready — maintaining continuous regulatory readiness across all operating jurisdictions.

title: Sr. Demand & S&OP Manager, PAC
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
The Power & Cooling (PAC) team is seeking a results-oriented individual with strong business judgement and experience working with internal and external stakeholders to own demand planning and the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process for Data Center Power & Cooling equipment. Our Demand & S&OP Managers are high-energy self-starters who are excited to work across functions to turn a volatile demand signal into a clean, executable plan that the rest of the supply chain can run on.
As a member of the Power and Cooling Supply Chain Management Team, this is an individual-contributor role that owns the demand signal end to end: verifying it, resolving anomalies with upstream teams, reading the patterns in it, and absorbing the volatile long-horizon work — the changes a year or more out — so the execution team does not have to. You will run the S&OP process as the organization’s orchestration layer, and act as the single point of truth for what the business actually needs, when it needs it. You do this through influence rather than authority, partnering across Design, Technical Infrastructure Program Managers (TIPMs), Global Category Managers (GCMs), and the Materials Managers who execute against your signal.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own projects through completion.


Key job responsibilities
• The Demand & S&OP Manager is an individual contributor who serves as the orchestrator of the demand signal for AWS data center Power & Cooling equipment. This role drives forecast accuracy, pattern detection, and cross-functional alignment so the execution team receives a clean, executable signal.
• Demand Planning and Forecasting — You will spearhead the development and maintenance of a rolling three-year forecast for Long Lead Equipment (LLE), collaborating with business partners to capture evolving requirements. This includes managing schedule changes, tracking design modifications, and validating net-new demand to maintain forecast accuracy, and coordinating with Design teams so equipment specifications align with construction timelines through a change-management process that achieves first-time-right implementations.
• S&OP Orchestration — You will run the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process as the organization’s nerve center, built on four pillars: demand changes and their impact, the supply position and its constraints, the inventory and storage position, and the operational patterns underneath. You will convert S&OP from a report-out forum into a true orchestration mechanism that reduces noise in the demand signal and drives cross-functional resolution.
• Pattern Detection and Signal Integrity — You will act as the gatekeeper of signal quality — distinguishing confirmed demand from speculative demand, catching anomalies and impossible date sequences before they propagate, and reading patterns across the operation so recurring issues are routed to the function that can fix them at the source.
• Risk Highlighting and Prioritization — You will serve as an early-warning system for demand-side risk, maintaining a dynamic view of where the plan and reality diverge. While Global Supply Chain Managers handle supplier negotiations, you will partner with them to highlight risk and support mitigation, and you will drive build-prioritization decisions as the key liaison to the business.
• Cross-Functional Alignment — You will align the PAC demand and S&OP cadence with the broader AWS S&OP cycle and bring Design, TIPMs, and GCMs into that rhythm, so our plan feeds — and is shaped by — the decisions made around us rather than arriving after they are set.
• Success in this role directly impacts AWS’s ability to deliver data centers on schedule, with performance measured by forecast accuracy, signal quality, and the reduction of downstream noise — rather than supplier negotiations and capacity management.

A day in the life
• Communicate ideas concisely to a wide variety of stakeholders, for purposes ranging from informative to securing approvals from executives.
• Embody a true pioneering spirit, willing to “get your hands dirty” in a start-up environment while simultaneously developing processes, automation, and delivering results.
• Clearly define data requirements and metrics, working with teams to implement the entire data flow from capture to presentation and management.
• Apply high attention to detail and a proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously.
• Continuously improve the demand and S&OP process, building the automation and standards that make it repeatable and teachable.


About the team
*Why AWS* Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
*Diverse Experiences* Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
*Work/Life Balance* We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
*Inclusive Team Culture* Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
*Mentorship and Career Growth* We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Site Operations Leader, OneMHS
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)
- Experience in Lean Management, Six Sigma and other operations engineer tools

title: Solution Architect, Vehicle Technology CoE
descriptionHtml:
AWS's Vehicle Technology Team is a global Center of Excellence covering AMER, EMEA and APJ. It helps automakers, Tier-1 suppliers and mobility companies build the next generation of vehicles on AWS. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll set the worldwide technical strategy for our three core areas: Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV), ADAS/Autonomous Driving, and E/E Architecture. You'll be the technical lead on pilot engagements with strategic customers. You'll also choose and build relationships with key technology partners, and turn new ideas into demos for the industry's biggest stages.

This role is for a hands-on technologist who can talk architecture with OEM engineering leaders in the morning and build a working prototype in the afternoon. You'll have real influence on how AWS shows up in the automotive industry.

Key job responsibilities
Technical strategy: Guide the worldwide technical strategy for Vehicle Technology across SDV, ADAS/AV and E/E Architecture, and turn industry trends into reference architectures and solution patterns.
Pilot customer engagements: Lead pilot engagements with strategic automotive customers from discovery through proof of concept, and help turn them into production pipeline.
Partner ecosystem: Choose and work closely with key automotive partners (silicon, simulation, middleware, toolchain and systems integrators) to build joint solutions.
Industry demos: Build demos for flagship events such as AWS re:Invent, CES and IAA Mobility, working with account solutions architects.
Ambassador programs: Represent AWS in strategic technology ambassador programs, such as with NVIDIA and OpenAI.
Thought leadership: Speak at conferences, write blogs and whitepapers, and give product teams feedback from the field.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. In the morning you might meet with the E/E architecture team at a European OEM to look at how a zonal compute design maps to a cloud-native development and validation toolchain. Around midday you could join a working session with a silicon or simulation partner to scope a joint reference architecture for virtual ECUs and large-scale ADAS simulation. In the afternoon you might get hands-on with a prototype for the next CES or IAA Mobility demo, working with an account solutions architect who has a customer ready to see it.


About the team
The Vehicle Technology Team is a global Center of Excellence in AWS Automotive, with members across AMER, EMEA and APJ. We help automakers, Tier-1 suppliers and mobility companies change how vehicles are designed, developed, validated and updated. Our focus areas are Software-Defined Vehicle, ADAS/Autonomous Driving and E/E Architecture.

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

title: Senior Site EHS Manager - HoH
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we prioritize health, safety, and well-being above all else. There is nothing more important. To support this priority, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Site Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for partnering with the site level operations team for your designated site in order to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and Kaizen events, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in Amazon’s processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our associates.

In this role, you must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the cross functional operations teams, and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. To do so, you must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. You will also be required to instruct and train operations leadership and site WHS professionals in company EHS policies while assisting the regional teams in incorporating our safety standards at their sites. Your experience working in safety programs and your relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge in an operations environment will be crucial. You will be responsible for developing a team of safety managers and safety professionals at your designated site. Your teams’ success will depend on your ability to create and execute leadership development plans for your larger team. You must demonstrate your ability to clearly communicate organizational direction through your team. As a senior leader in the WHS organization, you will also be responsible for judging and assessing safety talent to select appropriate bench strength for current and future business needs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Act as SME of local/regional regulations and company WHS policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
- Measure site performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
- Ensure safety record keeping and data integrity and provides Operations with accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
- Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
- Deep Dive safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
- Deep Dive trends and propose action plans to Sr. Leadership on site.
- Audit record keeping practices and Global Safety Database entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
- Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
- Manage and mentor the Safety Managers and Safety Associates in your assigned site.
- Engage the Injury Prevention Specialists (IPS) and Site Leadership to drive long-term strategic actions to achieve incident reduction.
- Perform targeted Kaizen events in partnership with the Operations teams based on the risks identified in each task (force, repetition, and awkward postures).
Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.
- Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Review for effectiveness the deployed safety tools and revise to ensure continual improvement.
- Partner with corporate and other regional field safety personnel to leverage global safety and environmental best practices into NA network standards.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- 7+ years of increasing responsibilities in people and performance management
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
- Willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends, as required to support direct reports and site needs

- Experience in a fast-paced, dynamic organization

- Prior experience in a management development training program
- Track record of effectively managing a safety operation comprising both salaried and hourly staff

title: Sr Program Manager, AI & Data, Global Corporate Communications
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Global Corporate Communications (GCC) is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the data and AI systems that GCC's teams rely on. You'll build the shared foundation beneath GCC's work: making its data usable by AI, delivering the AI systems on top of it, and connecting the work across GCC and its partners.

Today, a lot of GCC's most valuable data is scattered. Research, media coverage, agency reporting, processes, and planning documents live in different places and formats, with different access. title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization)
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Senior FDE) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you are the technical lead embedded inside a strategic customer, accountable for building, optimizing, and running the custom generative AI models at the heart of their business. You set the technical direction for model customization and optimization engagements, deciding what to build, how to measure it, and how it reaches production. You combine the technical depth of an AWS senior engineer with the urgency of a startup builder, using your judgment and ownership to deliver measurable business outcomes in quality, latency, and cost.

Senior FDEs work on the hardest problems where models meet systems: building domain foundation models, post-training frontier-scale open-weight models with reinforcement learning, and migrating large training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. They take on problems where the business problem itself is ambiguous, define the approach, and break it into workstreams others can own. They make long-term architectural trade-offs, balance customer urgency against sustainable design, and are trusted by customer engineering leadership as a technical peer. They raise the bar for the team through design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, and hiring, and they shape how AWS builds.

Key job responsibilities
Lead the technical engagement: Embed with the customer as the technical lead for their model customization and optimization program, spanning multiple workstreams. Partner with customer engineering and product leadership to frame the business problem, define success metrics and the evaluation bar, and set technical roadmap that moves from proof of value to production. Communicate trade-offs, risks, and results clearly to executives and engineers alike. Requires up to 25% travel.

Define the customization strategy: Decide the right path to the customer's quality, latency, and cost targets — prompting, distillation, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning (including RL with verifiable rewards and multi-turn agentic RL), continued pre-training, task-specific adapters, or building a domain foundation model. Own the data strategy, synthetic data generation, and evaluation methodology that make those decisions defensible, and drive them to production for patterns such as coding agents, vertical foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Architect training and inference systems at scale: Design distributed training and RL post-training systems for large dense and mixture-of-experts models using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl, and production inference architectures using engines such as SGLang and vLLM. Architect RL interaction harnesses using frameworks such as NeMo Gym and OpenEnv, defining how agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions connect to training and evaluation. Set parallelism, precision, and serving strategies that balance throughput, latency, memory, reliability, and cost per token, and ensure the designs hold up under production load.

Lead optimization on AWS AI chips: Lead migrations of training and inference workloads to AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Diagnose performance and accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, direct kernel-level optimization where it matters, and work with AWS Neuron and service teams to close capability gaps. Turn benchmark evidence into recommendations that shape customer infrastructure and capacity decisions.

descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. title: Sr. HR Specialist, AIS HRP Team, AIS HRP Team
descriptionHtml:
This role sits on the Data Center's People Foundations team, which owns the Data Center's time, pay, and people-infrastructure demand signal. The team turns diffuse requirements from across the DC network into delivered, compliant solutions by working through the central teams that own each domain (TimeHub, Workforce Solutions, Payroll, Compensation, policy, and Benefits), then operationalizing the result with the business. The team is small and specialist. It builds the standards and mechanisms the network runs on, and partners with those owner teams to make sure the data center use case is built in, not bolted on.
You own how people-infrastructure needs get gathered from the field across the network and see them through to delivery. You gather what the business actually needs across every workstream, translate it into structured requirements, and partner with the central owner teams to land real solutions, running against the prioritization criteria and roadmapping mechanisms the function sets. You are fungible by design: one week you're supporting a site launch, the next a retrofit or closure, the next carrying a time and pay requirement into the owner teams or building something net-new for how DC operations run. You go where the highest-value problem sits, and you're trusted to size it, work it, and see it through. You're based in the EU, and where the work calls for on-the-ground regional support, your focus is EMEA and APJC.
Specifically, you will support the full site lifecycle (launches, retrofits, closures, and replacements) so the people experience holds through every transition; support accurate time and pay for the DC population by bringing clear requirements to the timekeeping and payroll owner teams and helping operationalize the fixes; and take a solution proven in one market and help turn it into the standard other markets adopt, so the network solves once rather than rebuilding in parallel. This is a net-new operating model for the data centers, so you'll help stand up the mechanisms as you run them.


Key job responsibilities
• Own how the people-infrastructure demand signal gets gathered from the field across every workstream: translate needs into structured build requirements, and drive each one through to a delivered, compliant solution rather than letting it resurface as a post-launch defect.
• Support the full site lifecycle (launches, retrofits, closures, and replacements), making sure people transitions are planned before the physical work begins, not after; where on-the-ground support is needed, your focus is EMEA and APJC.
• Support accurate time and pay for the DC population: bring clear, well-structured requirements to the timekeeping and payroll owner teams and partner with them to operationalize solutions through launches and site transitions.
• Partner with the owner teams (TimeHub, Workforce Solutions, Payroll, Compensation, policy, and Benefits) as a single, reliable point of contact: bring them the data center use case early, work alongside them to land it, and track progress so requirements arrive as delivered solutions.
• Solve once, apply everywhere: take a problem worked to a solution in one market and help turn it into the standard other markets adopt, running against the mechanisms and standards the function sets.
• Surface risks in the intake-to-delivery pipeline early and work them to resolution with the owner teams, so a gap is closed before it becomes a compliance issue or business disruption.
• Flex across the team's workstreams as priorities shift, taking on the highest-value problem wherever it sits.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
- • 5+ years of HR, talent program, or program and project management experience.
- • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience.
- • Experience translating ambiguous business needs into structured requirements and delivered solutions.
- • Experience supporting or leading initiatives across multiple countries or business lines.
- • Experience working cross-functionally with teams you influence rather than manage

Preferred qualifications

- • Experience with intake, prioritization, and delivery across a portfolio of requirements or programs.

title: Engineering Operations Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

2+ years of data center engineering experience
Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
Vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Business Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance, Network Strategy and Performance
descriptionHtml:
Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset.

Key job responsibilities
• Create and accurately maintain CSA shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL).
• Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL.
• Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities.
• Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery.
• Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan.
• Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences.
• Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need.
• Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages.
• Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process.
• Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations.
• Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs.
• Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.


About the team
The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.
We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.
The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 2+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with SQL or ETL

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with Tableau
- Experience using very large datasets

title: Engagement Manager, APJC-Delivery-JAPAN
descriptionHtml:
企業を支える基幹システムの革新に携わり、ビジネストランスフォーメーションと価値創造をリードしませんか？

Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にある大規模なワークロードをAWSへの移行を支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的な加速の実現をリードする Engagement Managerを募集しています。

お客様の業務を支える基幹システムはビジネスを支える重要なシステムです。多くの企業において、こうしたシステムは、オンプレミス環境で稼働しています。こうしたシステムは安定かつ堅剛である一方で、定常的な運用コスト負荷、短期間で変化するビジネスニーズへの柔軟な対応が容易でないなどが課題になっています。従来のアプリケーション資産を継承しモダナイズすることでビジネスに俊敏性と持続性を実現化することは大きなチャレンジです。近年、金融業など大規模なシステムを抱える企業でもこのような取り組みが始まっています。モダナイズされたアプリケーションアセットを Amazon Web Services(AWS) のマネージドサービス上で動かすことは、単なるプラットフォームやアプリケーションアセットの刷新にとどまらない、お客様の未来を作る仕事です。モダナイゼーションによってコスト削減、効率化が実現すれば、生成AIなどの最新の技術サービスの活用による新しいアプリケーション開発と新しいビジネスサービスのプロダクトリリースなどの長期的な好循環と価値の享受が期待できます。このようなお客様のビジネストランスフォーメーションの実現をプロジェクト全体のマネジメントとデリバリーの観点からリードするのがEngagement Managerです。AWSコンサルタント・パートナー・お客様チームを率いて大規模なマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションプロジェクトを成功に導く意欲のある方を求めています。


Key job responsibilities
当ポジションのコンサルタントは、AWSコンサルタント、パートナー、お客様のプロジェクトチームをリードし、大規模なクラウドマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションエンゲージメントの計画策定からデリバリーまでを一貫して推進します。お客様の経営課題・ビジネス目標を把握し、それを実現するためのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの全体計画（スコープ、スケジュール、体制、リスク管理）を策定・管理します。 オンプレミス環境上のワークロードの評価・計画・環境設計・移行実行を、関連する技術コンサルタントやパートナーと連携して推進します。最新のAWSのAIテクノロジーも活用したスケーラブルなモダナイゼーション手法と自動化ツール技術をエンゲージメント全体に適用することで、大規模なオンプレミス環境からAWSへの移行およびモダナイゼーションを加速することを目指します。また、プロジェクトの進捗・課題・リスクを適時に可視化し、お客様の経営層・プロジェクト責任者に対してプロアクティブに報告・提案を行います。お客様の成功のために、複数のProfessional Servicesメンバー、AWSパートナー、グローバルのProfessional Servicesを含む社内の多くのAWSチームと連携し、プロジェクトのギャップを特定・解消してお客様の成功をリードします。こうした支援を通じた市場へのサービス投入の短縮化やビジネスインパクトの大きなシステムのクラウドへのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの実現はとてもエキサイティングな経験になるはずです。価値提供にまい進することでプロジェクトマネージャーとしての成長も期待できます。

A day in the life
お客様に対してチームで対応するなど体制に柔軟性があり、コアなしフレックス制度やリモートワークも活用し、柔軟でライフステージに合った働きやすい環境が整っております。

About the team
AWSについて: https://aws.amazon.com/jp/careers/#how_we_work
Amazon は男女雇用機会均等法を順守しています。人種、 出身国、性別、性的指向、障がい、年齢、その他
の属性によって差別することなく、平等に採用選考の機会を提供しています。障がいをお持ちの方は、以下
をご覧ください。https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/jp/

title: Program Manager, QC, Quick Commerce
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Program Manager to architect the future of our ultra-fast delivery network. In this role, you will own the strategic roadmap for our network, determining launch planning, how our Under-the-Roof (UTR) and On-the-Road (OTR) operations must evolve, how to optimize channel strategies to balance speed with cost-efficiency. You will be the bridge between high-level business strategy and operational reality.

We are building foundational elements of new network from the ground up, including development of operational frameworks, technology integration, and service optimization. The team consistently demonstrates agility in learning and implementing improvements, turning challenges into opportunities for growth. Our collaborative environment encourages experimentation and rapid iteration, allowing us to establish robust playbooks that will shape the future.

title: Partner Solutions Architect, ASEAN APO Partner Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders, we try new things, and imagine big dreams. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, testers, and doers. Come join us and work with the latest cloud technologies that enable our customers to adopt cloud-based solutions.

THE ROLE
You will collaborate with a diverse partner community—including distributors, traditional system integrators, born-in-cloud partners, and AI-native partners—alongside other AWS teams to build architectures, proof of concepts, and demonstrations of AWS services by working backwards from their customers' business needs to accelerate the adoption of appropriate AWS technology.
A key focus of this role is accelerating both migration and AI transformation through partners. You will drive large-scale migration initiatives while simultaneously building and scaling an Agentic Platform that empowers partners to deliver AI-driven, autonomous solutions to their customers. You will help shape and design partner solutions covering a spread of domains from migration of core applications and workloads to working with GenAI, Agentic AI, AI/ML, microservices, containers, app development, IoT, and more. Being able to continuously expand your technological knowledge—particularly in migration methodologies and emerging agentic and autonomous AI capabilities—and having an interest in designing industry-applicable architectures that demonstrate business value are essential for this role.
PARTNER COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT
You will be responsible for managing and scaling relationships across multiple partner types to accelerate both migration and AI adoption:
• Distributors: Enable and empower distribution partners to extend AWS reach, providing technical enablement for migration and AI services, go-to-market support, and architectural guidance that cascades through their partner networks
• Traditional System Integrators: Work with established SI partners to modernize their migration practices, integrate AWS services into their delivery models, and help them evolve their capabilities to include AI and agentic solutions alongside traditional migration offerings
• Born-in-Cloud Partners: Engage with cloud-native partners who have built their business models around cloud technologies, helping them scale their AWS migration practices and develop advanced capabilities in emerging AI technologies
• AI Partners: Collaborate with AI-native and specialized AI partners to co-innovate on industry solutions, integrate their technologies with AWS services, and accelerate customer adoption of intelligent, autonomous systems that complement migration journeys
MIGRATION ACCELERATION
You will drive migration velocity and scale through your partner community by:
• Enabling partners to execute large-scale migration programs using AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and other migration frameworks
• Building partner capabilities in migration assessment, planning, and execution methodologies
• Developing migration-specific reference architectures, tools, and accelerators for partners
• Coaching partners on migration best practices, including the 7Rs (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, etc.)
• Helping partners integrate AI/ML capabilities into migration workflows to optimize and accelerate customer migrations
• Driving partner-attached migration ARR and ensuring successful migration outcomes
AGENTIC PLATFORM DEVELOPMENT
A critical component of your role is building up an Agentic Platform for partners that enables them to:
• Develop, deploy, and scale autonomous AI agents that can reason, plan, and execute complex tasks
• Integrate agentic capabilities into their existing migration and modernization solutions
• Leverage AWS AI/ML services to create intelligent, self-improving systems that enhance migration and post-migration optimization
• Build partner competencies and certifications around agentic AI technologies
• Create reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and accelerators for agentic solutions that complement migration journeys
TRUSTED TECHNICAL ADVISOR
As a trusted technical advisor, you'll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders—from technical teams to executives—across your partner community. You'll help ensure their short-term technology decisions around migration and AI are aligned with their long-term strategic goals. Helping partners work with customers to accelerate adoption of AWS migration services and AI capabilities will be part of your day-to-day activities.
COMMUNITY EVANGELIST & THOUGHT LEADER
You'll also act as an evangelist in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing whitepapers, blogs, and running workshops focused on partner enablement, migration acceleration, agentic AI, and emerging technologies. You won't just want to be part of an industry movement; you'll want to be leading it.
BUILDER & PRODUCT INFLUENCER
As a Builder, you'll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from partners and their customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams to influence the roadmap of AWS's migration tools, agentic capabilities, and AI services.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 3+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture, database architecture, networking and application development, including designing and delivering complex, large-scale enterprise solutions
- Knowledge of enterprise application platforms, middleware, containers, serverless and distributed systems, and their architecture, scalability, security and resiliency needs
- Hands-on experience with modern software development practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK) and API-driven, microservices-based architectures
- Experience working with end-user or developer communities, including building technical content, running workshops and enabling teams to adopt new technologies
- Experience managing relationships with enterprise customers and technology partners (ISVs, Systems Integrators, Consulting Partners) to drive solution design and adoption
- Experience modernizing and migrating legacy or monolithic applications and infrastructure to cloud-native architectures
- Experience designing and building solutions in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, data & analytics, and event-driven integration
- Industry certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or equivalent

title: Solutions Architect Manager, AI & Growth - ASEAN, ASEAN APO PSA Team
descriptionHtml:

title: Regional Project Design Controls Engineer - APJC, Fleet Remediation Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and their servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We have an immediate opening for a Project Design Controls Engineer in Sydney. If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenge of innovative projects at hyper-scale, this job is for you!

As a Controls Engineer within the Fleet Remediation Engineering (FRE) team, you will lead the design, specification, and implementation of Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) controls solutions for data center retrofit projects. You will bridge the gap between mechanical/electrical retrofit design and controls integration, ensuring that upgraded systems are properly monitored, controlled, and optimized across our existing fleet. This role combines deep controls engineering expertise with the fleet remediation mission of evolving our data centers to meet ever-changing customer needs at hyper-scale. You will use your Controls expertise to:

• Own the design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions which add data center infrastructure, capacity, improve availability, and/or increase sustainability.
• Develop and maintain deep expertise in building operations, mechanical plant strategies, BMS/EPMS programming concepts, control diagrams, industrial HVAC systems, electrical lineups, one-line diagrams, and complex environmental concepts.
• Perform design and equipment submittal review for Data Centers in your region.
• Interface with internal and external data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team, field engineering, and controls engineering to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
• Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
• Act as a technical subject matter expert for your given discipline during new remediation projects.
• Support construction, commissioning, operations, and turnover.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Fleet Remediation Project Design Controls Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:
• Lead controls design and integration for mechanical and electrical retrofit projects across the existing data center fleet, ensuring BMS and EPMS systems are properly specified, programmed, and commissioned.
• Develop and maintain controls design standards, specifications, and scope of work (SOW) documents specific to fleet remediation retrofit projects, aligning with global design standards.
• Collaborate with FRE mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, construction teams, commissioning, and operations stakeholders to deliver integrated controls solutions that support retrofit objectives.
• Serve as the central technical authority for BMS/EPMS controls within FRE, managing and prioritizing controls scope across retrofit projects, legacy site enhancements, and capacity recovery initiatives.
• Perform controls design reviews on retrofit packages, identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities for optimization in monitoring and automation strategies.
• Coordinate with controls vendors and programmers on bid reviews, RFI support, controller drawings, MOPs, and code reviews, ensuring deliverables meet FRE standards.
• Develop and review control sequences of operation, control diagrams, point lists, and network architecture for retrofit applications including HVAC upgrades, power distribution modifications, and liquid cooling integrations.
• Interact with AWS cloud services and data analytics platforms to support data reporting, energy optimization, and operational intelligence initiatives.
• Anticipate roadblocks and risks in controls integration, providing escalation management and proactive solutions to maintain project timelines.
• Travel domestically and internationally as needed to support retrofit project initiatives, site surveys, and commissioning activities.
• Provide engineering judgment and design recommendations for controls scope despite uncertainty, particularly on legacy systems with limited documentation.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center safety, remediation projects, capacity, and availability, focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- 2+ years of relevant discipline work, or 2+ years of data center or mission critical facilities (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.) experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related fields
- Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 25% of the role.

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience with EPMS/SCADA/BMS Controls system software or hardware
- 7+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
- Knowledge of Modbus, BACnet, and other industrial communication protocols.
- Experience with data center redundancy concepts, mechanical failure strategies, and failure mode analysis

descriptionHtml:

入社後、数カ月間は他の事業所でトレーニング（出張ベース）をしていただく予定です。

私たちのグローバルオペレーションネットワークは、日々何百万もの荷物と笑顔をアマゾンのお客様にお届けしています。私たちは、シフトアシスタントとして私たちのチームに加わってほしいと考え、意欲的で顧客重視の人材を探しています。この役割では他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。また、お客様の注文が適切な時間に適切な場所へ確実に配送されるよう、お客様の期待に応えることにおいても重要な役割を担います。

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。

本ポジションはアマゾンの新しいエキサイティングな配送拠点で業務を行います。可能な限り最速でお客様のご自宅に商
品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。
