title: Sr. Product Manager - Fleet Telematics (Fixed-Term contract), Fleet Safety & Technology
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Product Manager, Telematics to lead the vision, roadmap, and global execution of our telematics product portfolio. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant cross-functional influence, responsible for shaping how connected vehicle technology powers fleet safety, predictive maintenance, and operational efficiency across our last-mile delivery network.

Based in Luxembourg or London, you will operate at the intersection of product strategy, vendor governance, and large-scale program delivery — driving outcomes across EU and global markets.

Please note that this is a 12 months fixed-term contract.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the multi-year telematics product strategy and roadmap, aligning with global fleet and last-mile delivery objectives across EU and international markets
- Lead end-to-end product development from discovery through scaled deployment, including requirements definition, prioritization, and executive stakeholder alignment
- Define and govern contractual relationships with telematics vendors, including leading commercial negotiations, SLA frameworks, performance accountability structures, and contract renewals
- Establish and maintain vendor governance mechanisms to ensure delivery against contractual commitments, data quality standards, and operational KPIs
- Partner with engineering, data science, legal, and operations teams to deliver telematics capabilities including real-time vehicle tracking, fault diagnostics, driver behavior monitoring, and predictive maintenance
- Drive adoption of telematics solutions across Delivery Service Partner (DSP) networks and internal fleet operations at scale
- Define, track, and report on key product metrics and use insights to continuously improve product outcomes
- Lead market and competitive analysis to identify emerging connected vehicle technologies and integration opportunities, including direct OEM integrations
- Ensure compliance with regional data privacy and regulatory requirements, including GDPR and EU-specific frameworks, in close collaboration with legal and privacy teams
- Communicate product strategy, roadmap progress, and business impact clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across geographies


About the team
The Fleet Safety & Technology (FS&T) team sits within International Global Fleet & Products (GFP). Our mission is to make Amazon's delivery fleet the safest, most technologically advanced, and most efficient in the industry — striving to eliminate all serious incidents through technology, data, and accountability.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in fleet technology, IoT, connected vehicle platforms, or telematics
- Familiarity with OEM telematics integrations and connected vehicle data standards
- Knowledge of EV fleet management, battery health monitoring, or energy consumption analytics

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Regulatory and Trade Services (ARTS Tech)
descriptionHtml:
ARTS Tech is seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to build services that make the cross-border movement of products, software, and technology secure, lawful, and seamless. You will design and operate scalable systems that support trade classification, import and export controls, product compliance, and global expansion. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex greenfield problems, work with emerging Amazon businesses, and deliver durable solutions used across Amazon's global footprint.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate scalable distributed services for cross-border trade and regulatory compliance.
- Translate ambiguous business and regulatory requirements into simple, maintainable technical solutions.
- Own the architecture and delivery of major features, including effort estimation and rollout planning.
- Build reliable, secure, and observable systems that meet performance and availability goals.
- Collaborate with product managers, compliance specialists, UX designers, and engineers across Amazon.
- Participate in code reviews, operational support, and continuous improvement.
- Mentor engineers and contribute to hiring and team development.

A day in the life
You will work with product, compliance, and engineering partners to clarify customer needs, review designs, and build services that operate at Amazon scale. A typical day may include writing and reviewing code, resolving production issues, making architecture decisions, and planning delivery with your Scrum team. You will own the systems you build, use operational data to improve them, and help teammates grow through thoughtful design and code reviews.

About the team
Amazon Regulatory and Trade Services (ARTS) Tech builds systems that enable the secure, lawful, and efficient movement of products, software, and technology across international borders. Our solutions support trade classification, duties and import costs, export and import restrictions, and product compliance. We serve Amazon businesses—including Global Store, Direct Imports, Devices, Robotics, and Physical Stores—as well as sellers, vendors, carriers, customs brokers, and freight forwarders. We value ownership, pragmatic engineering, operational excellence, and collaborative problem solving.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Compliance Manager, Dangerous Goods, Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.

The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility, Chemical Safety Compliance and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Key job responsibilities
A Manager in GSRC team typically manages a team of up to 20 people. The role can also require managing a team of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and Individual Contributor (IC) that acts as support function for teams. Candidate will also be expected to interact with counterparts in other geographies and share best practices across the program and cross program. The basic responsibilities include, but not limited to –

- Own business metrics and processes, aligned with business goals; Implement KPIs(Key Performance Indicators), metrics, audit processes, and best practices to track, maintain and exceed productivity (TPH) and quality (DPMO/defects/internal audit scores) as per service level agreements. Actively manage capacity and triggers for investigations to balance supply and demand.
- Contributes to goal settings for direct team members in lines with process goals.
- Responds to escalations/analyzes data; highlights trends and gaps, and prepares data for business meetings/reviews.
- Analyze defects and develops programs that fix root causes and work with other support/tech/process excellence teams wherever required.
- Build and scale process-related solutions that have metric impact through multiple projects and automation; drive adoption of solutions across teams.
- Review SOPs, processes, and tools to ensure that proactive changes have a positive impact on process and team performance.
- Prepare and share scorecards monthly following leadership aligned timelines, ensuring effective performance management and optimum employee experience. Acknowledge and reward strong performers.
- Guide new joiners to meet training goals during onboarding and training phases, providing coaching as necessary.
- Recruit top-quality reviewers/classifiers and develop their skills by setting SMART goals and driving developmental plans. Provide regular coaching and feedback to help them grow in functional and leadership skills, expanding team capabilities which provide growth opportunities for future leaders.
- Ensure direct team members adhere to their schedules by punching in and out on time daily, accurately tracking their activities as productive or non-productive and applying leaves on the amazon portal to avoid impact to Utilization and productivity.
- Additional responsibilities may involve taking part in analyzing data trends for planning for the program, ensuring process hygiene for multiple functions, onboarding new processes and running cross program initiatives regarding people engagement.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any field of study
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Minimum 4 years in managing people, interacting with customers or stakeholders
- Minimum 2 years in independently managing a function
- Responsible for performance and development of a downstream team of at least 15 to 20 people in operations
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Preferred qualifications

- Overall work experience of minimum 6 years
- Strong Analytical ability Good in verbal and written business communication
- Master of Business Administration from tier 1/tier 2 college
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/ Black Belt PMP/Prince Certified

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.

• Hold a valid and active driver’s license
• High School or equivalent diploma
• Candidates must be 21 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines in English.
• Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, reach and ascend/descend stairs
• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
• Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications
• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills with diverse audiences
• Experience building strong, collaborative relationships with colleagues and outside vendors
• A valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL)
• Completion of Career Choice Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) Course

title: DCEO Engineer, Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer with experience in critical facilities management, and a result-driven individual with strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The DCEO Engineer is responsible for engineering operations including risk management and mitigation, planning, implementation of corrective and preventative maintenance for critical infrastructure and vendor management within our AWS Data Center environment. They are responsible for day-to-day operational excellence, maintenance of the critical infrastructure, supervising specialist vendors, acting as first responders to incidents, and becoming subject matter experts for the facility.


Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

• Act as the site primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders involving communication and relationship management.
• Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
• Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
• Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
• Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analysis, and prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
• Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
• Work with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
• Establish documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
• Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
• Assist in recruiting efforts.
• Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues


A day in the life
• Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
• Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
• Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
• Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
• Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience with power management and power monitoring systems
- Basic understanding of the electrical and mechanical systems used in a data center environment, including but not limited to DRUPS, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDUs, Chillers, AHUs and CRAC units

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
- Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure

title: Senior-Manager/in für Arbeitssicherheit, Workplace Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Bei Amazon brauchen wir talentierte und erfahrene Kolleg:innen, die uns helfen, unseren Betrieb sicher und effizient zu führen. Als Senior Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Manager:in bist Du maßgeblich daran beteiligt, strategische Verbesserungen an Deinen Standorten und auf regionaler Ebene voranzutreiben. Du leitest und entwickelst Dein Team, setzt die Sicherheitsagenda und arbeitest mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, um eine Kultur der Sicherheit und Inklusion in Deinem Verantwortungsbereich zu verankern.

Key job responsibilities
Leitung der Teams vor Ort und bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zur Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Arbeitsschutzgesetzen, Richtlinien und Unternehmensrichtlinien.
Verwendung interner Reporting-Tools zur Datenanalyse und Bereitstellung von Informationen für die Unternehmensführung zur Unterstützung sicherheitsrelevanter Entscheidungen.
Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Pflege von Sicherheitsschulungsprogrammen, Ergonomie-Initiativen und Präventionsprogrammen zur Verbesserung der Sicherheitskultur.
Durchführung von Risikobewertungen für neue Prozesse und Maschinen, Überprüfung von Änderungen an standardisierten Prozessen und Aktualisierung bestehender Risikobewertungen.
Förderung des Engagements für Arbeitsschutzmaßnahmen bei Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden zur Stärkung einer soliden Sicherheitskultur.

A day in the life
Dies ist eine äußerst vielseitige Rolle an einem unserer Standorte, die Dir ermöglicht, direkt zu vielen Aspekten unserer Sicherheitskultur beizutragen. Du verwaltest die Arbeitsschutzstandards und verbesserst gleichzeitig Funktionalität und Effizienz. Außerdem leitest Du Dein Team und hilfst bei der Umsetzung von Änderungen basierend auf Mitarbeiterfeedback oder bei der Nutzung von Möglichkeiten zur kontinuierlichen Prozessverbesserung.

Deine Rolle ist entscheidend für die Sicherheit der Mitarbeitenden, die Verwaltung ihrer Zufriedenheit und die Überwachung ihres Wohlbefindens und ihrer Produktivität. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitssicherheit und förderst eine Kultur des sicheren Arbeitens.

About the team
Das Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung des mentalen und körperlichen Wohlbefindens unserer Mitarbeitenden am Arbeitsplatz. Unser Team arbeitet mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und lokalen Behörden an allen unseren Standorten zusammen, um die Einhaltung der Amazon-Richtlinien und gesetzlichen Vorschriften sicherzustellen und die Sicherheit unserer Arbeitsumgebungen zu gewährleisten. Das Team bietet vielfältige Möglichkeiten — von Safety Technicians bis hin zu Programm Manager:innen. Unabhängig von Deiner Position trägst Du zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Sicherheitsstrategie im gesamten Netzwerk bei.

- Ein Bachelorabschluss oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation entsprechend dem Europäischen Qualifikationsrahmen (EQF)
- Zertifizierung als Sicherheitsfachkraft (gemäß ASchG §§73–77).
- Kenntnis der österreichischen Arbeitsschutzgesetzgebung.
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Leitung eines Teams.
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (B2), in Wort und Schrift.

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit Lean-, 5S- oder Kaizen-Methoden.
- Erfahrung in der Planung oder Durchführung umweltbewusster Initiativen.

title: Technik BHP
descriptionHtml:
Bezpieczeństwo i dobrostan naszych pracowników to najwyższy priorytet w Amazon. Nasi Technicy BHP odgrywają kluczową rolę w jego zapewnianiu. To stanowisko jest szansą na rozpoczęcie kariery w dziedzinie bezpieczeństwa pracy i rozwój w międzynarodowej firmie. Będziesz ściśle współpracować z naszymi ekspertami, monitorując swój obiekt, dzięki czemu każdego dnia zobaczysz, jaką różnicę robisz dla dobrostanu ludzi.

Key job responsibilities
- Przeprowadzanie ocen ryzyka i audytów.
- Monitorowanie obiektu w celu zapewnienia zgodności procesów z procedurami bezpieczeństwa Amazon.
- Tworzenie i aktualizacja raportów dotyczących wskaźników bezpieczeństwa do przeglądu przez współpracowników.
- Współpraca z kolegami z działu Operations i całej firmy przy zadaniach związanych z bezpieczeństwem oraz doradztwo w zakresie procesów.
- Wsparcie we wdrażaniu nowych środków bezpieczeństwa.

A day in the life
Będziesz pracować w jednym z naszych obiektów. Oznacza to, że będziesz mógł/mogła ściśle śledzić to, co się dzieje, a pracownicy będą mogli łatwo zadawać Ci pytania podczas swoich zmian. Ta rola polega na identyfikowaniu potencjalnych problemów, zanim się pojawią. Będziesz poświęcać dużo czasu na sprawdzanie obiektu i poznawanie sposobu, w jaki ludzie korzystają ze sprzętu. title: Software Development Engineer, System SW group
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs is the team behind the custom silicon and systems at the heart of AWS (Amazon Web Services) infrastructure — we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

We're looking for Software Engineer to join the System Group in defining, shaping, and integrating advanced solutions for the next generation of our cloud platforms.

Join our dynamic System Software team in creating innovative software solutions that power our product development lifecycle from conception to deployment. You'll develop critical tools that ensure product excellence across design, validation, manufacturing, and production environments


Key job responsibilities
• Design and develop software tools for all product development stages (card level, rack level).
• Collaborate with hardware engineers, firmware developers, and system architects.
• Create and maintain debugging tools and utilities
• Develop comprehensive documentation and provide training for tools.
• Optimize testing and validation processes for coverage, speed, efficiency, and resource utilization.
• Research and implement new technologies to enhance the testing ecosystem.
• Support critical system troubleshooting and issue resolution.
• Participate in design reviews and provide technical guidance on testability.

About the team
Our System SW team at Annapurna Labs brings Amazon's custom EC2 servers from first engineering units to full-rate production across our various sites. We work close to the metal industry, bringing up new chip and card platforms, standing up the manufacturing process and driving each one to launch faster, healthier, and more reliably. Partnering with design teams, manufacturing partners, and data center operations, we turn brand-new hardware into a healthy, high-volume fleet that directly impacts millions of customers around the world.

If you're a systems or software engineer who loves hard problems where hardware, manufacturing, and software meet — we'd love to talk.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent.
- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience in a multidisciplinary company.
- Experience in programming, with at least one software programming language (C, Python, Lua).
- Experience in Software-Hardware systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Understanding of Linux internals.
- Experience in computer architecture.
- Experience in scripting language.

title: System Manufacturing Engineer, Graviton server development team
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs, as part of Amazon, is the team behind AWS (Amazon Web Services) Graviton — the industry's most advanced Arm-based server CPU — and we operate like a start-up with the scale of the world's largest cloud provider.

We're looking for System Manufacturing Engineer to be part of defining, shaping and integrating solutions to next generation of our cloud platforms.

As a System Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll own the development, testing, and monitoring of the manufacturing health of Amazon Graviton server products. You’ll be part of a team integrating new silicon, hardware, firmware, and software into a revolutionary system architecture.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with hardware design teams to drive Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Test (DFT), providing early feedback that reduces cost, defects, and ramp risk.
- Work with design partners and contract manufacturer (CM/ODM) sites to set up assembly, test, and burn-in processes, tooling, and fixtures that enable reliable manufacturing of Graviton-based servers.
- Define functional, stress, and in-circuit test coverage; drive first-pass yield up and defect/DPPM rates down through data-driven root cause analysis.
- Review, identify, and qualify second-source components to enable continuity of supply.
- Continuously assess process capability and innovate to simplify processes, reduce cost, and shorten cycle time across Graviton server development and manufacturing.
- Own defect containment, RMA root-cause, corrective/preventive actions (CAPA), and continuous improvement of production quality and reliability.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams — design, SI/PI, firmware, supply chain, and quality — to improve product design, processes, and quality.
- Work with upstream vendors and downstream customers to optimize the entire value stream and build joint processes that drive better cost and cycle time.
- Willingness to travel 4–6 times per year (approximately 1 week per trip) to design partner and manufacturing sites.

About the team
Our Graviton System group owns the design, manufacturing, and health of the Arm-based server fleet powering Amazon EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud). We work close to the metal — across firmware, board bring-up, diagnostics, and hardware debug — to keep servers running and return failed units to production fast. In close partnership with design partners, data center operations, and hardware engineering teams, we bring new server platforms into the fleet and drive them to launch faster, healthier, and more reliably, at a scale that directly impacts millions of customers around the world.
If you are a systems, HW, or SW engineer who thrives on hard problems at the intersection of hardware and software, enjoys root-causing failures on real servers, and wants to see your work make a measurable difference across a global fleet — we would love to talk.

Basic qualifications

- B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent.
- 6+ years of experience bringing hardware products from design through mass production- including production test development, process development, and yield management.
- 6+ years experience with electronics manufacturing processes (SMT, assembly, system integration, test, and burn-in) and the supporting test equipment.
- Demonstrated ability to conduct manufacturing bring-up, failure analysis, and root cause investigation in both a lab and a production environment -on-site and at external CM/ODM partner sites.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience ramping server, networking, or data center hardware, especially multi-socket or GPU/AI platforms.
- Experience with production testing of DDR4/5, PCIe Gen4/5/6, CXL, and 100/400GbE.
- Knowledge of SPC, DOE, Six Sigma, and yield/data analytics.
- Experience in sustaining engineering, root cause analysis, ECOs, yield improvement, and vendor/CM support.
- Experience with Bash, Python, or SQL for data analysis, automation, or process monitoring; familiarity with AI-assisted tools.
- Exposure to networking, storage, or Linux-based servers.
- Strong technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration across design, test, firmware, supply chain, and manufacturing teams.

title: Solutions Architect, Alps ISV
descriptionHtml:
This role is within the EMEA Independent Software Vendors (ISV) organization. You will be working with Software Vendors in Austria, in order to help them be successful on AWS, working backwards from their needs.

Solutions Architects work close to customers. They engage with organizations at all stages of their cloud adoption and are responsible for the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS. They make recommendations on architecture, security, cost, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with AWS technology.

Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos, and technical workshops.

They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams, and the AWS partner ecosystem.

In this role, you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Serverless, and Container-based architectures, Analytics and Big Data, DevOps or Security).

The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a sound technical foundation and a desire to learn. You will have the support to grow your expertise in industry and technology areas of depth. Every day you will learn something new from your customers, your peers, and your experiments.

At Amazon, you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is suitable for the customer's long-term success. We value your passion for discovering, inventing, and building on behalf of customers.

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.


Key job responsibilities
• Help Austrian ISVs accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects, from architecture design to hands-on implementation. Recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes, and build alongside customers: prototypes, proofs of concept and production-ready code when it speeds up their journey. Agentic AI and SaaSification are key topics, as are containerization and adding innovative services to their solutions.
• Build technical relationships with customers and act as their trusted advisor, earning credibility by working hands-on with their engineering teams. The customer's best interests will shape the guidance you provide.
• Share the voice of the customer to inform the AWS feature roadmap.
• Help create and share best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g., white papers, code samples, open-source repositories, reusable assets, blog posts).
• Evangelize and educate about AWS technology (e.g., through hands-on workshops, hackathons, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
• Develop deep expertise in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customers' outcomes, including staying hands-on with the latest AWS services and AI-assisted development tools.

About the team
Our team is based in Switzerland and Austria, offering a dynamic and collaborative work environment in the heart of Europe. As part of a broader EMEA organization working with Software Vendors, we benefit from strong cross-regional synergies that foster knowledge sharing, diverse perspectives, and innovative approaches to our work. This structure provides exciting opportunities for team members to collaborate with colleagues across multiple geographies and engage in cross-border projects.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications
- Knowledge of AI/ML concepts, including modern Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI integration patterns or equivalent
- Fluent English

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
- Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
- Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Understanding of agentic AI frameworks and architectures, including autonomous agents and multi-agent orchestration
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
- Speaking German

title: Health & Safety Manager, Data Center Health and Safety , Data Center Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Join the world class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Health and Safety Manager. As the Health and Safety Manager you will own the Health and Safety function of your respective area. You will be responsible for improving the health and safety of our data centers, advancing safety culture, and protecting our employees. Each day you will work with our data center engineers, the people who make the cloud go. They are working with electrical switching equipment, large scale air handling mechanical systems, and critical IT gear.

You will work closely with experts in security, construction, operations, logistics, compliance, corporate counsel, and human resources to further the global health safety program. You will partner with employees as well as contractors to achieve health and safety goals and improve our already strong safety culture. As AWS increases data capacity you will partner with construction managers to ensure risks are identified and mitigated prior to live operations. You will work in a fast-paced environment where our operations are rapidly changing, advocating safe changes in the face of new infrastructure, new tools, and new products/processes.

This role is for an experienced Safety Specialist or Safety Engineer. The role's prime responsibility will be to support the safety operations for Data Centers. You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives.

You must be an effective communicator, sending clear, concise and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and/or public speaking forums. You will advise, instruct and train company personnel on safety policies and procedures, as well as assist the teams in incorporating and improving our safety standards at their sites.

You will report to the Regional Safety Manager – EMEA and be responsible for continuing to enhance the safety of operations and construction. Some domestic and international travel is required.

Key job responsibilities
•Implement safety standards, policies and best practices.
•Provision and Management of Training: Induction, Refresher Training as required, develop and deliver training/presentations to support achievement of H&S objectives. Ensure all H&S training requirements are fulfilled.
•Collaborate with vendors (General Contractors, sub-contractors, Emergency Services) as they relate to operations and construction.
•Ensure compliance and implementation of global safety programs and local regulatory legislation.
•Develop and review safety plans for on-site emergencies, special events and other unique safety situations.
•Perform safety data analysis and create bench marking.
•Ensure safety record keeping and provide accurate reporting and metrics to support business safety initiatives.
•Consult and work with compliance teams on safety regulations interpretations and investigations.
•Develop and implement solutions to eliminate exposure to risks and prevent injury.
•Adapt to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, strategy and deadlines.
•Able to work as part of a team and provide safety support to regions outside of local cluster when required.
•Other duties as assigned.

About the team
We’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications

- Occupational Safety Specialist in accordance with Italian Legislative Decree 81/2008 (Testo Unico sulla Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro):
- - Qualified as Responsabile del Servizio di Prevenzione e Protezione (RSPP) meeting the requirements of Art. 32 of D.Lgs. 81/2008, including completion of training modules A, B, and C as defined by the Conferenza Stato-Regioni agreements.
- - Minimum 5+ years of field experience in Safety.
- - Fluent English and Italian language skills required.

Preferred qualifications

- A good knowledge of the Italian occupational safety framework under D.Lgs. 81/2008 (Testo Unico) and its implementing regulations
- Considerable knowledge of local safety and health regulatory laws and practices and workplace safety
- Experience / knowledge of implementing safety programs, processes, and procedural documentation
- Data center, manufacturing, construction, or similar industry safety experience with mix of full-time employees and third-party contractors

title: Solutions Architect, Software & Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth, business acumen and strong interpersonal skills. You will engage with some of the world’s largest companies to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate their ability to innovation.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.


Key job responsibilities
As a trusted customer advocate, the Solutions Architect will work to understand their business needs and provide guidance and best practices on how to leverage cloud technologies to solve these with traditional or innovative solutions.

The ability to connect technology with measurable business value and help customers solve problems is critical to a solutions architect.

You will represent AWS in face-to-face meetings and own the overall technical relationship between AWS and the customer up to C-level.


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Solid experience in design/implementation/management of complex distributed IT applications and infrastructure or database architectures
- Awareness of cloud computing benefits, concepts and principles; software development tools and methodologies
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across internal and external organizations
- Demonstrated ability to continuously adapt to new technologies and trends and learn new skills quickly
- Fluency in French and English

Preferred qualifications

- Technical degree; Computer Science, Engineering or Math background highly desired, or equivalent work experience
- History of successful technical sales consulting and architecture engagements with large-scale customers or enterprises
- Experience architecting, migrating or transforming customer solutions to the cloud
- Familiarity with SaaS workloads

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Senior Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support and Unified Operations Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies - including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

The Role As a TAM you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services - including EC2, S3, DynamoDB and RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support, and risk management. You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support and Unified Operations customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!

The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

Key job responsibilities
- You'll develop strategic engagement plans, working backwards from customer outcomes, challenges and blockers
- You'll advise on solutions, provide technical guidance, and advocate for our customers
- Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
- Develop trusting relationships with customers understanding their business needs and technical challenges
- Using your technical acumen and customer obsession you'll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
- Consult with a range of stakeholders from developers through to C-suite executives
- Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
- With a bias for action you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
- Provide detailed reviews of service events, monthly and quarterly metrics, detailed pre-launch planning
- Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of technical engineering experience
- 5+ years of experience in design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications and infrastructure
- Experience in a similar role as a Technical Account Manager, Consultant, Solutions Architect, Platform Engineer, Systems Engineer, Cloud Architect etc.
- Understand operational parameters and troubleshooting for four (4) of the following, deep in at least one (1): Security & Compliance / Resilience & Reliability / Operational Excellence & Observability / Cost Optimisation & FinOps / Operations for AI & AI for IT Operations.
- External customer-facing experience with the ability to communicate across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Ability to juggle tasks and projects in a fast-paced environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead
- Professional experience with AWS and/or other cloud offerings such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform etc.
- Programming or scripting skills with a combination of Java, Python Perl, Ruby, C#, and/or PHP a plus but not a requirement
- Previous experience as a Software Engineer, Developer, Solution Architect, DevOps Engineer, etc.
- Understanding of DevOps practices and tools, including: Continuous Integration / Deployment, Puppet, Docker, Kubernetes, Chef etc.
- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Bachelor's degree, or Associate's degree or above
- Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering)

title: Data Engineer II (1 Year FTC), Supply Chain Optimization Technologies - Planning
descriptionHtml:
**This is a 1 Year FTC contract**

Are you passionate about building data solutions that power decisions at massive scale? As a Data Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and optimize data architectures that turn raw information into reliable, high-quality datasets used by analysts, scientists, and engineering teams. You will work across the full data lifecycle — from ingesting and transforming semi-structured data streams to creating logical data models that drive physical design and enable self-service analytics. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex data challenges, improve how teams discover and trust their data, and directly influence business outcomes through the systems you create.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement ETL workflows and data pipelines that extract, transform, and load data at scale, ensuring stability, performance, and efficient resource usage across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure.
- Create and maintain logical and physical data models that accurately represent business requirements, enforce data integrity, and support downstream analytics and reporting needs.
- Write clean, well-documented code using SQL and scripting languages to automate data processes, optimize query performance, and build tools for tracking data lineage and improving data quality.
- Collaborate with analysts, scientists, and software engineers to understand data requirements, balance competing priorities, and deliver usable datasets that provide clear business value.
- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence initiatives, contributing to continuous improvement of team data solutions while mentoring peers on system architecture and best practices.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing pipeline health dashboards and resolving any data quality issues before they reach downstream consumers. From there, you might pair with a scientist to refine a data model, write and optimize SQL queries for a new reporting dataset, or evaluate a generative AI tool to accelerate a repetitive transformation task. Afternoons often include design reviews with your team, where you propose improvements to existing architectures or troubleshoot production incidents at their root cause.

About the team
Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable data infrastructure that empowers teams across Amazon to make faster, better-informed decisions. We value collaboration, technical curiosity, and a commitment to simplifying complex systems. As we continue to grow, you will have the opportunity to shape the tools and processes that define how data is managed and consumed. If you are excited about working in an inclusive environment where your ideas directly influence how we build for the future, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in data engineering
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Sr. Partner Integration Manager, Amazon
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about managing the technical partnerships that connect retailers to new ways of selling online? As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will own the relationship with the retailer systems and third-party integrators. Sitting at the intersection of Business Development, Engineering, and our integrator community, you are the trusted technical advisor and two-way translator — shaping the right integration paths for new partners, keeping integrators ahead of API changes, and driving our documentation toward true self-service. This role requires deep understanding of retailer systems and independent judgment about what is operationally critical for a retailer. You must be technically fluent (able to read API specs, reason about data flows, and troubleshoot integrations), excel at navigating ambiguity, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, with excellent interpersonal skills. This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the technical foundation of an emerging category on Amazon. Your insights from working directly with the integrator community will directly influence our APIs, documentation, and marketplace.

Key job responsibilities
1. Partner with the BD team to assess prospective retailer and platform partners’ systems architecture and define the right integration path with Amazon, bringing solutioning expertise into partner conversations.
2. Map IMS/DMS/platform capabilities to our APIs, surface constraints and dependencies early, and apply independent judgment on what is critical for operations (inventory accuracy, transaction flows, data fidelity) to steer integration design.
3. Work closely with Engineering to understand upcoming API updates, deprecations, and new capabilities before they ship.
4. Proactively communicate API changes to the integrator community with enough lead time and clarity for them to plan and execute their own updates.
5. Act as the first line of technical support for integrators — answering questions, troubleshooting integration issues, and escalating to Engineering when needed.
6. Drive the accuracy and currency of API documentation by coordinating with the internal owners of each API surface.
7. Feed real integrator questions and friction points back into the documentation to continuously push it toward true self-service and reduce question volume at the source.
8. Build and manage durable relationships across BD, Engineering, documentation owners, and the external integrator ecosystem, operating with influence.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will work cross-functionally with Business Development, Engineering, and Product Management, while building and maintaining relationships with technical stakeholders across our external integrator community. One part of your day may be spent advising BD on a prospective partner’s integration path; another translating an upcoming API change into clear guidance for integrators; another troubleshooting a live integration issue and feeding what you learn back into the documentation. You will be instrumental in defining how integrators build on Amazon, providing valuable technical insights to product and engineering teams, and creating initiatives that scale integrator self-service. This role is based in London with occasional travel to meet with systems partners and integrators.

About the team
This role explores opportunities to innovate in an emerging category on Amazon. Our team aims to raise the bar on the buying experience for end customers, while enabling industry partners and integrators to build and grow efficiently by leveraging Amazon’s capabilities.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience in a technical partner/customer-facing role (developer relations, technical partner/alliance management, solutions architecture, or sales/integration engineering).
- Direct experience with DMS, inventory/feed systems, CRM, or digital retail/commerce platforms.
- Strong working knowledge of integration patterns; able to read API specs, reason about data flows, and troubleshoot integration issues.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with APIs and technical integrations
- Experience building and managing an external developer/integrator community at scale.
- Comfort operating in ambiguity across international markets.

title: Junior Logistik/Shift Manager - Vienna
descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.Als wichtiges Mitglied des Betriebsteams arbeitest Du mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Teams sowie externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Das beinhaltet die Analyse von Daten und Leistungskennzahlen gemeinsam mit Führungskräften in Deinem Geschäftsbereich ebenso wie die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit dem technischen Team.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

The minimum basic salary for this position is EUR 47'000 gross annually. In accordance with the applicable legal requirements, we also state that the minimum salary for this position is determined by the relevant collective bargaining agreement. Depending on experience and qualifications, there is a willingness to overpay. In addition, depending on the position, we offer sign-on payments and restricted stock unit (RSU) award as well as employee discount.

Basic qualifications

- Erfolgreich absolviertes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor- oder Master) vor Arbeitsbeginn
- Fortgeschrittene Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Relevante Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenanalysen

Preferred qualifications

- Aktuelles Studium oder kürzlich erworbener Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Logistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
- Interesse eine Führungsaufgabe und ein eigenes Team mit Mitarbeitenden aus der ganzen Welt zu übernehmen
- Erfahrung in der Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Kolleg:innen und Führungskräften
- Erfahrung in einer Logistikumgebung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) im beruflichen Umfeld

title: Senior Partner Solution Architect, Partner Solutions
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Partner Solution Architect on Amazon Ads Partner Solutions, you help agencies, SaaS platforms, CDPs, and systems integrators design and ship integrations across the Ads API, Amazon Ads Agent, Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), and Amazon Marketing Stream, spanning Sponsored Ads and Display, Video, and Audio (DVA) use cases. You work across these products to build the dozens of use cases and hundreds of solutions our partners bring to market on AWS. You bring strong solution-architecture and data skills. If you are coming from a cloud or platform background without ad-tech, you will ramp on the Amazon Ads domain with support from the team.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement partner integrations across the Ads API, Amazon Ads Agent, AMC, and Amazon Marketing Stream, spanning Sponsored Ads and Display, Video, and Audio (DVA) use cases and the full range of solutions partners build on these products.
- Lead technical discovery and requirements gathering with partners; guide them through technical decisions to successful delivery.
- Develop reusable patterns and best practices; mentor junior solution architects; influence the product roadmap.

A day in the life
Your day involves designing and reviewing technical solutions for advertising partners, focusing on helping them implement Amazon's advertising capabilities effectively. You lead technical implementation discussions, create architecture diagrams, and provide best practices guidance. Throughout the day, you develop proof of concepts, collect partner feedback, and collaborate with product and engineering teams. You mentor junior architects while ensuring partner solutions are properly implemented and optimized for performance across advertising platforms.

About the team
The Amazon Ads Partner Solutions team enables partners to build and scale innovative advertising technology solutions. Working with customer data platforms, systems integrators, agency holding companies, independent agencies, ad servers, and retail media platforms, this global team designs and delivers technical solutions that drive partner success. The team combines deep advertising technology expertise with Amazon's latest capabilities, including AI-driven features, to help partners build scalable, secure, and performant solutions. Through technical leadership and close collaboration with product teams, they influence both partner solutions and Amazon Ads product development, driving innovation across the advertising ecosystem.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- 5+ years in a technical, partner- or customer-facing solutions role (pre-sales SA, solutions/integration engineering, or equivalent)
- Hands-on RESTful API integration; proficiency in SQL and a scripting language such as Python
- Experience designing and delivering solutions on a major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent)
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with advertising or marketing technology: Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Ads Agent, Ads API, Amazon Marketing Stream, or close equivalents at another DSP, retail-media, or martech platform
- Familiarity with privacy-safe / clean-room data patterns (1P data, pseudonymized signals)
- Comfortable ramping quickly on a new product domain; deep ad-tech experience is welcome but not required if you bring strong solution-architecture and data skills
- Experience deploying AI/GenAI-enabled features in production; AWS service familiarity; enterprise-partner experience (agency holding companies, CDPs, SIs, ad servers)

title: Assistant·e RH, PXT (HR)
descriptionHtml:
L’une des nombreuses raisons pour lesquelles Amazon place la barre très haut en matière d’expérience client tient au fait que les RH veillent à ce que nous ayons la meilleure équipe derrière nous. Nous avons besoin d’une main-d’œuvre agile, afin d’avoir les bons talents en nombre suffisant pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients. En tant qu’ Associate Partner, PXT, vous aurez pour objectif de motiver nos collaborateurs·trices et de maintenir leur engagement en leur offrant une expérience enrichissante. En travaillant au sein d’une équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de partager des idées et d’apprendre des autres pour faire évoluer votre carrière.

Key job responsibilities
Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles et les responsables RH dans le déploiement de projets et d'initiatives stratégiques, en contribuant activement à l'engagement des collaborateurs et à l'amélioration continue de l'environnement de travail.

Assurer une gestion RH opérationnelle rigoureuse et réactive, en prenant en charge les processus d'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs, le suivi des temps de travail et des absences, ainsi que le traitement des demandes RH quotidiennes, tout en garantissant une expérience collaborateur de qualité.

Piloter et analyser les indicateurs de performance RH (KPIs) à travers les outils et tableaux de bord internes, identifier les tendances et les axes d'amélioration, et fournir des analyses pertinentes pour soutenir la prise de décision des équipes de management.

Déployer des initiatives favorisant l'engagement, le bien-être et l'expérience collaborateur, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes opérationnelles, afin de renforcer la satisfaction et la qualité de vie au travail.

Garantir la conformité et la fiabilité des processus RH, en réalisant des audits réguliers, en identifiant les écarts et en mettant en œuvre des actions correctives, dans le respect des procédures internes, de la législation du travail et des exigences de protection des données.

A day in the life
Vous n’occuperez pas une fonction de bureau conventionnelle, mais travaillerez sur site au contact de nos équipes d’entreposage. En fonction de votre lieu d’affectation, vous travaillerez peut-être en rotation avec vos collègues Associate Partners Cela signifie qu’un membre de l’équipe RH est toujours à proximité pour répondre aux interrogations du personnel.
Le rôle de l'Associate Partner est très varié. En plus de nous aider à maîtriser les principaux processus RH, vous épaulerez les responsables de votre équipe dans différents projets visant à impliquer le personnel. Il peut s’agir de recueillir les commentaires des employé·es et d’organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux plans. Vous pourriez, par exemple, avoir à recueillir les commentaires des équipes impliquées, organiser des activités pour les faire adhérer à de nouveaux projets ou participer à la création d’un environnement inclusif dans lequel les employé·es se sentent à l’aise pour poser toutes leurs questions relatives aux ressources humaines.

About the team
Le service RH joue un rôle essentiel dans le fonctionnement de l’entreprise et la gestion des collaborateurs·trices. Baptisée « équipe PXT » (People Experience and Technology Solutions), elle veille avant tout à la mise en place d’un environnement de travail exceptionnel pour que l’innovation, la satisfaction client et l’agilité continuent de faire rayonner Amazon partout dans le monde.
Nous adoptons une approche holistique, proactive et intégrée de la gestion du personnel. Notre équipe a « l’obsession de la satisfaction client ». Elle s’attache à résoudre rapidement les problèmes d’implication et de motivation des employé·es, afin que rien n’affecte l’expérience globale des employé·es et des clients. En définitive, notre travail consiste à veiller à la conformité d’Amazon aux normes RH les plus strictes et à faire progresser la stratégie et les objectifs d’Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Connaissance de la suite MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) dans un environnement professionnel
- Une expérience dans la communication avec un large éventail de parties prenantes, y compris avec vos pairs et la direction
- Parfaite maîtrise du Français, à l’écrit et à l’oral, l'Anglais est préferable.
- Une expérience significative dans le domaine des ressources humaines, des relations avec les employé·es ou de la paie

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience dans le traitement des processus de nouvelles recrues et des tâches administratives
- Connaissances de base du droit du travail et des pratiques en matière de RH et de paie

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.
