A critical piece of this support is ensuring the highest level of initial quality and ongoing support from our suppliers.

As a Supplier Quality Engineer you will interface with AWS Engineering teams, Procurement teams, Commissioning teams and suppliers to manage infrastructure equipment quality. Our Supplier Quality Engineer is responsible for supplier qualifications, quality monitoring at supplier sites, supplier quality issue resolution and supplier development and quality improvement initiatives.
If you want to be a part of a team that has a daily impact on company success, this is a great opportunity for you.

In this role you will lead internal and external engagements with engineering, procurement, supply chain management, operations, finance, construction, and suppliers to deliver robust and resilient quality systems at our vendors and within AWS. You will identify supplier quality defects or waste in AWS processes, and drive new processes to eliminate the defects and prevent them from recurring without posing risk to availability. You will be responsible for developing the suppliers to bring them up to the AWS quality standards
who build custom infrastructure electrical, electro-mechanical and security equipment for AWS. Sr. Supplier Quality Engineers will work closely with AWS product development and engineering teams and with infrastructure equipment vendors to monitor and improve the incoming quality of AWS equipment.


Keys to success in this role include sound judgment and excellent written/verbal communication skills.
Travel required, both international and domestic, approximately 30-50%

Key job responsibilities
In this role you will:
-Develop, implement and maintain the supplier quality roadmap across engineering and procurement teams.
-Verify AWS quality standards are met at suppliers through in-person and remote audits.
-Define and roll out incoming inspection/first article inspection plans
-Drive supplier and product qualification and assessment processes in support of procurement teams. This includes effective resolution of any issues identified.
-Monitor and report on supplier performance quality metrics and actions. Lead supplier quality issue resolution in partnership with engineering, construction and commissioning teams.
-Develop and support suppliers with quality improvement initiatives and Key Performance Indicators (KPI). Provide a feedback mechanism from suppliers to internal teams on joint quality issues. Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

title: Overnight Staff Pharmacist , Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that
prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the
medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided
customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service
support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products
that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online
pharmacy.

We are looking for a Staff Pharmacist to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for
customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they
need to get and stay healthy!

#everydaybetter


Key job responsibilities
• Perform clinical data review, prescription verification, and virtual patient consultations in
compliance with state and federal regulations
• Manage end-to-end prescription fulfillment process, including dispensing medications
using automated systems (Parata Max2) and manual fill
• Package and prepare prescriptions for shipment or site injection, including handling of
specialized medications (refrigerated and bulk items)
• Maintain strict quality standards and safety protocols while meeting Critical Pull Times
(CPT) and production targets
• Split time effectively between prescription verification and fulfillment duties based on
operational needs and customer centric volume
• Perform thorough DUR (Drug Utilization Review) and ensure accurate documentation in
pharmacy systems
• Monitor, receive, and manage pharmacy inventory effectively and compliantly
• Work collaboratively with pharmacy technicians and other pharmacists to maintain
efficient workflow
• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced
environment
• Support operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement efforts
• Identify and report quality or safety concerns promptly while maintaining compliance with
all regulatory requirements
• Complete daily operational tasks including processing returns, medication rejects,
therapeutic substitutions, and canister approvals

Physical Requirements:
During Peak/high demand, shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 8-10 hours)
• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists
• Walking throughout the Amazon building for various reasons such as injections and inventory receive

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Science, or Doctor of Pharmacy in PharmD, or Doctor of Pharmacy
- Knowledge of pharmacy laws and federal/state regulations concerning patient care
- Can demonstrate proficiency with basic computer functions and pharmacy systems
- Can have an active and unrestricted pharmacist license in your state of employment (additional licenses may be required)

Preferred qualifications

- Exemplary interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality

Amazon is expanding the Data Center management team in India. This position serves as the primary operational resource to support ADSIPL within its owned and operated Data Centers in India. This position will provide a central point of ownership and accountability for the overall ‘hands-on’ management of the Mechanical, Electrical (M&E) and across ADSIPL’s portfolio of Data Centers in India. This position will be responsible for the overall operation and maintenance of the critical infrastructure supporting IT operations within the Indian Data Center space. It will also include event management, incident management, problem management, change management, and cost/contract management. In addition, this will include the relationship management with the landlords, critical facility vendors, Data Center Construction team, Data Center Operations team, Technical Program Managers, Security team, and Logistics team in India. The position will require 24x7 on-call, scheduled weekend work support and rotational shift. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.

Key job responsibilities

Operations and Maintenance:
· Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
· Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
· Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
· Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
· Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
· Develop a complete, deep knowledge of the design intent, operational alternatives and contingency plans related to all Data Center systems.
· Manage the engineering aspects of the Data Centers related to financial and cost control, code and regulatory compliance, personnel management, staff training and development
· Health & Safety, local statutory requirements, environmental and energy management.
· Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
· Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
· Providing hands on facility support where required (e.g. installation of new equipment, decommissioning of equipment, replacement of faulty equipment, internal audits…etc.)
· Oversee technical compliance auditing and the effective and timely close out of corrective action plans. Perform annual operational reviews with a focus on compliance with the Amazon standards and all applicable regulatory requirements. (Audits).

o Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.

o Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.

title: Manager, Robotics Data Collection Ops, Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR)
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in solving the most critical operations problem behind cutting-edge robotics development? Interested in a fast dynamic environment? Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems through frontier foundation models, and high-quality data collection is a core input to that research. Come lead the data operations team that produces the ground-truth data our models learn from.

We are looking for a Manager of Robotics Data to manage the shift of our data collection operation in San Francisco. You will manage a 20–30-person team of data collectors, own delivery and process for the shift, and ensure quality and throughput targets are met. You will be responsible for identifying the key initiatives to increase capacity and efficiency of the team, and partner with engineering, DC tech leads and researchers closely to deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Set the team's priorities for the Data Ops team. Own the team's throughput, quality, and safety metrics. Work with the team to deep-dive technical and operational issues that impact data productivity. Build mechanisms for taking corrective actions.
- Partner with 3P to mentor and coach data collectors. Own data delivery, key initiatives, and process improvement.
- Serve as an essential point of contact for the Data Flywheel team. Interact with researchers, software and hardware engineers, and the Ops team on prioritization and project execution.
- Manage daily floor operations: staffing, work allocation, and escalation of issues on robotics. Create reports and track project/process metrics.
- Capacity planning and build capacity: Forecast the demand of the data based on research plan, plan for the ops capacity, and identify bottleneck
- Identify repetitive problems from data operations and initiate new technical and operational programs to de-bottleneck the issues systematically.
- Drive process optimization and improvement projects in quality and productivity across the data collection workflow. Partner with cross-functional teams and DC Tech Leads to improve tooling and processes.
- Partner with vendors on managing the 3P team. Review vendor performance at regular cadence and ensure productivity and quality deliverables are met.
- Manage expectations of multiple stakeholders across teams within the program. Present team metrics and write-ups in business review meetings.
- Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members, including conversion of high-performing contractors to full-time roles.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of people management and team development experience
- Experience with continuous improvement processes
- 5+ years of operations experience
- Familiarity with standard desktop tools (Word, Excel) and the ability to create reports and track metrics
- Strong technical and non-technical program management
- Strong entrepreneur ownership, willingness to meet daily deadlines in an ever changing and fast-paced environment

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
- A bachelor's degree in any field (STEM preferred but not required)
- Experience managing robotics, data, or ML data operations teams
- Excellent verbal and written communication; strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Strong people-management skills and the ability to lead by example and adapt to dynamic requirements

descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in solving the most critical operations problem behind cutting-edge robotics development? Interested in fast dynamic environment? Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems through frontier foundation models, and high-quality data collection is a core input to that research.


Key job responsibilities
Own the technical execution and continuous improvement of early-stage data collection for advanced robotics. Partner with researchers to translate research objectives into reliable collection workflows, improve data quality, and shorten policy training iteration cycles. Work independently within agreed priorities, providing hands-on technical guidance to data collectors and coordinating execution across research, engineering, and operations.

In this role, you will
- Own end-to-end collection iterations for assigned research tasks, from requirements and station readiness through pilot collection, quality review, and delivery of training-ready data. Coordinate dependencies and resolve blockers to meet agreed quality and turnaround goals.
- Partner with researchers to develop and refine SOPs, translating task objectives, failure modes, and evaluation feedback into clear collection instructions and acceptance criteria. Maintain version control and ensure collectors adopt changes consistently.
- Serve as the technical subject matter expert for assigned collection workflows, equipment, and tools. Independently diagnose complex issues involving robotics hardware, sensors, calibration, collection software, and data integrity; engage engineering partners when resolution requires deeper expertise.
- Provide critical technical direction and coaching to data collectors. Demonstrate correct execution, calibrate collectors against quality standards, and develop their troubleshooting skills and judgment.
- Assess operational and technical risks, including equipment readiness, unsafe conditions, data loss, and quality degradation. Determine when to continue, pause collection, or escalate, and coordinate recovery within established safety and technical boundaries.
- Own collection performance metrics, including usable-data yield, rework, station availability, and iteration turnaround time. Use dashboards and root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues and verify that corrective actions improve results.
- Lead operational improvement projects that reduce collection failures and iteration delays. Develop and implement reusable workflows, troubleshooting guides, readiness checks, and lightweight tooling, and drive adoption across relevant stations, shifts, and partner teams.
- Coordinate technical and nontechnical stakeholders, including researchers, engineering, operations, and annotation partners. Communicate priorities, trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly, and escalate issues that threaten delivery commitments.

Basic qualifications

- Can work proactively and independently, meet deadlines, and deliver on projects and tasks
- Bachelor's degree or above in Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or related field, or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)
- Experience diagnosing hardware, software, or process issues, using evidence to identify root causes and implement corrective actions
- Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, including the ability to assess risks and make sound technical decisions with incomplete information
- Working understanding of how collection quality, task coverage, and consistency affect model training and evaluation, with the ability to translate research requirements into executable procedures and quality checks
- Demonstrated ability to train and mentor others and communicate complex information clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including remote teams and colleagues who use English as a second language
- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and dependencies across multiple collection tasks

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in technical operations, engineering, technical project management, or a related role involving hands-on ownership of complex systems or workflows
- Experience developing SOPs, technical documentation, performance metrics, and process improvements, and ensuring their adoption
- Experience with robotics, teleoperation, egocentric video, or multimodal sensor data
- Experience supporting ML/AI data collection, annotation, quality assurance, or model evaluation workflows
- Familiarity with sensor calibration, timestamp synchronization, pose tracking, and data integrity checks
- Experience using vibe coding agents to build and maintain lightweight operational tools
- Experience taking an experimental workflow from initial pilot through repeatable execution across multiple stations or teams

title: Software Engineer, Worldwide Amazon Stores Finance Technology, Controllership Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's finance teams rely on financial controls to keep spending accurate and financial reports audit-ready. You will build the systems that automate those controls, catch errors and waste before money is spent, and give finance analysts fast, trusted answers through AI tools built on cloud services and large-scale data.

Key job responsibilities
- Build services that check purchase requests and orders against finance rules in near real time, then correct or flag issues before approval.
- Automate financial controls, such as reviews of fixed assets, leases, cost centers, open orders, so finance teams spend less time collecting data by hand and more time acting on exceptions.
- Build data pipelines on AWS, including Lambda, StepFunctions, Glue, EMR, DDB, and S3, that feed C-Hub/dashboards finance teams use during month-end close and audit reviews.
- Build AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with the Strands SDK, including MCP tools, context and memory management, evaluation, harnesses, and guardrails that keep finance answers accurate.
- Big data experience with Spark, StarRocks, or similar OLAP engines.
- Build web applications and browser extensions in React and TypeScript that let finance users review exceptions, filter large datasets, and export results.
- Turn defined business requirements into technical designs, review them with senior engineers, and take them from prototype to production.
- Own your services in production. Write the tests, alarms, and automated rollbacks that let a change reach customers in hours, not days. Take part in on-call rotation.
- Work directly with finance, accounting, product, and data science partners, and explain technical tradeoffs.

A day in the life
Most of your day goes to building. You might start by looking into an alarm from an overnight data job that feeds a finance control. Then you meet an accounting partner to design how a manual review could run automatically. After lunch, you write code and tests and ship the change through an automated pipeline the same day. Some weeks, you test a new AI model against an evaluation set to see if it gives better answers. Near month-end close, you answer finance users who want to know why a control flagged a transaction.

About the team
We are a team of software engineers who build the tools that keep Amazon's spending accurate and its financial reports audit-ready. Our customers are finance analysts, accountants, and employees across Amazon who buy goods and services. We own our products end to end, from data pipelines and services to the web apps and AI agents people use every day. We ship changes through automated pipelines and measure our work by the manual effort and errors we remove. We value clear writing, careful reviews, and engineers who ask why a process exists before they automate it.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Knowledge of machine learning model architecture and inference
- Knowledge of computer architecture, operating systems, and parallel computing
- Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

title: Principal Product Manager - Tech, News, Prime Video Global App Experience
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop destination for premium video in one app, available on thousands of devices worldwide. Alongside movies, series, and live sports, Prime Video is becoming a place customers come every day to stay informed, and we're investing in News to make that happen.

Our News program is early. We launched a dedicated News experience this year and are moving quickly, but much of what this product could become is still unbuilt. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead Prime Video's effort to become the best place to watch video news. The work feels like a startup inside a larger business. You'll have the room to define a new category for Prime Video, along with the scale, data, and technology to reach millions of customers.

You'll own the strategy for growing customers' awareness of news on Prime Video and making it a daily habit. You'll set ambitious goals and run the programs that deliver them. A central part of the work is inventing AI-powered news features that inform and engage customers. You'll partner directly with applied scientists and engineers to build them, turning user research and data into the experience customers see on screen. You'll study the competitive landscape closely so that Prime Video sets the bar for video news streaming instead of following it.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who is highly analytical, customer obsessed, and comfortable with ambiguity. You have a track record of taking a new product area from early traction to scale. You're fluent in AI/ML and generative AI, and you can weigh in on technical trade-offs with scientists and engineers. You influence senior stakeholders through clear writing and sound judgment, and you can bring hotly debated topics to a decision. Experience in news or digital media is a strong plus.

Key job responsibilities
- Define the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for news on Prime Video, and the metrics that measure customer awareness, engagement, and daily habit.
- Set ambitious, measurable goals for news growth, and drive the programs and feature launches that deliver them.
- Invent AI-powered news experiences that help customers stay informed in ways they can't get elsewhere.
- Partner directly with applied scientists and software engineers to frame problems, evaluate model and technology choices, and make trade-offs between quality, speed, and cost.
- Build a deep understanding of news customers through user research, experimentation, and data analysis, and translate those insights into product requirements and design direction.
- Continuously benchmark against best-in-class news and video experiences, track emerging industry trends, and use those insights to inform Prime Video's approach.
- Write clear product narratives and requirements that align senior leaders and cross-functional partners, and bring contentious decisions to resolution.
- Drive launches across teams inside and outside Prime Video, including design, content partnerships, marketing, legal, and operations.
- Shape how Prime Video meets the unique demands of news, including timeliness, accuracy, trust, and responsible use of AI.

About the team
Prime Video's Global App Experience (GAE) organization builds a simple, intuitive, fast, and personalized streaming experience for Prime Video customers worldwide, across web, mobile, and living room devices. Our goal is to make Prime Video a daily destination where customers want to come to watch their favorite content. The News team within GAE is central to that goal. We're building Prime Video into the place customers turn every day to stay informed. The team combines the energy of an early-stage startup with GAE's global reach and Amazon's investments in AI. We work closely with science, engineering, design, and content partners to experiment fast, learn from customers, and scale what works.

- 4+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience technical product management
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience with AI/ML technologies

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in a technical field, or Master of Business Administration
- Experience with machine learning (ML) tools and methods
- Experience reviewing user research and data to build a strategic and user-friendly design
- 5+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience

title: Network Services Specialist Solution Architect, AGS-EMEA-Europe South
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about enterprise networking, edge computing, and content delivery? Do you enjoy helping customers design high-performance, secure network architectures that connect their workloads to the world? Come join us!

At Amazon, we've invested deeply in building a resilient, secure, and globally distributed network in the cloud. AWS is looking for an Edge/Network Specialist Solutions Architect for our Europe South team, who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) helping customers design complex networking and edge delivery solutions spanning connectivity, content delivery, and perimeter protection services.

As part of the team, you will work closely with Europe South customers across all industry verticals to drive adoption of AWS Network Services, including CloudFront, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, Elastic Load Balancing, WAF, and Shield. You will act as a trusted advisor on hybrid connectivity, network security, application delivery, and high-throughput architectures supporting AI/ML, migration, and modernization workloads. Beyond customer engagements, you will create and deliver original content, including white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and presentations, to enable customers and field teams to fully leverage the strength of the AWS network from data center to end user.

Key job responsibilities
As the Network Services Specialist SA for Europe South, you will:
- Act as the regional SME for AWS network and edge services, advising customers on connectivity, content delivery, and perimeter protection architectures.
- Lead technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and hands-on workshops covering CloudFront, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, Elastic Load Balancing, WAF, and Shield.
- Design hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity, zero-trust network segmentation, and high-availability application delivery for enterprise customers.
- Support high-throughput architectures for AI/ML, migration, and modernization workloads.
- Create reusable reference architectures, white papers, and blogs, and present at Summits, re:Invent, and customer events.
- Partner with sales, service teams, and the field community to drive adoption of AWS network services across the region.

A day in the life
You start the day on a customer architecture review, helping an enterprise redesign hybrid connectivity across Direct Connect and Transit Gateway. Midday you run a workshop on edge delivery and perimeter protection, then partner with an account team to unblock a migration networking design. In the afternoon you write a reference architecture for high-throughput AI/ML connectivity and prepare a talk for an upcoming customer event. You work across engineering teams and VP-level stakeholders.

About the team
The Europe South Specialist SA team helps customers get the most from the AWS global network, from data center to end user. We are deep technical experts who pair closely with customers and account teams on their most complex networking and edge challenges. We value hands-on building, original technical content, and customer obsession. We learn fast, share openly, and help each other grow in a collaborative, high-trust environment.

Basic qualifications

- Deep expertise in CDN and Edge Services Hands-on experience with content delivery networks (CloudFront or equivalent), edge compute (Lambda@Edge, CloudFront Functions), Global Accelerator, and perimeter protection architectures (WAF, Shield, Firewall Manager).
- Enterprise networking architecture Advanced knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud networking: Direct Connect (including 100+ Gbps), Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, VPN, and BGP routing.
- Network security and zero-trust design Expertise in network segmentation, PrivateLink, VPC Lattice, security groups, NACLs, and micro-segmentation patterns.
- Application delivery and load balancing Deep understanding of Elastic Load Balancing (ALB, NLB, GWLB), origin architectures, TLS termination, health checking patterns, and high-availability application delivery across regions and edge locations.
- Performance optimization and troubleshooting Ability to diagnose and resolve complex latency, throughput, and connectivity issues across distributed architectures.
- Customer-facing technical leadership Proven ability to lead architectural workshops, deliver technical presentations at events (Summits, re:Invent, customer days), write technical blogs, and create reusable reference architectures. Comfortable presenting to both engineering teams and VP/C-level audiences.

Preferred qualifications

- AI/ML and high-throughput workload connectivity Understanding of network requirements for AI/ML training, fine-tuning, and inference workloads, including high-capacity DX provisioning, placement group networking, EFA, and low-latency connectivity to GPU/Trainium clusters.
- Migration and modernization networking Experience designing network foundations for large-scale cloud migrations (VMware, Oracle, SAP), including DX + TGW bridge connectivity, DNS migration, IP address management, and hybrid routing during cutover periods.

descriptionHtml:
Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA) is responsible for maintaining and raising the trust bar for Amazon customers across 30+ Devices and Services. We offer horizontal services for builders to ensure trust, privacy, and accessibility is built into our products and services. We also build customer-facing capabilities that provide customers with control and transparency while reducing trust risks, and enable partner teams to innovate with appropriate guardrails for privacy, safety and appropriateness, creative content, fairness, veracity, security, and accessibility.

As we expand our scope into trust incident response and crisis management, we are growing the team to address trust risks across our devices and services portfolio. The TPA team is seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will manage incident response for high-severity, trust-impacting events, from intake through containment, mitigation, and closure, operating the mechanisms, playbooks, and metrics that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident manager during active events, drive escalations with urgency, keep stakeholders aligned, and write clear briefs for senior leadership. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and partners with our US-based incident leads to sustain continuous, cross-time-zone coverage.

A successful candidate will have a strong background driving cross-functional programs, solid program-management, technical problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You should understand systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and support sound decisions, derive insights from complex data, write clear business documents, and hold partner teams accountable to shared commitments through to closure. The ability to stay detail-oriented and decisive under pressure will be critical to success in this role.

- Set up incident rooms for high-severity events; triage, classify, escalate, and coordinate response under pressure using established severity matrices.
- Partner with engineering and product stakeholders to understand system architecture, data flows, and design trade-offs, ensuring remediation meets scalability, performance, and operational standards.
- Drive root-cause analysis and post-mortems (correction-of-error), track corrective and preventative actions across Engineering and Product through to closure, and prepare incident narratives, escalation briefs, and status updates for leadership.

You start your day triaging newly reported issues across trust surfaces and picking up open incidents and corrective actions. During an active event you step into the incident-manager role: classify severity, coordinate the response, assign clear ownership for each action, and keep every item moving to closure within SLA. Between events you run post-incident reviews, keep playbooks and dashboards current, and partner with Engineering and Product to embed trust-by-design practices upstream. You collaborate across trust, privacy, accessibility, security, engineering, legal, and product teams to drive these programs from intake to resolution.

About the team
Our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function sits within Devices & Services Trust, Privacy and Accessibility (TPA), building the programs and services at Amazon scale that grow customer trust, create mechanisms to meet evolving regulatory objectives, and ensure our partners can fulfill their trust obligations without disruption. We run a single, consistent, always-on operating model for high-severity, trust-impacting events: detection, coordination, containment, and crisis response. This is a newly expanded area of investment, so it is a great time to join and help shape how we build out this capability. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and operational rigor, and we support new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にあるワークロードをAWSへのマイグレーションを支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的に加速できるようにプロジェクトをリードするCloud Infra Architectを募集しています。
お客様の業務を支える基幹システムはビジネスを支える重要なシステムです。多くの企業において、こうしたシステムは、オンプレミス環境で稼働しています。こうしたシステムは安定かつ堅剛である一方で、定常的な運用コスト負荷、短期間で変化するビジネスニーズへの柔軟な対応が容易でないなどが課題になっています。従来のアプリケーション資産をクラウドへマイグレーションし、継承しモダナイズすることでビジネスに俊敏性と持続性を実現化することは大きなチャレンジです。しかし、移行・モダナイズされたアプリケーションアセットを Amazon Web Services(AWS) のマネージドサービス上で動かすことは、単なるプラットフォームやアプリケーションアセットの刷新にとどまらない、お客様の未来を作る仕事です。マイグレーションとモダナイゼーションによってコスト削減、効率化が実現すれば、生成AIなどの最新の技術サービスの活用による新しいアプリケーション開発と新しいビジネスサービスのプロダクトリリースなどの長期的な好循環と価値の享受が期待できます。このようなお客様のビジネストランスフォーメーションの実現を支援するのが Cloud Infra Consultant です。オンプレミス環境の知識と経験を持ち、これらの上で稼働する様々なワークロードのクラウドへのマイグレーションとモダナイゼーションに経験、興味のある方を求めています。


Key job responsibilities
当ポジションのコンサルタントは、お客様とパートナーのオンプレミス環境と稼働するワークロードの評価、計画、動員、設計、実行を支援します。AWS ProServeのコンサルタントは、スケーラブルな移行・モダナイゼーション手法と自動化ツール技術をエンゲージメント全体に適用することで、オンプレミス環境よりクラウドへのマイグレーションおよびモダナイゼーションを加速することを目指します。お客様の経営課題を把握しそれを実現する上で、現行システムのマイグレーションとモダナイゼーションの最適アプローチとそれを実現する全体計画の策定を支援します。また、関係する技術コンサルタントとともに、移行・モダナイゼーションのための最適技術手法や技術選択肢の決定などを支援し、お客様が AWS のサービスを活用してスケーラブルで可用性の高いアプリケーションソリューションを構築できるよう支援します。こうした支援を通じた市場へのサービス投入の短縮化やビジネスインパクトの大きなシステムのクラウドへのマイグレーション＆モダナイゼーションの実現はとてもエキサイティングな経験になるはずです。
お客様の成功のために複数の Professional Services のメンバーやAWS パートナーのメンバー、そして、グローバルの Professional Services を含む社内の多くの AWS チームや AWS パートナーと連携し、価値提供にまい進することで技術者としての成長も期待できます。

About the team
About AWS:
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- お客様先でAWSの代表として、顧客のプロジェクト責任者と情報共有や議論を進めるコミュニケーションスキル
- お客様、パートナー様、社内の他部門と連携しプロジェクトを進めるスキル
- データベース環境の要件定義・設計・構築・導入のハンズオン経験とプロジェクトリード経験
- データベース環境を含むシステムのオンプレミス環境→クラウド環境/オンプレミス環境等の移行プロジェクトにてアセスメント・計画・移行の経験
- ビジネスレベルの日本語読解・ドキュメント作成・会話力
- ***上記に加えて以下いずれかの経験
- 可用性の高いシステムの設計とソリューション化に関する実務経験
- 継続的インテグレーションプラットフォームの設計と実装に関する実務経験
- エンタープライズにおけるネットワーク、コンピューティング、ストレージ、コンテナを含むクラウド実装の経験

Preferred qualifications

- プロフェッショナルレベルのAWS認定取得
- データベース関連の認定資格取得
- データベースのオープン化などエンジン変更を伴う移行経験
- AIを活用したシステム移行の経験・スキル
- 基幹システムをクラウド環境へ移行した経験
- AWSサービスを利用したモダナイゼーションの経験
- 日常会話レベルの英語力

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Tririga Solution Architect, Close Systems
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable Financial systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top engineering talent get you charged up? If so, Amazon Finance Technology (FinTech) is for you.We have a team culture that encourages innovation and we expect developers to take a high level of ownership for the product vision, technical architecture,build a scalable,service-oriented platform and continuously innovate on behalf of our customers.

FinTech systems process large scale data sets eliminating several thousand hours of manual work for global Accounting and Finance teams. Our systems leverage the latest technologies from the AWS stack providing engineers an amazing opportunity to learn and grow.

We are looking for a Tririga Solution Architect with specific focus on real-estate leasing domain.Solution Architect who has expertise in end to end solution design,build and support Lease Accounting processes using Tririga.The Engineer will work across Amazon engineering and business teams and seek opportunities to automate and simplify Lease Accounting process providing enhanced user experience for our customers located across the globe.

Key job responsibilities
Collaborate with customers to work on Accounting Requirements documentation for new projects or enhancements/customizations to existing TRIRIGA workflows or creating new workflows, creation of Business Objects, Associations, near real-time integrations with source and target systems, Local GAAP to IFRS conversion, creation of new reports or enhance existing reports using BIRT and preferably AWS Quicksight. Enhance and simplify overall lease administration and lease accounting processes. Well versed in IBM TRIRIGA usage and preferably Tango. Optimize complex customization's and Integrations to enhance customer experience. Leverage AWS tech stack to build upstream/downstream integrations to data lakes. Define and enhance Operational Engineering excellence metrics and Engineering excellence metrics. Proficient in scripting using, Java, Python, SQL. AWS solution Architect certification is a huge plus.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Bachelor's degree
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective
- Knowledge of AWS services

title: Sourcing Manager - APAC, GND Sourcing
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Global Network Deployment (GND) organization is responsible for the cabling infrastructure, network hardware deployment, and program management across AWS data centers worldwide.



Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate will have a successful track record of creating sourcing plans, managing supplier performance, and working with a broad range of cross-functional stakeholders.
- Manage day to day operational processes for cable ordering.
- Work with a range of stakeholders including supply chain, operations, engineering, and suppliers to drive supply profiles and to support on-time material availability.
- Analyze business and technology trends to identify process improvement opportunities, reduce costs, and minimize risks for AWS and its customers.
- Manage material inventories for AWS data centers
- Evaluate and monitor performance of suppliers
- Lead cross-functional meetings with clear document writing, agenda creation, note capture, and follow-up activity coordination.
- Serve as an escalation point for teams to remediate supplier/material risks.


A day in the life
As a Sourcing Manger, you will play a crucial role in the procurement of goods and services in support of AWS data centers. You will work with teams across networking, design engineering, and data center delivery to understand project requirements and translate that into material needs to drive on time delivery for our customers.

About the team
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations experience
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- Experience in procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations
- Experience in strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis
- Experience with data analysis tools such as Advanced Excel, SQL, Tableau, Python
- Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process experience
- Experience in program, project, product management, or leading a product implementation process
- Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies

title: Prod Compliance Sr. Associate Turkish, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
**WE OFFER A 6-MONTHS TEMPORARY CONTRACT**

The Compliance Operations team is the beating heart of our customer safety practices. As a Senior Compliance Associate, you’ll set our product compliance standards high and ensure we’re always meeting them, never settling for substandard. You’ll work closely with a wide variety of Amazon colleagues and external vendors. In this role, every day is an opportunity to learn more about the complexities of compliance and develop into a subject-matter expert.

Key job responsibilities
Review and classify products on their hazardous risk
Uphold the highest customer experience standards by identifying and removing products that are not in line with Amazon’s policies
Collaborate with various teams and vendors to foster a culture of safety in your area of the business
Consistently analyse safety performance and use findings to recommend improvements

A day in the life
In your role as a Senior Compliance Associate, you will ensure that safety remains a priority for colleagues, vendors, and customers. Our Senior Compliance Associates are spread across the globe, from Krakow to Costa Rica. You’ll have flexible hours in a hybrid role, allowing you to balance your time between the office and home.

You’ll be a crucial point of reference across product compliance. From day one, you’ll be using your analytical skills and attention to detail to identify and address day-to-day risks, ensuring nothing is overlooked. You’ll always have safety on your mind, while building and maintaining positive relationships with vendors and colleagues. This role will see you facilitate effective communication, with everyone from leaders to new employees, so everyone understands their role in keeping operations running smoothly.

About the team
Compliance’s role is to work across Amazon to uphold global and local regulations, laws and safety standards. Some of our team work to import restricted products safely. Others spend time classifying products, making sure customers get the right safety warnings and understand any risks that may come with their purchase.
We take a long-term view of compliance. We use data, automation and world-class systems to make our customers’ shopping experience even better. Our team is based across the world, in regions including China, India, eastern Europe, the Middle East and South America. This way, we help colleagues across the globe stay safe and compliant.

The minimum base pay salary for this position is listed below. As a total compensation company, Amazon's package may include further pay components such as performance bonuses, where applicable. Your recruiting team will share final base pay and any applicable total compensation elements depending on skills and requirements.Company discretionary, supplementary benefits apply subject to further terms, including pension plans, health insurance, life and disability insurance, business travel insurance, MultiSport card, employee discount code and program (EDC/Extras), commuter benefits where applicable, and the Employee Assistance Program (private and confidential counselling and referral service to support health and well-being). The minimum base pay for this position is PLN 5833 monthly.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Turkish
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including your peers and leadership
- Experience working with the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) in a professional environment

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you. Understanding of product safety regulations
- Experience in client services, including developing client relationships
- Experience in data-driven business operations processes

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. The Learning Manager is a team player who not only leverages their own team to respond effectively to a variety of training scenarios, but can work closely with a central EU team to prioritise and deploy training programs based on customer needs – from training processes at scale to ongoing leader development.

An Amazon Fulfilment Centre (FC) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UAKPoAn2cB0 is a dynamic and challenging environment. title: Senior Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician, RME
descriptionHtml:
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team is central to Amazon's commitment to innovation. As Amazon evolves and adapts, this team makes sure that the tools and technologies we use do as well. As a Senior RME Technician, you'll help us stay one step ahead, adopting the latest technologies and identifying new and efficient ways of working. In this role, you’ll pay close attention to our processes to help maintain our high standards, and you’ll put in place upgrades to take that standard even higher.

Key job responsibilities
• Demonstrate best practice on using equipment safely and monitor teams to ensure everyone follows the correct processes.
• Keep track of equipment performance through visual checks, condition-based monitoring, and preventative maintenance tasks and schedule additional servicing when required
• Supervise technicians on shift to support their development and act as the first point of contact for Reliability Maintenance Engineers
• Solve issues in equipment to reduce downtime for operations so they can process packages as quickly as possible
• Support in finding ways to continually improve systems and standardize processes across the EU network

A day in the life
In every shift, you’ll be leading a team to make sure everyone has the equipment they need and that it’s running properly. That involves monitoring processes so that regulations and policies are followed and ensuring that preventative maintenance is carried out to increase equipment uptime.

With everything you observe on your shifts, you’ll suggest improvements to make our systems more efficient and productive and then implement those improvements across an EU-wide function. You’ll also be monitoring processes with tools like Scada to guarantee their performance, as well as working closely with your line manager to assist with admin tasks.

This role is located at one of our operational sites. You’ll work shift patterns, which may include some weekends and nights. As you develop your experience within this exciting part of Amazon, you’ll be well-placed to progress into more senior roles.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes or innovative tech like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, preventative maintenance procedures, blueprint and schematic reading, industrial electrical, industrial controls, industrial electronics, Programmable Logic Control (PLC) programs, National Electrical Code (NEC), work order management
- Experience using CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) to plan proactive maintenance and record reactive tasks

Preferred qualifications

- Associate's degree in Mechatronics or a related technical field
- Experience in vendor management
- Experience leading engineering teams as a mentor or tech lead
- Experience working with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards in accordance with OEM requirements

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. title: Senior Equipment Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Equipment Engineer to join our team in South Korea. This is the team's **first hire in country**, making it a foundational role with significant ownership and visibility. This role will provide technical leadership for automated test equipment (ATE) operations at our OSAT partners, driving excellence in test cell qualification and problem resolution.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and execute new test cell qualification and bring-up activities at OSAT partners

Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex issues at OSAT facilities

Drive resolution of sophisticated setup challenges involving thermal, electrical, and mechanical systems

Conduct comprehensive technical audits at OSAT partners to ensure compliance with quality standards

Develop and deliver technical training programs for new team members and OSAT partners

Review and approve test cell configurations for production release

Partner with cross-functional teams to optimize test cell performance and reliability

Lead continuous improvement initiatives for test cell efficiency and yield

A day in the life
As our first engineer based in South Korea, you will be the on-the-ground technical anchor for our OSAT operations in the Incheon area — a foundational role with real ownership and visibility.

A typical week blends hands-on floor time with focused remote work:

- **On-site at the OSAT (3+ days/week):** You start the day walking the test floor — reviewing overnight test cell performance, checking in on qualification or bring-up activities in progress, and acting as the first point of contact when the OSAT team hits a complex thermal, electrical, or mechanical setup challenge. You run technical audits, review configurations for production release, and partner directly with the partner's engineers to keep yield and reliability on track.

- **Remote days (work from home):** You focus on the deeper work — analyzing test data, preparing audit findings, building training materials for OSAT partners and new team members, and syncing with cross-functional teams across time zones (including colleagues in Israel).

- **Quarterly business trips:** You travel to OSATs outside South Korea (Taiwan, Malta) to support bring-up and qualification, or to Israel for training and team collaboration.


Because you'll be the first local hire, you'll also help shape how the team operates in-country — setting the standard for how we engage our Korean OSAT partners.

About the team
You will join Annapurna Labs' Equipment Engineering team, which provides the technical backbone for our semiconductor test operations across our OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partners. The team owns test cell qualification, bring-up, and sustaining engineering for the ATE and handler fleet that validates our custom silicon.

As a globally distributed team — with engineers in Israel and a growing presence across APAC, including Taiwan — we work hand-in-hand with our OSAT partners to ensure every test cell runs reliably, efficiently, and to spec. Establishing a dedicated engineer in South Korea is a key step in expanding our regional footprint and deepening our partnership with local OSATs. You will be the team's first presence in Korea, working closely with colleagues across these sites while building the local engineering relationship from the ground up.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with automated test equipment
- **ATE testers** — proficiency in at least one of the below:
- Advantest (EVA Scale, SmartScale)
- Teradyne UFP ("UltraFLEX Plus")
- **ATC handlers** — proficiency in at least one of the below:
- HonPrec Inc. (HPI) — 1028CH / CA, 9046LS
- Chroma ATE — 3160-H
- Cohu — EclipseX
- Demonstrated expertise in complex problem solving across thermal, electrical, and mechanical domains
- Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge in electrical engineering at practical engineer level is a significant advantage
- Experience with semiconductor test and handling equipment
- Track record of leading technical teams or mentoring junior engineers
- Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills
- Excellent communication skills in English; Korean proficiency highly desired
- Experience working with OSAT partners in Asia

title: Electrical Engineer, Sustainability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Sustainability Engineering team is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to drive the definition, development, and continuous improvement of electrical infrastructure standards across Amazon facilities in Europe.

You will join a team which:
• Enables EV charging infrastructure implementation through electrical design definition and review
• Develops grid infrastructure standards spanning high-voltage up to 24 kV (HV) and low-voltage (LV) systems, ensuring a coordinated and resilient approach to grid design
• Explores emerging technologies to address evolving sustainability needs, with emphasis on smart grid integration, efficiency, and resilience
• Drives end-to-end deployment of EV chargers and other sustainability technologies across European sites
• Defines processes for procurement and maintenance of electrical and sustainability infrastructure
• Owns cost budgeting, forecasting, and tracking across sustainability programmes

Possible locations for this role: Luxembourg, London, Munich, Milan, Madrid, and Barcelona

Amazon is committed to building a sustainable future for our customers, local communities, and the planet. Under The Climate Pledge, we committed to achieving net-zero carbon across our business by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement. To get there, we need driven people who are dedicated to making a meaningful impact through sustainable energy technologies and scalable infrastructure design.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and develop electrical equipment standards, including standard designs for core electrical infrastructure in partnership with manufacturers and internal stakeholders
• Perform design validation and review to ensure compliance with established electrical standards during installation and commissioning of infrastructure
• Act as subject matter expert (SME) for LV and HV (up to 24kV) electrical systems
• Align stakeholder expectations and define technical requirements for EV charging network infrastructure and smart grid deployments
• Drive the technology roadmap for electrical infrastructure, including EV chargers, substations, energy efficiency solutions, and IoT technologies (e.g. smart metres)
• Develop business cases and present recommendations to leadership to secure approval for programme scoping and investment decisions
• Coordinate with programme managers to ensure quality and standards compliance across large-scale installations
• Drive process improvement across commissioning, audit, value engineering, and cost control activities


A day in the life
Your day could include engagement with all levels of the organisation and multiple stakeholder groups to drive short-, mid-, and long-term technical decisions with large-scale impact across the Amazon network. You will also work with partners from Operations, Reliability & Maintenance, Health and Safety, Global Fleet Product, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to design and deploy electrical infrastructure across Amazon’s operational sites in Europe.

About the team
The Sustainability Engineering team drives the execution and deployment of EV charging infrastructure, grid connections, and smart grid solutions across Amazon’s European sites. We manage supply chain, procurement, and maintenance activities, and define the processes that ensure consistent, scalable delivery. To enable this, the team develops and continuously improves electrical standards and technologies that underpin reliable, compliant deployment at pace. We power Amazon’s sustainable growth through operational excellence and continuous innovation.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent
- Experience in Design/Innovation, research & development, manufacturing, process, industrial engineering, or related work
- Experience in management of engineering design projects
- Experience using business or technical software like MS Excel, MS Project, and CAD software

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
- Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making
- Experience working with the designs of complex automated material, handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems including robotics and high-speed manufacturing
- Experience with design-in-safety

descriptionHtml:

We keep the cloud running by supporting AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that give customers continual access to innovation. We solve complex problems with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain.

Work with Network Deployment and Vendor Management teams to integrate quality assurance into cable installation processes throughout the project lifecycle. You'll participate in reviews of training curriculums and cabling design documents, providing Quality Assurance representation to ensure standards are met during cable installation activities. You'll influence partner teams and cabling vendors to adopt quality assurance checklists that validate conformance to both Amazon and jurisdictional standards during critical milestone checks for cable installation and testing activities.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Computer Vision and Robotics, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Come shape the future of robotic sensing hardware by building the computer vision and ML systems that define how every robot in Amazon's global fulfillment network sees, senses, and understands the world. This is applied science embedded in a hardware development team where you directly shape what gets built, manufactured, and deployed at scale.

As a Senior Applied Scientist on the Amazon Robotics Sensing and Compute hardware team, you will be the ML and perception expert working alongside the Principal Applied Scientist and Principal Hardware Development Engineer to shape the future of deployed and scaled sensing hardware. You will influence sensor selection, compute architecture, optical design, and system level trade offs, ensuring the hardware we build is purpose designed for the algorithms that run on it. You will help define what the next generation of cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute modules need to be, and then prove it with data, experimentation, and production validation.

What makes this role unique:
-Embedded in the hardware development team, directly influencing what gets designed, manufactured, and shipped
-Partner with the Principal Engineers to co define the sensing and compute hardware roadmap for every major Amazon Robotics program
-Own the ML experimentation and validation that drives hardware architecture decisions for cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute
-Solve perception problems no other company is tackling: safety rated vision, multi modal sensor fusion, and real time inference on resource constrained hardware
-Ship to hundreds of fulfillment sites worldwide across autonomous mobile robots, manipulation workcells, barcode sensing, and safety rated human collaborative systems
-Your work does not sit in a research queue. It goes into production hardware that enables the future of Amazon Robotics


Key job responsibilities
-Partner with the Principal Hardware Development Engineer and Principal Applied Scientist to co define sensing and compute hardware requirements, ensuring ML and perception needs drive sensor selection, optical design, compute architecture, and system level trade offs
-Develop and optimize computer vision and deep learning models for robotic perception including object detection, depth estimation, scene understanding, and barcode recognition, purpose built for edge deployment on resource constrained hardware
-Lead ML experimentation and validation that directly informs hardware architecture decisions for cameras, depth sensors, and edge compute modules
-Design and execute benchmarking frameworks to evaluate sensing hardware performance across diverse robotic use cases, providing data driven recommendations on what to build next
-Optimize models for production edge deployment including quantization, pruning, distillation, and inference pipeline tuning to meet strict latency, power, and accuracy requirements
-Drive research and experimentation on next generation perception capabilities in collaboration with the Principal Applied Scientist, including multi modal sensor fusion, safety rated vision, and real time inference for autonomous and human collaborative robotics
-Collaborate cross functionally with hardware engineers, software developers, and robotics program teams to transition models from prototype through production validation and fleet deployment
-Contribute to the sensing and compute hardware roadmap alongside the Principal Applied Scientist, identifying where ML trends and emerging capabilities require new hardware architecture or sensor modalities
-Mentor engineers and scientists on ML best practices for embedded systems and production robotics
-Publish and present research to advance the state of the art in robotic perception

A day in the life
In this role you will work at the intersection of machine learning and physical robotics hardware. You will collaborate with hardware engineers to evaluate how your models perform on real sensors and edge compute, run experiments that directly influence what gets built next, and validate perception systems alongside robotics program teams. You will push the boundaries of computer vision for robotic applications while seeing your work deploy on real robots in real fulfillment centers. This is applied science with immediate, measurable impact at a scale no other robotics company can offer.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

About the team
The Amazon Robotics Sensing and Compute team powers a customer centric ecosystem built for speed, quality, and innovation. We stay ahead of sensing and compute technology, standardize reusable and cost effective modules, and pair them with deep engineering expertise and a robust supply chain. Every customer gets the right solution, whether off the shelf, rapidly customized, or purpose built, easy to integrate and ready to scale. We are a small, fast moving team of builders who own the full stack from optics through edge compute and take pride in shipping production hardware that enables every major robotics program in Amazon's global fulfillment network. If you want your work to matter on day one, this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience building complex software systems, especially involving deep learning, machine learning and computer vision, that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience with one or more deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent
- Experience with 2D and 3D vision tasks including object detection, segmentation, depth estimation, or point cloud processing
- Experience optimizing ML models for deployment on resource constrained hardware including quantization, pruning, or distillation techniques
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred qualifications

- PhD, or PhD and 4+ years of deep learning, computer vision, human robotic interaction, algorithms implementation experience
- Experience with robotic perception systems in industrial, warehouse, or manufacturing environments
- -Experience with sensor fusion across multiple modalities (RGB, depth, lidar, time of flight)
- -Familiarity with edge compute hardware and embedded inference pipelines
- -Experience with real time computer vision systems operating under strict latency and power constraints
- -Track record of transitioning research prototypes to production systems deployed at scale
- -Experience with safety critical ML applications or functional safety requirements
- -Experience collaborating with hardware engineering teams on sensor selection, optical design, or compute architecture trade offs
- -Experience with image signal processing pipelines and camera system characterization
- -Experience mentoring scientists or engineers in applied research environments
