title: Software Development Engineer II, Selection Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
Help Amazon understand every brand in the world and make sure customers can find the brands they love in our store. As a Software Development Engineer on the Universal Brand Catalog (UBC) team, you'll design and own large-scale data systems, AI/ML-powered services, and self-serve tools that show brand recruitment teams which brands are missing from Amazon and where to act. This is a new space with key architecture decisions still on the table, so you'll have real influence over the technical direction from day one. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle, collaborate closely with applied scientists and product managers, and see your work translate directly into wider selection for Amazon customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate scalable, highly available services and large-scale data pipelines (Spark on Amazon EMR) that process brand, product, and marketplace data across Amazon's global catalog.
- Own features end to end — requirements, design documents, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — and lead design reviews where you make sound tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, cost, and scalability.
- Partner with applied scientists to put ML models into production, measure data quality through precision and recall metrics, and iterate on brand-matching and gap-detection signals.
- Turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans, break large projects into shippable deliverables, and build self-serve tools that let business teams slice brand and selection data by market, category, and competitive trends without engineering support.
- Mentor junior engineers and interns through code reviews, design guidance, and pairing, while driving operational improvements in monitoring, alarming, and on-call health.

A day in the life
You might start the day at stand-up, then review a design document for a new pipeline that scores brands across marketplaces. Later you could meet with a product manager and a scientist to figure out how to measure whether a brand gap signal can be trusted, then turn that into a data model and plan. In the afternoon you'll write code, review a teammate's pull request, and help a junior engineer debug a Spark job. Your internal stakeholders include category and vendor management teams who use your data to recruit brands, partner catalog teams, and science teams.

About the team
The UBC team builds the foundation for how Amazon understands brands: which brands exist, how they relate to each other, where they're sold, and where they're missing from our store. We own Brand Gaps (finding brands and selection absent from Amazon) and Brand Cohort Management (grouping and prioritizing brands so teams can focus on what matters most to customers). Engineers and applied scientists work side by side on problems like signal precision, cohort ranking, and entity matching. The space is new and growing, so you'll have real ownership, see the business impact of your work directly, and grow through mentorship, design reviews, and a sustainable on-call culture.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Applied Scientist II, Prime Video - Ads Science
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Key job responsibilities
The science challenges include:
- Heterogeneous customer responses. The same customer responds differently to ads depending on what they’re watching, how engaged they are, and their broader streaming context. We need to understand and predict this variation to make better advertising decisions in real time.
- Signal sparsity in streaming. Unlike search or retail advertising, streaming offers no clicks, no conversions, and limited direct feedback. We must develop creative approaches to infer customer preferences, intent, and tolerance from indirect behavioral signals.
- Personalization at scale. A one-size-fits-all ad experience leaves value on the table for both customers and the business. We build systems that adapt ad load, placement, and content to individual viewers across 100M+ customers and 100k+ titles.
- Small effects, large variance. Ad interventions typically produce 0.1-2% shifts in engagement, effects easily overwhelmed by natural behavioral variance. Measuring, attributing, and optimizing these small signals requires rigorous experimental design and causal methodologies.
- Competing objectives. Revenue, customer engagement, long-term retention, and advertiser value are in tension. We develop principled frameworks to navigate these tradeoffs and optimize for sustainable outcomes rather than any single metric.

A day in the life
- Contribute to the research and development of ML models that personalize advertising decisions for 100M+ customers across 100k+ titles, with production deployment in mind
- Develop deep learning architectures (multi-task learning, embedding-based representations) for customer behavior prediction at scale
- Design and analyze large-scale A/B experiments, applying causal inference techniques to measure and optimize the impact of ad strategies on customer engagement and monetization
- Partner with engineering to ensure models meet production latency and scalability requirements
- Collaborate with product managers to frame business problems as tractable ML problems and translate findings into product decisions
- Shape the team’s scientific roadmap, identifying high-impact research directions

About the team
Prime Video Ads is pioneering the use of Generative AI, Deep Learning and Causal ML to empower the next generation of Ads experience in Prime Video. Our vision is to build the world’s most valuable and differentiated ad-supported streaming platform: one where every ad is relevant to the viewer, and every dollar spent by an advertiser delivers measurable results. We are seeking lead applied scientists who have demonstrated experience in advancing state of the art ML algorithms, particularly in Personalization, Relevance, Casual Inference and Gen-AI areas. Your role will be to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team is deeply committed to the safety and wellbeing of our people. WHS sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS site manager, WHS specialist, and occasionally the Wellness Specialist (WS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.
As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.
The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
• Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
• Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
• Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
• Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
• Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
• Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
• Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
• Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
• Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
• Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
• Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.
Additional Job Elements include:
• Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach.
• Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts.
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies.
• Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments).
• Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).

title: Sr. Product Manager (Bilingual - French/English), Alexa Canada
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about cutting edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, generative AI, and ambient computing? The Amazon Alexa International team in Toronto is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the expansion of Alexa+ in Canada. This is your opportunity to work on products that are making history!

Êtes-vous passionné(e) par les technologies de pointe telles que l'intelligence artificielle, l'IA générative et l'informatique ambiante ? L'équipe Amazon Alexa International à Toronto recherche un(e) Chef de produit senior pour diriger l'expansion d'Alexa+ au Canada. Voici une occasion unique de travailler sur des produits qui marquent l'histoire !

Key job responsibilities
- Define user needs and identify gaps, features enhancements and opportunities to grow the business
- Define creative, high-quality, simple product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision.
- Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the market landscape, customer needs, and
competitive dynamics in Canada across English and French locales.
- Develop detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that can be used to create product specifications and architecture for each product and application.
- Translate strategic vision into actionable plans and lead cross-functional teams to execute on priority initiatives.
- Own the end-to-end customer experience for Alexa Canada across Echo, FireTV, and additional endpoints.
- Track launches through every step—from experience review and packaging approval, to beta
testing, leadership presentations, and customer launch.
- Manage prioritization and trade-offs among customer experience, performance and operational support load.
- Continuous monitor customer experience performance, identify gaps and improvement areas and build improvement plan.
- Work closely with engineering teams and program management to deliver products to the market.
- Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team’s ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals


• Définir les besoins des utilisateurs et identifier les lacunes, les améliorations de fonctionnalités et les opportunités de croissance de l'entreprise.
• Définir des feuilles de route produit créatives, de haute qualité et simples, basées sur la stratégie et la vision de l'équipe.
• Développer et maintenir une compréhension approfondie du marché, des besoins des clients et de la dynamique concurrentielle au Canada, tant pour les marchés anglophones que francophones.
• Élaborer des exigences commerciales détaillées et précises ainsi que des témoignages utilisateurs pouvant servir à créer les spécifications produit et l'architecture de chaque produit et application.
• Traduire la vision stratégique en plans d'action concrets et diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles pour exécuter les initiatives prioritaires.
• Être responsable de l'expérience client de bout en bout pour Alexa Canada sur Echo, FireTV et les points d'accès supplémentaires.
• Suivre les lancements à chaque étape — de la revue d'expérience et l'approbation de l'emballage, aux tests bêta, présentations à la direction et lancement client.
• Gérer la priorisation et les compromis entre l'expérience client, la performance et la charge de support opérationnel.
• Surveiller en continu la performance de l'expérience client, identifier les lacunes et les axes d'amélioration, et élaborer un plan d'amélioration.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de gestion de programme pour livrer les produits sur le marché.
• Identifier et résoudre de manière proactive les problèmes stratégiques susceptibles de compromettre la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre ses objectifs stratégiques, financiers et techniques.


A day in the life
As a Senior Product Manager, you will have a wide set of responsibilities to ensure our customers are delighted, including launching new Alexa-powered devices and experiences and making Alexa continuously smarter. This role is equal parts business strategy, product definition, and program delivery. You will need to thrive and deliver results in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced, and dynamic business environment – operating at all levels of the organization. The ideal candidate will use a combination of outstanding analytical skills, cross-functional understanding, business judgment, technical expertise, and strategic thinking to define the programs that improve Alexa CA Customer Experience. You will work closely with many partners such as solution architects, engineering, marketing, content, business development, and legal to ensure customers have access to a world class Alexa experience in Canada.

En tant que Chef de produit senior, vous aurez un large éventail de responsabilités pour garantir la satisfaction de nos clients, y compris le lancement de nouveaux appareils et expériences alimentés par Alexa et l'amélioration continue de l'intelligence d'Alexa. Ce rôle combine à parts égales stratégie commerciale, définition de produit et livraison de programme. Vous devrez évoluer et produire des résultats dans un environnement commercial hautement complexe, dynamique et en constante évolution — en opérant à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Le candidat ou la candidate idéale utilisera une combinaison de compétences analytiques exceptionnelles, de compréhension interfonctionnelle, de jugement commercial, d'expertise technique et de réflexion stratégique pour définir les programmes qui améliorent l'expérience client d'Alexa au Canada. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires tels que les architectes de solutions, l'ingénierie, le marketing, le contenu, le développement commercial et le juridique pour garantir que les clients aient accès à une expérience Alexa de classe mondiale au Canada.

About the team
The Alexa Canada team's mission is to deliver products and services that are delightful and locallyrelevant for Canadian customers. We operate within the broader Alexa International organization, scaling Alexa globally while advocating for the unique needs of customers in Canada. Our work spans product launches and feature expansion across both English and French, ensuring that every Canadian customer experiences Alexa as a trusted companion in their daily life.

La mission de l'équipe Alexa Canada est de fournir des produits et des services agréables et pertinents à l'échelle locale pour les clients canadiens. Nous opérons au sein de l'organisation plus large d'Alexa International, en déployant Alexa à l'échelle mondiale tout en défendant les besoins uniques des clients au Canada. Notre travail couvre les lancements de produits et l'expansion des fonctionnalités en anglais et en français, veillant à ce que chaque client canadien considère Alexa comme un compagnon de confiance dans sa vie quotidienne.

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- French fluency is mandatory for this role. Do you speak, write, and read fluently in French and English?

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Vendor management is also becoming a defined programme rather than something each coordinator handles independently, giving you a clear area to own from the start. What matters is what you do with a process once you hold it: writing the run book a new joiner can follow without asking, building the report that answers the question before it gets asked, and automating the parts that should never have been manual.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage every work order, change order, purchase request, purchase order, and capital appropriation request end to end, tracking each against its published SLA and escalating exceptions early with a recommendation attached.
- Coordinate with Controls Engineers, Finance, Legal, and Procurement across APAC to land commitments that carry real money, including support for annual and mid-year operating plans.
- Design and maintain run books and process documentation so that workflows survive your absence and can be followed by any team member without additional guidance.
- Build reporting and automation that removes routine processing from people, using AI tools where they add value, and measure the before-and-after impact of every improvement you deliver.
- Own the vendor management programme for your region, defining consistent processes and partnering with global counterparts across a follow-the-sun operating model.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with your queue: the requests are yours from day one, and so are the blockers behind them. You might spend the first hour clearing purchase orders through their approval chain, then shift to refining an automation that shaves a manual step off the change-order workflow. After a standup with your Controls Engineering partners, you review an open vendor issue with Procurement and draft the escalation note. Later you pull together the data for a business review that senior leadership will read directly. Between tasks you are testing a new AI-driven dashboard the team is building in-house. By the end of the day you have moved work forward, removed a friction point, and documented what you changed so the next person does not have to ask.

About the team
The Program Management and Coordination team is the governance group within AWS Infrastructure Services that owns the planning cycles, goals, business reviews, and mechanisms the APAC region runs on. This is where process gets designed rather than requested. The team is eight people today, spread across Tokyo, Singapore, Sydney, and Melbourne, and everyone sits within the same Tech Ops Engineering job family — meaning the step from coordinator to programme manager is a genuine progression on a single ladder.

Our closest partners are the Controls Engineers running deployments, projects, service, and colocation across APAC, along with Finance, Legal, and Procurement on every commitment that carries money. We also collaborate with our counterparts in the Americas and EMEA through a global follow-the-sun model, so a process you improve once is improved everywhere we operate.

title: Software Development Manager, Amazon 1P Lending
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help millions of customers in Latin America get fair, simple and transparent credit? Amazon's 1P Lending team is looking for a Software Development Manager (SDM) to lead engineering for our lending products in Brazil and Mexico.

You will be the senior-most engineering leader for the team in São Paulo. You'll lead a team of Software Development Engineers that designs, builds and runs the systems behind Amazon's own lending offerings. These systems cover customer onboarding, credit decisioning, loan servicing, repayments, and integration with local partners and regulators.

This role sits where technology, financial products and regulation meet, in two of Latin America's largest and fastest-growing markets. You will work closely with Product, Risk, Finance, Legal and Compliance in Brazil and Mexico, and with engineering teams in India. Together you'll launch new products, grow into new markets and raise the technical bar for lending at Amazon.

We're looking for a hands-on technical leader with high ownership. You should be able to deep-dive into architecture and production issues, grow engineers' careers, and build a strong engineering culture at a growing site.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and grow the team: Hire, manage, coach and develop a team of SDEs in São Paulo. Set a high bar for engineering quality, operational excellence and Amazon's Leadership Principles.
Own delivery from start to finish: Take lending products and features from idea through design, build, launch and ongoing improvement, for both Brazil and Mexico.
Drive technical direction: Partner with senior engineers on architecture, system design and technical roadmaps. Build systems that are scalable, secure and auditable to meet financial-services standards.
Work across geographies: Work closely with engineering teams in India and partner teams in Brazil and Mexico. Align roadmaps, dependencies and launches across time zones.
Turn business needs into technology: Work with Product, Risk, Credit, Finance, Legal and Compliance to turn customer needs and local regulations into clear technical plans and delivery commitments.
Keep the systems reliable: Own the availability, latency, security and compliance of critical financial systems. Lead root-cause analysis and make lasting fixes.
Plan the work: Set yearly and quarterly plans for the team, prioritize competing demands, and balance new features against technical debt and operational health.


A day in the life
On a given day you might:

Review a design doc for a new credit-decisioning service with your senior engineers.
Sync with your counterparts in India on a shared launch.
Work with Risk and Legal on new regulatory requirements in Brazil or Mexico.
Hold a career-growth 1:1 with an engineer.
Dig into a production issue affecting customers' loan repayments.
You'll split your time between people leadership, technical guidance and working with business partners.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in engineering team management
- Experience in leading the definition and development of multi tier web services
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Research Scientist, RBS Tech
descriptionHtml:
RBS (Retail Business Services) Tech team works towards enhancing the customer experience (CX) and their trust in product data by providing technologies to find and fix Amazon CX defects at scale. Our platforms help in improving the CX in all phases of customer journey, including selection, discoverability & fulfilment, buying experience and post-buying experience (product quality and customer returns). The team also develops GenAI platforms for automation of Amazon Stores Operations.

As a Sciences team in RBS Tech, we focus on foundational ML research and develop scalable state-of-the-art ML solutions to solve the problems covering customer experience (CX) and Selling partner experience (SPX). We work to solve problems related to multi-modal understanding (text and images), task automation through multi-modal LLM Agents, supervised and unsupervised techniques, multi-task learning, multi-label classification, aspect and topic extraction for Customer Anecdote Mining, image and text similarity and retrieval using NLP and Computer Vision for product groupings and identifying duplicate listings in product search results

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Research Scientist, you will be responsible to design and deploy scalable GenAI, NLP and Computer Vision solutions that will impact the content visible to millions of customer and solve key customer experience issues. You will develop novel LLM, deep learning and statistical techniques for task automation, text processing, image processing, pattern recognition, and anomaly detection problems. You will define the research and experiments strategy with an iterative execution approach to develop AI/ML models and progressively improve the results over time. You will partner with business and engineering teams to identify and solve large and significantly complex problems that require scientific innovation. You will help the team leverage your expertise, by coaching and mentoring. You will contribute to the professional development of colleagues, improving their technical knowledge and the engineering practices. You will independently as well as guide team to file for patents and/or publish research work where opportunities arise. The RBS org deals with problems that are directly related to the selling partners and end customers and the ML team drives resolution to organization level problems. Therefore, the Senior Research Scientist role will impact the large product strategy, identifies new business opportunities and provides strategic direction which is very exciting.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 5+ years of quantitative field research experience
- Experience with big data technologies such as AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive etc.
- Experience communicating qualitative research methods and findings to non-qualitative researchers

Preferred qualifications

- Experience converting research studies into tangible real-world changes
- Experience with discrete and continuous optimization methodologies and algorithms

descriptionHtml:
Help millions of authors around the world get their books published, discovered, and supported. As one of the first scientists on our new team in Bengaluru, you'll help turn ideas into models authors rely on every day, building agentic solutions with large language models (LLMs), multimodal models, and fine-tuning.

- Build the multi-agent system behind KDP's author support assistant: orchestration across specialized agents and tools, personalization, and the evaluation that drives its continuous improvement.

Our team works in three connected areas: a support assistant that answers authors' questions from their own account data, in every language KDP supports; multimodal models that use book attributes to keep the catalog trustworthy and help authors reach the right readers; and fine-tuned models that power the assistant and catalog models with KDP expertise. We serve authors, from first-time writers to full-time publishers. You will work closely with engineering, product, and policy partners. We value safety before speed and shared foundations over one-off fixes. Scientists here get dedicated time for innovation, which can lead to patents and conference papers.

title: Area Manager, Operations
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

title: Spezialist/in für Arbeitssicherheit
descriptionHtml:
Arbeitsschutz und Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeitenden haben bei Amazon höchste Priorität. Unsere Safety Specialists spielen dabei eine entscheidende Rolle. In dieser Funktion sorgst Du proaktiv dafür, dass alle Mitarbeitenden an Deinem Standort in einem sicheren und gesunden Umfeld arbeiten. Du hast die Möglichkeit, jeden Tag einen Unterschied für Menschen zu machen. Indem Du proaktiv für ihre Sicherheit sorgst, gibst Du ihnen Zuversicht in ihrer Rolle und motivierst sie zu Höchstleistungen.

- Überwachung der Standortleistung anhand festgelegter KPIs und Erstellung von Plänen zur Verbesserung von Prozessen.

Du arbeitest vor Ort an einem unserer Logistikstandorte — einem Fulfillment Center, Sortierzentrum oder einer Lieferstation. Dort nimmst Du die Prozesse genau unter die Lupe. Außerdem entwickelst Du Schulungen und andere Programme, damit alle die neuen Sicherheitsprozesse befolgen und neue Standards erreichen.

About the team
Das Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung des mentalen und körperlichen Wohlbefindens unserer Mitarbeitenden am Arbeitsplatz. Unser Team arbeitet mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitenden und lokalen Behörden an allen unseren Standorten zusammen, um die Einhaltung der Amazon-Richtlinien und gesetzlichen Vorschriften sicherzustellen und die Sicherheit unserer Arbeitsumgebungen zu gewährleisten. Das Team bietet vielfältige Möglichkeiten — von Safety Technicians bis hin zu Programm Manager:innen. An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

Amazon is looking for ambitious, curious and versatile individuals to join our unique world as interns. We build the technology that powers billions of dollars in purchasing decisions, and we're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to help lead that transformation. In this role you'll help advance procurement from individual AI-assisted productivity toward an operating model where AI increasingly supports and automates processes, with people orchestrating, verifying, and governing the work. Key job responsibilities

An internship at Amazon means real responsibility from day one. You’ll build, test, and learn alongside people who want to see you succeed, while making an impact that reaches far beyond campus.

title: Sr. Tax Manager - WHT Controllership, Foreign Reporting and Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Tax Manager to lead the Controllership team within our Global Withholding Tax (WHT) organization. In this role you will bridge tax expertise, process innovation, and technology to solve complex challenges at scale, directly influencing how Amazon manages withholding tax compliance across markets worldwide.

You will set the strategy for how Amazon identifies, assesses, and strengthens withholding tax controls — evaluating and re-engineering existing processes, designing control and testing frameworks, and leading the global FAS-5 (ASC 450) process for withholding taxes on external-party payments. This is a people-leadership role: you will manage and develop a team of subject matter experts across global regions, operate independently in ambiguous, multi-jurisdictional environments, and influence partners across tax, finance, and technology.




Key job responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of withholding tax controllership experts across global regions.
- Own the design and execution of control and assurance testing frameworks, including differentiated approaches for intercompany and third-party payee withholding tax streams.
- Lead the global FAS-5 (ASC 450) process for withholding taxes on external-party payments, partnering with Accounting to document and assess accruals.
- Interpret testing outcomes, collaborate with Tax Planning and Compliance to agree findings, and oversee remediation actions through to closure.
- Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards providing visibility into control health, testing coverage, and remediation status.
- Drive the evolution toward scalable, technology-enabled controllership, including automated testing and AI-assisted assurance workflows.
- Monitor the controllership impact of regulatory and treaty changes, proactively updating control frameworks.


A day in the life
No two days look the same. You will split your time between leading assurance activities with your team, advising on controls for new market launches and system changes, presenting findings and improvement proposals to senior leadership, and collaborating with technology partners on automation initiatives. Throughout, you coach a globally distributed team and work across the boundaries of tax compliance, controls design, and technology delivery.

About the team
The Global Withholding Tax team is responsible for income tax withholding compliance and reporting for global intercompany and third-party payee transactions. The Controllership team provides independent oversight, assurance testing, and control governance that strengthen withholding tax compliance.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
- Experience analyzing and reviewing statutes, regulations, and case law and then extracting data to make appropriate recommendations
- Experience in taxation in a corporate environment, public accounting firm or major law firm
- Experience a direct tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
- Experience a compliance focused tax role in a multinational and/or professional organization
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field, or a Bachelor's degree or above and experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Experience managing training programs or teams across multiple sites or regions
- Extensive experience in progressive withholding tax experience, ideally from a large multinational or top-tier consulting/advisory firm (Big 4 or equivalent).
- Experience with treaty networks, cross-border withholding tax regimes, and income characterization and sourcing rules.
- Familiarity with SOX/internal controls testing, COSO framework, or similar control methodologies.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience within a multinational business and either legal or accountancy firm experience

title: Senior SAP Technical Consultant, Professional Services - SAP
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior SAP Technical Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). You will own the technical architecture and engineering strategy for SAP engagements across ABAP development, BTP extensibility, BASIS operations, and integration delivered within customer environments. You will lead multidisciplinary delivery teams of ABAP developers, BTP engineers, and BASIS professionals on complex SAP S/4HANA RISE migrations and modernization programs, establishing the technical standards, governance, and delivery mechanisms that produce secure, scalable, and maintainable SAP outcomes for AWS customers.

This role requires someone who moves fluidly between enterprise architecture decisions and hands-on technical problem-solving. You will evaluate solution alternatives, define development and extensibility patterns, resolve complex technical risks mid-delivery, and ensure ABAP, BTP, and BASIS workstreams operate as one integrated engineering organization across AWS teams, customer teams, and SI partners.
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities
Own the SAP technical architecture across ABAP, BTP, BASIS, integrations, extensibility, and platform operations on active customer engagements

Lead and develop multidisciplinary delivery teams across BASIS, ABAP, and BTP disciplines, establishing clear ownership, priorities, standards, and delivery expectations on every program

Define technical patterns and guardrails for SAP configuration, custom development, workflows, forms, reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, and extensions and enforce them across customer and partner teams

Establish and defend clean-core principles on every engagement, determining when requirements are addressed through standard SAP functionality, in-app extensibility, side-by-side BTP extensions, or custom ABAP and holding that line under commercial pressure

Own BTP architecture decisions including account and subaccount design, environments, connectivity, identity, security, application services, integration services, development standards, and lifecycle management

Lead BASIS architecture and operational design across system landscapes, environments, transports, upgrades, patching, performance, capacity, availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and production support

Establish software development standards covering solution design, coding, peer reviews, automated testing, documentation, source control, CI/CD, transport management, and release governance and embed them into customer delivery teams that will own them post-engagement

Partner with functional architects, customer product teams, and SI partners to convert business requirements into scalable technical designs and accurate delivery estimates

Review and approve technical designs across workstreams, ensuring solutions meet requirements for performance, scalability, security, controls, resilience, supportability, and cost

Develop technical roadmaps, architecture documents, SOW inputs, decision materials, and executive updates that communicate priorities, risks, trade-offs, and required investments to both customer and AWS leadership

Evaluate emerging SAP and generative AI capabilities including Kiro, ABAP Accelerator, and agentic testing frameworks and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, user experience, automation, monitoring, and support on active engagements

What Makes This Role Different

You are not maintaining a system. You are building the technical foundation customers rely on after AWS leaves. Every architecture decision, every standard you set, and every pattern you enforce becomes the customer's operational reality. The bar is high, the engagements are complex, and the impact is permanent.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
- 10+ years of SAP migration, implementation, or consulting experience in software or technology industries
- Experience as a technical lead or mentor on SAP S/4HANA RISE migrations
- Deep expertise in one or more of: ABAP development, SAP BTP, SAP BASIS, SAP integration, or SAP technical architecture

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture, and networking experience in customer-facing delivery contexts
- Deep knowledge of SAP systems including Business Suite, S/4HANA, BW, HANA, and Business Objects and their architecture and infrastructure requirements
- Hands-on experience with SAP clean-core design, including build using non-SAP technologies across Generative AI, agentic AI, and data and analytics
- Experience with ABAP Cloud, Core Data Services, RESTful Application Programming Model, Fiori, SAPUI5, APIs, workflows, forms, and enhancement frameworks
- Experience with SAP BTP services including Integration Suite, Extension Suite, Cloud Foundry, Kyma, SAP Build, Event Mesh, API Management, or related capabilities
- Experience with SAP BASIS and HANA administration across system landscapes, transports, upgrades, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, monitoring, and operational support

title: Program Manager II, AMZL Field Support
descriptionHtml:
Keeping tens of thousands of safety technology devices active and compliant across a large third-party rental vehicle fleet takes more than day-to-day upkeep, it takes an owner who can see the patterns behind the problems and reshape how the work gets done. You will own device compliance and operational performance for rental vehicles across hundreds of delivery sites, turning device health data into root-cause insight and leading cross-functional partners to durable fixes, not one-off corrections. This role brings that program under a single accountable owner, one person who runs the day-to-day operation and continuously raises the bar on how it performs.

In this role you will own the mechanisms that keep devices installed, accounted for, and active across the rental fleet: the recurring site and partner engagement, the case resolution path, and the operational reporting leaders rely on. You will go beyond resolving individual issues to analyze why they recur, designing process improvements that reduce failure rates at the source. You will work across field operations, partner, and support teams to align priorities and drive systemic resolution, delivering difficult cross-functional work independently and escalating when a decision falls outside established mechanisms.

The ideal candidate pairs operational ownership with program-management judgment: the analytical depth to turn recurring issues into root-cause insight, the influence to move multiple stakeholder groups toward a shared outcome without direct authority, and the instinct to simplify and improve the processes they inherit. You will thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you own outcomes, not just tasks.

Key job responsibilities
● Own the compliance program for the rental vehicle fleet end to end, keeping devices installed, accounted for, and active across hundreds of sites through the recurring mechanisms you run and improve
● Analyze case and failure trends to identify root causes, then design and implement process improvements that reduce recurring issues rather than resolving them one at a time
● Lead cross-functional stakeholder groups across field operations, partner, and support teams to align priorities, drive systemic resolution, and move compliance and device utilization in the right direction
● Own the operational reporting and device-health analysis that turn raw data into the insight leaders use to make decisions across rental fleet segments
● Identify risks and blockers early, drive crisp and timely decisions, and escalate appropriately to keep the program aligned with its goals

A day in the life
Your day blends operational ownership with cross-functional problem-solving. You will dig into device-health and case data not just to clear what is in front of you but to find the trend underneath it, then bring field operations, partner, and support teams together to fix the root cause. You will design improvements to the mechanisms you own, influence stakeholders toward a shared plan, and build the operational reporting that gives leaders a clear read on program health. Expect to move between focused analysis and the cross-functional work of aligning people and raising the bar across the rental fleet.

About the team
We keep the technology devices on Amazon’s last mile and middle mile fleets working, owning device repair, reliability, and availability so vehicles stay on the road. Our group sits at the intersection of field operations, data analysis, and vendor partnership, owning both the daily execution and the strategy behind a healthy device fleet. This role owns the rental fleet program at the heart of that work. You will join a team of program managers who take ownership of fleet readiness, dig past symptoms to root cause, and build fixes that hold up at scale.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Data Center Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for a Data Center Security Specialist II to serve as the primary physical security contact for an assigned data center site or campus. In this role, you will manage day-to-day security operations, oversee vendor performance, and ensure compliance with established security standards and policies. You will play a hands-on role in maintaining and improving security systems such as access controls, video surveillance, and intrusion detection — all while collaborating with operations teams and partner organizations to deliver a consistently secure environment. Our team is dedicated to safeguarding the data center infrastructure that our customers depend on around the clock. You also collaborate with data center operations teams to address emerging issues, document findings, and refine standard operating procedures.

- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: access-control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security

This role goes beyond coordination. You will apply security judgment to drive outcomes, close security gaps through code, and build automation that scales how we respond to security issues. You will think strategically, identifying patterns that point to systemic risks and driving proactive solutions before issues recur.

We are looking for security professionals who bring deep technical curiosity and the judgment to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. You will leverage the latest technology and tools to augment your capabilities, and you will partner closely with engineering teams to achieve security outcomes.

Successful candidates should:

- Exercise independent security judgment to assess risk, form informed opinions on severity, and drive engineering teams toward the right outcomes.

- Take a hands-on investigative approach to security issues, building deep technical understanding of risk and customer impact.

- Be technically proficient across security domains including network and operating system security, cryptography, software security, and incident response.

- Communicate complex security issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels.

- Challenge flawed analysis and escalate to senior leadership to ensure the best outcome for customers, even against consensus.

- Work effectively in AI-augmented workflows, using generative AI tools to accelerate security work.

- Mentor and coach junior engineers on security practices and professional growth.

- Drive security outcomes across organizational boundaries, partnering effectively with service teams and peer security teams.

An ideal candidate should be able to conduct most of the following:

- Close security gaps through code, working alongside service teams to develop and validate remediations.

- Navigate complex IAM and access control issues with confidence and technical depth.

- Build automation that improves how the team operates at scale.

- Think proactively, identifying systemic security themes and driving solutions that prevent classes of issues.

- Engage with cloud services at the architectural level, understanding how they work in order to assess and address risk.

Key job responsibilities
- Identify recurring security patterns across AWS services and drive proactive solutions that address root causes and prevent classes of issues.

- Build automation to scale incident response procedures, improving efficiency and reducing manual effort across the team’s global operations.

- Own and drive security issues from identification through resolution, bringing informed risk assessments and security judgment to every engagement with service teams.

- Independently reproduce and validate reported security issues to develop a deep understanding of the vulnerability, its exploitability, and its potential customer impact.

- Investigate and analyze security data across multiple sources to scope the impact of security issues and inform remediation priorities.

- Develop and validate remediations through hands-on code engagement, partnering with service teams to close security issues through code.

- Communicate the state of security issues to technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of seniority, up to and including the AWS Chief Information Security Officer. Escalate when the pace of resolution does not match the impact to customers.

A day in the life
As part of our follow-the-sun rotation, you will receive a handoff from global peers and take ownership of security issues presently in-flight. The issues could relate to any of our 200+ AWS products, so you will often need to learn on-the-fly.

Your first task may be to reproduce a newly reported vulnerability, working through service code and infrastructure to confirm the issue and assess the real-world risk. From there, you will analyze security data to understand whether customers have been impacted and determine the scope. You will engage service team engineers with a clear explanation of the issue, your reproduction details, and your recommended path forward.

As the day progresses, new issues will be assigned to you based on workload. You will triage them, determine their level of impact, and work toward resolution at the appropriate pace. For some issues, you will develop code-level remediations or build automation to address the problem at scale. Throughout the day, you will balance driving individual issues with identifying patterns across your caseload that point to systemic security gaps.

At the end of the day, you will document your work to allow the incoming shift to continue driving issues to resolution.

About the team
Cloud Response is a team within AWS Security Operations. This team is broadly responsible for the ‘AWS’ side of the Shared Responsibility Model, providing oversight of security issues from identification through resolution. Cloud Response operates follow-the-sun with teams based in four geographical locations.

We are evolving toward a model where our engineers are hands-on technical investigators who drive security outcomes through code, automation, and deep understanding of AWS services. We work with AWS service teams to ensure security issues are resolved with the right level of urgency while keeping stakeholders informed throughout the issue lifecycle.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, AWS Manufacturing Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking a Manufacturing Operations and Industrial Engineering Program Manager to help us fuel AWS’ explosive growth. This role is the single-threaded owner of factory layout and material flow design across AWS rack fulfillment manufacturing sites. You will work at the intersection of capacity planning, automation engineering, construction, and operations — spanning EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage hardware platforms in AWS manufacturing. Your work directly enables AWS to meet datacenter capacity commitments by ensuring manufacturing infrastructure scales efficiently, reliably, and repeatably across a global site network. Possessing strong leadership, influencing skills, and technical depth are critical elements of success for this role. This leader will establish manufacturing standards and publish process control guidelines to assure flawless ramp into volume manufacturing.


Key job responsibilities
· Translate rack fulfillment capacity plans into data-driven facility layouts for AWS manufacturing operations, designing end-to-end material flow from dock receipt through assembly, integration, test, and dispatch across EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage product platforms
. Design factory floor layouts including automation line stations, manual assembly zones, test positions, sub-assembly areas, burn-in, and repair workflows — determining optimal buffer sizing, automation vs. manual line trade-offs, and material handling system specifications (AMR/AGV routes, conveyors, ASRS) based on cycle time analysis, volume ramp curves, and product mix complexity
. Develop and maintain industrial simulation models (FlexSim, Plant Simulation, or equivalent) to identify bottlenecks, validate throughput assumptions, optimize material flow paths, and establish performance metrics including takt time adherence, buffer occupancy, and transport cycle times
. Coordinate utility and infrastructure requirements (power, cooling, network, compressed air) for each production zone with facilities and construction teams, ensuring infrastructure readiness aligns with layout phasing — particularly for high-density ML accelerator and Storage rack configurations requiring liquid cooling and high-power distribution
. Manage phased layout plans aligned with construction milestones, enabling production in early zones while build-out continues in adjacent areas; own layout change control, produce clear visual documentation (2D/3D layouts, material flow diagrams, phasing overlays), and develop replicable standards across the global manufacturing site network
. Drive continuous improvement and operations sustaining by owning the factory layout as a living document, partnering with Operations, Test, Process, and Automation Engineering teams to implement optimizations that reduce cycle time, improve throughput toward manufacturing-to-ship SLA targets, and enable rapid capacity deployment for new product platform introductions

title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager, Ring Business
descriptionHtml:
Ring's mission is to make neighborhoods safer, and businesses are an integral part of it. The Amazon Key and Ring teams empower customers to seamlessly manage access to their homes and businesses. We are looking for a results-driven Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own demand generation for Ring Business and build a repeatable engine that acquires new business customers at scale.

This is a builder's role. Business demand does not always exist, in many of our segments it has to be created. You will own the full demand funnel across both established and new channels, deciding where to invest, what to test, and what to scale. You will operate with an entrepreneurial mindset and a sprint-based approach: form a hypothesis, run a tightly-scoped test, read the data, and double down or kill it fast.

You will: i) own and execute the Ring Business demand generation strategy across the funnel; ii) stand up, test, and scale new acquisition channels; iii) run a rigorous test-and-learn operating cadence; and iv) deliver the reporting and insight that steers investment. As a senior individual contributor, you will set the plan, influence cross-functional partners, and be measured on business outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Own demand generation end-to-end: Build and execute the Ring Business demand gen strategy across the full funnel, from category awareness and consideration through to conversion, accountable for new business location growth and qualified lead/pipeline targets.

- Scale established channels: Drive performance across in-market channels (Amazon.com, Amazon Business, Search, paid media, retail), improving targeting, conversion, and cost per acquired location.

- Build new channels: Stand up, test, and scale emerging channels (LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, events, association and partner marketing, 3P-led / influencer content) to create demand where it does not yet exist.

- Run a test-and-learn cadence: Operate in sprints, define hypotheses and kill criteria, launch scoped experiments, read results quickly, and reallocate budget to what works.

- Develop and localize B2B materials:Create demand gen assets and adapt them to resonate across diverse markets and business segments (small vs. medium businesses), including EU localization.

- Lead market research: Plan and manage research initiatives (incl. EU) to uncover customer and category insight that sharpens targeting and messaging.

- Provide B2B reporting: Deliver weekly and quarterly business reviews (WBR & QBR), own the demand gen dashboard and KPIs, and translate performance into clear investment recommendations.

A day in the life
In this role you balance strategy with hands-on execution to drive B2B growth. You set the demand gen plan, then get into the detail of making it work. A day might include reviewing live campaign performance and reallocating spend, scoping the next channel test, briefing and localizing creative for EU markets, pressure-testing a targeting segment with the analytics team, and preparing the week's demand gen read-out for leadership. You work closely with sales, product, finance, and regional teams — and you are comfortable moving fast, making decisions with incomplete data, and owning the outcome.

About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- 6+ years of developing and managing acquisition marketing or channel programs experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

title: Strategic Marketplace Consultant - Dutch (C1/Native), Belgium
descriptionHtml:
More than 300 million customers shop in Amazon’s store, and every day, customers browse, purchase, and review products sold by third-party sellers right alongside products sold by Amazon. Since 2000, Amazon has offered this virtual shelf space to individuals and companies of all sizes, helping them reach hundreds of millions of customers, build their brands, and grow their business. Fast-forward to the present day, and these third-party seller products account for more than half of all units sold in our store.
With increasing complexity of today’s ecommerce and rise of opportunities, the Strategic Account Services (SAS) program aims to leverage the full potential of each Amazon Seller in our Marketplace. These sellers span a wide range of categories from fashion to consumables. Our team provides leading-edge strategic consultancy using a data-driven, collaborative, and customer-focused approach to support our Sellers to achieve their goals. Our holistic service offering addresses advice on all facets of the Amazon Marketplace including topics such as International expansion, Portfolio Optimization, Fulfillment Strategy, Product Presentation, Promotions, Advertising Strategy and Brand Building. In parallel to this strategic support, all Sellers integrated receive enhanced operational support by a separate team.
As a Marketplace Consultant, you strategically consult your own portfolio of Sellers independently. Your objective is to support and drive their business growth and program satisfaction by working backwards from their individual targets and developing a roadmap together. In addition, you will use your analytical know-how to proactively identify untapped potential of each Sellers. Additionally, you may also be responsible for recruiting and onboarding Sellers to this new service. You will work closely alongside colleagues in Europe, and have many opportunities to develop your career at Amazon.

title: Senior Security Compliance Specialist, Devices & Services Security Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Devices & Services organization is expanding into new markets and facing a wave of new regulations, including the EU Cyber Resilience Act. We are looking for a Security Industry Specialist to help us stay ahead of these changes by building and scaling the compliance programs that earn customer trust for products like Kindle, Alexa, Echo, Fire Tablets, and Fire TV. In this role, you will work across security, engineering, legal, and business teams to assess control environments, design compliance frameworks grounded in standards like ISO 27001, and drive remediation strategies to completion. You will also help reshape how we work by contributing to an AI-first approach to compliance processes. If you thrive on solving complex compliance challenges across a global organization, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

Key job responsibilities
Design and drive scalable Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) frameworks that address security assurance requirements for Amazon devices across multiple regulated markets, including new certifications and labels as the product portfolio expands.
Assess and mitigate security compliance risks by developing remediation strategies, tracking issues to resolution, and escalating blockers with actionable recommendations for leadership.
Collaborate with engineering, legal, and business teams to translate evolving regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act into control designs and compliance programs aligned with security audit frameworks like ISO 27001.
Represent Amazon in industry groups and with external regulators to understand and shape emerging compliance requirements before they impact the security and control environment.
Create repeatable process paths for security control design, testing, and validation that reduce duplicate effort and can be adopted by multiple teams across the organization.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing updates to an upcoming regulation and mapping its requirements against existing device certifications. Later, you could lead a working session with engineering and security partners to close a control gap, then prepare a compliance briefing for leadership. You will regularly engage with external auditors and industry peers, turning what you learn into practical guidance for internal teams. Mentoring colleagues and refining shared processes round out a day focused on protecting customers and enabling business growth.

About the team
The Devices & Services Compliance Team supports Amazon's consumer devices products, including Kindle, Alexa, Echo, Fire Tablets, and Fire TV, by setting a high security bar, ensuring regulatory compliance, and obtaining industry certifications. The team is investing in an AI-first redesign of its compliance processes and expanding its coverage as Amazon enters new markets and navigates new regulatory demands. You will join a collaborative group that values creative problem-solving and works closely with security, engineering, legal, and business partners worldwide.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience
- 7+ years of security, compliance and risk management experience, or degree in advanced technology
- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: access-control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security
- Experience working with multiple security frameworks and regulations like ISO 27001/2, HIPAA, NIST CSF

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AWS tech stack (e.g., AWS Redshift, S3, EC2, Glue)
- Experience working directly with security engineers, auditors, and development teams
- Consistent demonstration of utilizing automation and AI to solve recurring problems at scale
- Experience working with connected devices or related regulations (e.g. EU Radio Equipment Directive, Cyber Resilience Act, AU Cyber Security Act, etc.).
- Experience obtaining one or more of the following certifications/reports: ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, Matter PKI, HITRUST.
- Experience with hardware and software development processes, products launches and lifecycles of devices and/or services

title: Sr. Manager, Global SMB Ads Marketing
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Manager, SMB Global Performance Marketing leads the worldwide first-party (1P) channel marketing team and content strategy for Amazon Ads' Small and Medium Business (SMB) segment. This leader owns two critical pillars: 1) Owned and operated ("1P") marketing channels (email, in-portal nudges across Seller/Vendor Central, Ad Console...), and 2) Click Credit promotions strategy and execution. The role spans demand programs (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Brand Stores, and others), as well as vertical programs for Amazon Business and Authors.

Rooted in a deep understanding of SMB advertiser needs, this leader acts as the strategic bridge between customers and the broader Ads organization—translating pain points, behaviors, and performance signals into lifecycle marketing strategies that drive long-term growth. By combining customer and performance insights with business objectives, this role shapes messaging, influences product direction, and ensures marketing efforts align to advertiser success across their lifecycle. Success is measured through business impact: advertiser activation, retention, and sustained revenue growth.

As the team evolves toward an AI-enabled operating model in 2027, this leader will guide the transition from static campaign execution to continuous iteration—where Marketing Demand Automation (DMA) anchors end-to-end advertiser journeys, and marketers shift from hands-on execution to active system stewardship. This includes guiding strategy, defining business requirements, interpreting advertiser sentiment, and continuously calibrating outcomes based on customer satisfaction, engagement, and business impact.

Key job responsibilities
1. Owned and Operated ("1P") Marketing Channels
- Define and execute the worldwide 1P channel marketing strategy across email and in-portal nudges, driving reach, engagement, and attributed revenue at scale.
- Own end-to-end advertiser growth domains—acquisition, optimization, growth, and retention—defining problem statements, shaping strategy, and owning performance outcomes across the full advertiser lifecycle.
- Design customer-centric, experience-led marketing around cohesive end-to-end advertiser journeys.
- In partnership with decision science and mar-tech, define content frameworks, value propositions, and modular messaging that power 1:1 personalized experiences at scale.
- Own demand generation and performance, managing trade-offs between volume, quality, and Return on Investment (ROI) to maximize total business impact.
- Drive deep dive analysis and continuous experimentation.
- Lead the transition toward Marketing Demand Automation as the anchor of the operating model, shaping increasingly precise inputs and content frameworks to unlock scaled variation, personalization, and performance over time.

2. Click Credit Promotions
- Own the worldwide promotions strategy, including offer design, experimentation, and performance measurement, operating promotions as a key lever within Marketing Demand Automation journeys.
- Define and optimize promotional offer structures that incentivize advertisers to take actions supporting long-term changed behaviors.
- Drive continuous experimentation on promotional targeting, timing, and value to maximize incremental revenue and advertiser activation while managing ROI trade-offs.
- Converge promotions into a unified system across targeting, journeys, and messaging strategy, ensuring promotional offers are integrated within lifecycle marketing rather than operating as standalone tactics.

3. Strategic Leadership and Team Development
- Lead and develop a high-performing team of marketers operating as single-threaded owners across their respective domains.
- Guide the team's evolution from content creation to curation, system design, and business impact as AI scales execution.
- Serve as the strategic bridge between SMB advertisers and the broader Ads organization.

15+ years of work experience, 5+ years of management experience of international teams in a fast moving environment, MBA

Preferred qualifications

Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
