descriptionHtml:
The Frontier AI Assets (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Principal Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning and reinforcement learning background to build the training and evaluation assets that advance frontier Generative AI (GenAI) with Large Language Models (LLMs).

AI models become more capable largely because of the learning environments, the RL gyms, in which they are trained. FAI builds those gyms and the platform that certifies them, so that model training teams across Amazon can rely on high-quality, graded assets. As a Principal on this team, you will set the technical direction for how these gyms and the tooling around them are built, evaluated, and scaled.


Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Applied Scientist with FAI, you will:

•Set technical direction across data collection, sampling, and evaluation for RL gyms focused on agentic tool use across a range of real-world domains.
•Design and lead experiments that produce reliable, efficient signal on what drives model improvement.
•Build gym-building tooling and automated quality control that scale with demand.
•Advance the science of how gyms are evaluated and validated before they're used in model training.
•Act as a hands-on technical leader: produce exemplary, high-quality assets yourself, and audit and support more junior scientists and engineers.
•Partner closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams, turning real-world problems into challenging, high-value tasks.
•Lead scientific reviews, scrutinize experimental design and verification, probe assumptions, and align teams toward coherent strategies. Contribute to hiring, mentorship, and the development of other scientists.


About the team
The FAI team has the mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers. We build frontier training and evaluation assets, RL gyms and the certification platform behind them, that directly shape how Amazon's models are trained and improved. We value scientific depth, hands-on building, and turning research into measurable impact at scale.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; or Master's degree with significant additional applied research experience.
- Strong hands-on experience building machine learning models and systems for real-world applications, with deep learning and neural methods.
- Experience with reinforcement learning and/or building RL gyms, learning environments, or agentic tool-use systems.
- Experience setting technical direction across data, modeling, and evaluation, and dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives.
- Experience leading experienced scientists/engineers and developing more junior members.

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience
- Experience building automated evaluation, quality-control, or verification tooling for training data or environments.
- Experience with agentic tool use and improving the capabilities of LLMs (for example multi-step, tool-using agents).
- Track record of creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art; peer-reviewed contributions in premier journals and conferences.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Foundational Security Services, AFSS Identity
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to protect how Amazon's workforce signs in and accesses critical systems every day? Amazon Foundational Security Services is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build and operate the identity and authentication services that keep tens of thousands of employees secure and productive. You'll design and deliver distributed systems that handle real-time identity data sync, certificate issuance for corporate devices, and Kerberos authentication—solving problems where correctness and availability matter around the clock.

This role offers rare breadth across the identity space in one team. You'll work on workforce sign-in and AWS access, near real-time directory sync, a corporate certificate authority, and Kerberos authentication. You'll balance building new capabilities on AWS with modernizing long-running core infrastructure, all through a security-first lens. If you're ready to turn well-understood business problems into simple, secure, and maintainable code while learning from every incident and mentoring others, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build distributed services that handle authentication, authorization, and identity data synchronization, making sound tradeoffs between scalability, performance, and security
- Deliver software features across the full lifecycle—from scoping and design through code, testing, deployment, and maintenance—while actively reviewing code and providing meaningful feedback to teammates
- Participate in operational support including oncall rotation, monitoring and alarming, root cause analysis, and balancing new feature work against operational improvements to ensure services remain reliable
- Work with identity and security technologies such as SAML, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, Active Directory, Kerberos, and X.509 certificates to solve real authentication and authorization challenges
- Document how your services are constructed, tested, operated, and secured, and train new team members so they can confidently contribute and maintain the systems you build

A day in the life
Most days start with a short standup. You might spend the morning drafting a design doc for speeding up group membership sync for very large groups, then write and test the code with help from AI coding assistants. You review teammates' code and designs, offering constructive feedback. In the afternoon, you might pair with a newer engineer or meet with a partner team that depends on your identity data to understand their next requirements. During your oncall week, you triage alarms and tickets, identify root causes, and implement permanent fixes.

About the team
We're part of Amazon Foundational Security Services within Amazon Security. Our team builds and operates the identity and authentication services Amazon's workforce uses every day—from signing in and accessing AWS, to syncing identity data across downstream systems, to issuing certificates for corporate devices. We're based in Seattle and share oncall across the team, learning from every incident through structured post-incident reviews.

Mentorship is part of the job here. Engineers get broad exposure to identity, security, and AWS, and grow by owning real problems end to end. Whether you're ramping up on our systems or taking on harder, more ambiguous challenges as you progress toward Software Development Engineer III, you'll find a team that supports your growth and values operational excellence alongside innovation.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do.

As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.

We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.

Key job responsibilities
Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability
Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale
Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance
Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate
Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries
Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines
Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement
Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team
Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards
Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide.

The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. title: Support Engineer, Identity and Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a passion for protecting data and ensuring compliance at scale? We are looking for a detail-oriented Support Engineers to join our data protection team, where you will investigate access to Amazon's most sensitive and regulated data. You will independently review SQL queries, access logs, and large datasets to determine compliance with policies and standard operating procedures, making clear determinations that protect customer trust and data integrity.

In this role, you will combine technical investigation skills with stakeholder engagement, interpreting complex access patterns and coaching teams on compliant data handling. You will evaluate access requests against data-handling policies, document findings with clarity and precision, and escalate high-risk cases with sound judgment. This is an opportunity to apply your analytical expertise to meaningful work that safeguards data across one of the world's largest technology platforms.

Key job responsibilities
- Investigate access to sensitive data by reviewing SQL queries and access records to determine what data was accessed and whether that access is compliant with policies and standard operating procedures
- Interpret dashboards, logs, and large code and data sets to reach clear compliance determinations, applying analytical reasoning to identify patterns and assess risk
- Engage stakeholders and other Amazon employees to understand access behavior, remediate non-compliant practices, and share best practices that help them maintain compliance and keep data access safe
- Process access requests to protected data, evaluating internal use cases against data-sharing and data-handling policies to ensure appropriate access controls
- Document investigation findings clearly and concisely, articulating impact, the steps taken, and the current state of each case, and escalate complex or high-risk findings with sound judgment following information security guidelines

A day in the life
Much of your day is investigative work: reviewing SQL queries and access records to determine what data was accessed and whether that access is compliant with policy and standard operating procedures. Some investigations involve engaging stakeholders to understand access, remediate behavior, and coach them on compliance best practices. You will process requests for access to protected data, evaluating use cases against data-handling policy. Where needed, you will write queries to validate findings across datasets. As you build expertise, you will resolve cases independently and seek guidance from experienced engineers when cases are complex or findings are high-risk.

This role includes occasional on-call responsibilities.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We protect Amazon's most sensitive and regulated data by monitoring and investigating access to protected data. Our team is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of data security and compliance, ensuring that customer and business data remains safe and is accessed only in accordance with established policies.

title: Support Engineer, Identity and Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security Compliance Investigations team protects our most sensitive and regulated data by monitoring and investigating access at scale. We are seeking an experienced Support Engineer to lead complex investigations, set quality standards, and help the team grow.

In this role, you will lead high-stakes investigations that require advanced SQL analysis and pattern recognition across large datasets to determine compliance with data access policies. You will connect patterns others miss, engage stakeholders and their leadership to drive remediation, and establish best practices that keep internal customers compliant. You will own the quality bar for investigation documentation and access-request reviews, refine how the team investigates, and mentor engineers to elevate the capability of the entire team. This is a hands-on, investigation-heavy role for engineers who combine technical depth with sound judgment.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead complex investigations by reviewing SQL and access records to determine what data was accessed, interpreting dashboards and logs to identify patterns across large datasets, and reaching clear compliance determinations with limited guidance
- Own the quality of investigation documentation, clearly articulating impact, steps taken, and case state, and serve as the lead reviewer for content in your area of technical expertise
- Engage stakeholders and their leadership to understand access behavior, drive remediation, and establish best practices that help internal customers stay compliant with data-sharing and data-handling policies
- Evaluate access requests to protected data against policy, assess internal use cases for compliance, and identify recurring issues to improve investigation methods and standard operating procedures
- Act as a subject matter expert and technical point of contact for escalations, mentor other engineers on the team to raise their capability, and use data to identify and drive development of new support mechanisms and tools

You will lead the team's most complex investigations: reviewing SQL and access records to determine what data was accessed, connecting patterns across dashboards and large datasets, and reaching clear compliance determinations. You will engage stakeholders and their leadership to remediate access behavior and set best practices for staying compliant. You will own the review of access requests to protected data, evaluating internal use cases against data-sharing and data-handling policy. Where an investigation calls for it, you will write queries to validate findings across datasets. title: Senior Technical Program Manager, GDCO Central Intelligence and Analytics Team
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Technical Product/Program Manager to own a portfolio of these business-facing products and programs end to end: shaping what each one should do and for whom, driving its design and delivery with engineering, science and data technicians, and proving it changes business outcomes. This role is oriented toward business problems and the products/programs that solve them, not toward running shared platform infrastructure. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a system architecture or challenging a recommendations quality as presenting a roadmap to senior executives like VPs.

## The portfolio you'll own
- **Self-service analytics, to production.** Take our natural-language and SQL analytics product over the governed data lake from team tool to a production service leaders rely on: accuracy on governed metrics, onboarding new domains, reliability, access controls, and adoption.
- **Recommendation engine delivery and quality.** Deliver the AI-assisted recommendation engine from pilot to broad use, own its quality bar: what it recommends, with what confidence, when it should stay silent, and how we know it worked.
- **Business domain decision products.** Our operation runs on a few core business domains, each with its own leaders, metrics, data sources, and decisions. For each one, you'll own the product that moves a leader from "what's happening" to "what should I do about it": define the decisions it supports, the metrics and data it needs, and how we measure whether it improved the domain's outcome. Today that means: data products that cover repair backlog and aging, repair throughput and turnaround time, parts availability and other blockers, and repeat failures. The core decision is where to focus the effort so it returns the most capacity to customers fastest. Data products track deliveries from plan through install and hand-off, show what's on track, what's at risk, and why (parts, labor, facilities, network readiness), and route each blocker to the owner who can clear it. The core decision is which at-risk deliveries need intervention now. Success is more capacity delivered on its committed date.


Key job responsibilities
- **Own program strategy and roadmap** for each product/program in the portfolio, tied to a business outcome (repair turnaround, labor productivity, capacity on time), and phase scope deliberately from pilot to GA.
- **Define and enforce quality.** Set the bar for each products/programs, such as answer accuracy for self-service analytics or recommendation precision, confidence, and abstain behavior for the recommendation engine. Partner with engineering and science so no product presents correlation as causation or claims more confidence than it has earned.
- **Prove business impact.** Define how actions are captured, how impact is measured against matched baselines, and how outcomes feed back into the product. Success is not "recommendations accepted" or "queries run"; it's decisions that changed outcomes.
- **Run technical delivery with the engineering team.** Own the delivery cadence, sprint planning, and release management for your products/programs. Review design docs, understand the architecture well enough to weigh tradeoffs (build vs. reuse, latency vs. cost, coupling between services), and keep scope, sequencing, and dependencies honest.
- **Drive launch readiness** across security review, penetration testing, operational readiness (ORR), and privacy reviews for each product moving to production.
- **Lead cross-org dependencies** with Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Facilities, workforce planning, and peer data teams: write the asks, negotiate data contracts, and escalate when a partner dependency blocks the roadmap.
- **Write the narratives** (PR/FAQs, 6-pagers, pilot readouts) for Director and VP audiences, with honest accounting of what is proven vs. pending.

About the team
Our team is focused on building and delivering data solutions that drive meaningful outcomes for AWS and our customers. We operate in a collaborative environment where program managers work closely with engineers, scientists, and business leaders to tackle challenging problems at scale. We value clear thinking, thoughtful communication, and a willingness to take initiative in unstructured situations. If you are excited about shaping program strategy, influencing technical direction, and growing alongside a talented group of peers, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- - 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- - 3+ years of technical program management experience with a software application or software engineering team
- - Experience with software architecture and system design, including reviewing design documents and driving technical tradeoff decisions with engineers
- - Experience owning and driving roadmap strategy and definition
- - Experience shipping data, analytics, or decision-support products to business or senior-leadership customers
- - Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- - Experience managing software engineers, directly or as a technical lead
- - Software development experience
- - Owned a portfolio of several products at once, each tied to a different business outcome
- - Shipped ML/LLM-powered products to production, including evaluation design (golden sets, LLM-as-judge) and failure-mode analysis (hallucination, over-confidence)
- - Productionized a self-service analytics or natural-language query product, including accuracy measurement and access controls

descriptionHtml:

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Controls Colo Engineer, you will work with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability. You will provide full life-cycle support to Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

• Work in close relationship with the control team of DCE Colocation Design and Standards (CoDeS) to develop and implement new and existing standards.
• Perform design and equipment submittal review for Controls for new Colo Data Centers in the region in order to ensure consistent standards across Colocation Data Centers and AWS owned sites.
• Review and Identify risks within the scope of Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) for in-flight AWS Colo Data Centers.
• Review and identify risks within automation controls drawings and wiring diagrams, the controls logic programming and the graphical user interface.
• Review and accept proposed changes to the site-specific control infrastructure against AWS Data Center standards, and document accepted deviations when appropriate.
• Review Colo and Hybrid controls sequence of operation and provide feedback to design.
• Support the design for existing Colo Data Center control system upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures related to control equipment.
• Conduct site audits of Colo Data Centers, including producing reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.
• Support construction, commissioning, and turnover for Controls for any new construction projects (could be remote with local Colo Engineer presence).
• Lead internal team training and knowledge sharing sessions on Colo controls.
• Review and improve controls related processes, including quick reference guides for the team.

Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As a Controls Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out the data centers we support to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale.

descriptionHtml:
Shape the future of one of the world's largest energy enterprises by driving multi-million-dollar cloud and AI transformations. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a world-class sales professional to lead the North America business relationship with our major global customer headquartered in London — someone who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and executive influence.

As a Global Account Manager (GAM), you will partner with our customer to build strategic relationships, articulate a clear vision, and generate measurable business value. You will own and develop primarily Upstream, Production & Exploration segment within our customer, driving growth and enhancing satisfaction across multiple geographies.

Based in Houston, you will work alongside a high-performing team of Global Account Managers, Executives, Solution Architects, Business Development, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service teams, and Professional Services to execute strategies aligned with the client's needs and objectives. You will also leverage existing programs, innovate and scale new mechanisms, and develop formal case studies highlighting outcomes and solutions running on AWS.

As a Global Account Manager, you will drive digital transformations through effective engagement with C-level executives, IT leaders, architects, developers, and various lines of business. Being part of an EMEA team, independently you will establish AWS as the key AI and cloud technology provider and promote the entire AWS products and services portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
- Identify and build trusted advisor relationships with key influencers and decision-makers business (CxOs, VPs, Board members) across Lines of Business and functional areas
- Develop and implement comprehensive 3-year account strategies aligned to customer board-level priorities that drive growth and maximize revenue opportunities
- Work closely with internal AWS teams (executives, solution architects, industry specialists, marketing, partners, enterprise support, service teams and professional services), as well as external SI and ISV partners, to architect and deliver best-in-class business solutions for customers
- Display strong leadership presence with the ability to command a room; serve as an authority in communicating via email, phone, and face to face, and comfortable writing executive briefing documents for the most senior executives
- Operate with significant autonomy and discretion; exercise critical business judgement in routine and complex customer engagements
- Drive strategic pipeline creation and conversion of large-scale transformation programs to achieve and exceed revenue targets
- Create executive-level value propositions tied to measurable outcomes and ROI
- Monitor Energy & Utility industry trends to provide strategic insights and identify new opportunities for customer innovation
- Develop case studies and reference materials highlighting successful customer outcomes on AWS
- Participate and lead the negotiation and closing of legal agreements, such as Enterprise Agreements (EAs), and contracts, such as Private Pricing Addendums (PPAs).

About the team
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience
- Experience planning, managing and closing competitive sales efforts and managing deals from negotiation, to closing and through delivery
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, with experience presenting to executive audiences
- Deep understanding of the Energy & Utilities industry landscape, including regulatory environment, market dynamics, and digital transformation trends

Preferred qualifications

- Strong understanding of AWS’s service catalog ability to relate cloud and Agentic AI solutions to solving clients’ business problems
- Experience in digital transformation consulting or strategic advisory roles
- Proven history of creating net-new revenue streams through strategic initiatives

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

title: NW Deployment Build Lead , Infra - GND
descriptionHtml:
Job description
AWS is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers.

You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
• Managing work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
• Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords
• Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment
• Participating in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware

Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

A day in the life
Our team has three primary tasks:
1. Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. And then partner with network engineers to ensure all configurations are ready. You'll also be working on link and device troubleshooting within a certain Service-Level Agreement
2. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks.
3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation (RDPI) - Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources
- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results
- This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
- Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
- Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
- Walking in the FC and around area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
- Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours
- Should be able to work in environments with variable noise levels, lighting conditions and temperature variation
- Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)



A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 1+ year’s experience with technical drawings and/or reading CAD models (mechanical and electrical)
- 1+ year’s Experience working on mechanical, electrical, IT networked, or software systems
- Understanding of data collection, reporting processes, and ability to make data-driven decisions
- Ability to read technical drawings and/or reading CAD models to resolve on-site clash issues using 3D clash detection reports
- Ability to troubleshoot robotics systems to resolve escalations including quality hand-off, live order testing, site acceptance testing, operational readiness testing, monitoring robotics system performance, etc.
- Ability to read and develop technical documentation and process instructions
- Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Willingness to work primarily in a construction or warehouse environment in a field-based role and travel extensively across the US and potentially internationally
- Must be proficient in standard office software tools and processes

Preferred qualifications

- 1-3 years of experience working in a field engineering, construction, manufacturing, or warehouse environment
- Proven experience working on hardware integration or complex mechanical-electrical or networked industrial equipment. Knowledge of specific robotic equipment (Fanuc, ABB), and Allen Bradley PLC experience
- Ability to demonstrate past use of data to drive decision making processes
- Practical understanding of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, routing, switching, HTTP)
- Ability to take independent initiative when presented with a business need
- Certified in OSHA, ANSI, or other Automation Safety Certifications. Familiarity with LEAN or Six Sigma, certifications are a plus

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. title: Software Development Engineer, PXT Central Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's People Experience and Technology Central Science (PXTCS) team uses economics, behavioral science, statistics, machine learning, and Generative AI to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements that simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, well-being, and value of work for Amazonians. PXTCS is an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science, engineering, and UX to build and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal — at a scale that touches over 1.5 million Amazonians worldwide.

As a Software Development Engineer on PXTCS, you'll work side by side with economists, data scientists, data engineers, and applied scientists turning leading-edge ML and Generative AI models into reliable, scalable production systems.

This is a rare chance to see your code directly shape how Amazon supports its workforce, spanning areas like benefits, compensation, recruiting, voice of employee, management practices, and organizational culture. We offer opportunities for builders to build and make history!

Key job responsibilities
- Work with teams across the org to deliver large distributed projects to delight our customers
- Write high-quality, efficient, testable code in Java and other object-oriented languages
- Build highly available, secure, systems in a microservices architecture
- Collaborate with some of the best engineers in the industry
- Own and operate the systems that you build
- Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement
- Get firsthand experience engineering client apps as well as AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB and others

A day in the life
- Find out what it takes to engineer systems for "Amazon Scale"
- Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement
- Get firsthand experience engineering client apps as well as AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB and others

About the team
PXTCS combines economics, behavioral science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements that improve both Amazon's operations and the experience of every Amazonian. Its engineering teams take science-driven insights and models — spanning areas like benefits, compensation, recruiting, voice of employee, management practices, and organizational culture — and turn them into production systems operating at Amazon's scale. PXTCS is an interdisciplinary group where engineering, applied science, and product work side-by-side, and where this team's output directly shapes how Amazon supports its workforce.

Basic qualifications

title: Hardware Test and Integration Manager, OISL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are seeking a Hardware Test & Integration Manager to lead a major share of the Prototyping and Integration (PI) Team. You will manage three engineering functions — Testing (development, qualification, and reliability test), Mechanical DVT, and Electromechanical Integration (harnessing, PCB fabrication, and related electro-mechanical build) — and the mixed team of engineers and technician staff who deliver them. You are accountable for the people, the mechanisms, and the hardware outcomes across all three.

This is a people-leadership role where the problem, opportunity, and strategy are often not yet defined. You set the metrics and long-term direction these functions run by, design the team structure and mechanisms that keep complex prototype hardware moving at quality and speed, and negotiate priorities across the organization when three disciplines compete for the same bench and the same week. You hire and grow bar-raising talent, build a team that delivers without you, and represent these functions to program leadership and partner engineering organizations.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the Testing, Mechanical DVT, and Electromechanical Integration functions of the PI-Team.
- Define the metrics, goals, and long-term strategy for development, qualification, and reliability test of OISL prototype hardware, and establish the mechanisms that make test results auditable, data-driven, and repeatable.
- Direct the team's electromechanical integration work — GSE and prototype design, harnessing, and PCB fabrication — setting the workmanship and quality standards the team executes to.
- Own configuration control for the team's hardware — ensure designs, drawings, BOMs, and test documentation are created, reviewed, and released through formal PLM structure and change control (Siemens Teamcenter or equivalent).
- Establish workflows, SLAs, and cross-pillar prioritization, and negotiate resourcing across teams when programs and disciplines compete for the same capacity.
- Build and scale process-improvement and operational-excellence mechanisms across all three functions.
- Partner with design, manufacturing, and program engineering upstream to influence hardware design and schedule decisions before they are finalized.
- Serve as the escalation point for cross-functional blockers, resourcing conflicts, and schedule delays.

A day in the life
You move across multiple labs in a day — a reliability test review in the morning, a design verification test plan midday, a harnessing or PCB integration issue in the afternoon. You spend real time with your engineers and staff: unblocking them, coaching ownership, and holding 1:1s that tie their work to where they want to grow.

When program demands create a resourcing conflict, you make the prioritization call and own the outcome. You carry status to leadership yourself, pulled from the work rather than reported up to you. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who manages through mechanisms, earns trust across engineering disciplines, and builds a team that runs well without them.

About the team
The Prototyping & Integration (PI) Team accelerates hardware development through rapid prototyping, manufacturing, and integration of novel Line Replaceable Units (LRUs) and systems for the Optical Intersatellite Link organization. Our service areas span Hardware Fabrication, Electrical Integration, Systems Hardware Development, DVT and Qualification Testing, and Quality Assurance. Our learnings are directly applied to scale aerospace manufacturing processes and enable risk reduction through comprehensive Design Verification Testing and qualification testing. We seek candidates who thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments where ownership, operational excellence, and engineering-first approaches are valued.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power Engineering, or a related field
- 10+ years of engineering team management experience
- Experience directly managing engineers and/or technicians, including hiring, setting deliverable expectations, and managing performance.
- Experience establishing engineering processes, standards, or operational-excellence mechanisms that a team executes to, driven to measurable results.
- Experience driving hardware through development and qualification phases (DVT/PVT or equivalent) in a prototype or low-volume development environment.
- Experience creating and releasing hardware designs and documentation — drawings, BOMs, and procedures — within a formal PLM structure and change-control process.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
- Experience in aerospace, defense, satellite, or other high-reliability hardware development.
- Deep working knowledge of at least one pillar — test strategy and reliability methods, design of experiment, or harnessing/PCBA and electromechanical integration — strong enough to set the standard and mentor senior individual contributors in it.
- Experience building out lab infrastructure, including executing facilities improvement projects and/or commissioning capital equipment.

title: Multi-Site EHS Lead
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Multi-Site Workplace Heathy and Safety Lead to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate wellbeing while driving operational excellence.

As a Multi-Site WHS Lead you will provide WHS support to multiple sites within your region to execute company safety policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce or eliminate conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes. The Multi-Site WHS Lead partners with Operations leadership across sites, advises on regulatory compliance and risk mitigation, and serves as a subject matter expert, influencing change through comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis. This role instructs and trains operations leaders in Amazon safety policies, identifies best practices, and incorporates these standard methodologies to continuously improve the safety landscape.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

- Possess a thorough understanding of local and regional regulations and company policy.
- Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon WHS Policies across assigned sites.
- Measure sites' performance against published requirements in WHS policies, identify remediation plans for deficiencies, and drive accountability.
- Spend time at the sites and seek input from teams, associates, and leaders on safety program improvement opportunities, ensuring open communication on status and resolution.
- Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy, and audit the quality, delivery, and effectiveness of all required safety training.
- Ability to travel up to 50-70% of the time.
- Must be flexible regarding shifts.

Additional Job Elements include:

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site


For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience
- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon Safety (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations (specifically 29 CFR 1910) and applicable federal and state safety standards

Preferred qualifications

- Distribution Center or manufacturing safety experience with a mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 250 people
- Master's degree
- Certified Safety Professional (CSP)
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort collaborating with site leaders
- Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem-solving ability
- Ability to manage multiple sites remotely

title: Data Center Structural Engineer, AMER Design Engineering - East Regional Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Data Center Structural Engineer to join its design team in Herndon, Virginia.

AWS designs, builds, and operates Data Centers (DC) around the world and is a leader in worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure. Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost effective DC facilities. Our team is responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers and drive to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness, while finding new ways to meet AWS’s growing demand.

As a DC Structural Engineer at AWS, you will be part of the design team for Amazon DCs in our Americas Region and impact other projects around the world. As a Structural Engineer at AWS you will be part of a highly creative and efficient design team comprised of Architects, Engineers and Designers tasked with solving problems and challenging the status quo. As a subject matter expert, you will have a direct impact on the design of prototypical DC facilities, provide technical guidance to team members, review milestone drawings by consultants, solve large scale implementation issues, and be responsible for structural design requirements.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Structural Engineering
- 3+ years experience in structural design for industrial or commercial projects
- 1+ with design of Data Center, Mission Critical, Hospital, Schools, Commercial or Residential Tower facilities
- Proficiency in building codes, regulations, and standard including IBC and ASCE

Preferred qualifications

- Professional Engineer License
- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
- Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and MS Office Suite
- Detailed understanding of tilt-up and precast concrete structures, structural steel systems, seismic design, wind loading, snow loading, and forensic analysis of building design and construction defects.
- Experience in value engineering for building structural systems
- Design and calculation for auxiliary framing systems, non-structural components and non-building structures. ( ie. cable tray, conduit, ductwork, equipment platforms, façade, screen walls etc.)
- Ability to evaluate the constructability of new technologies, and determine construction methods of data center equipment and facilities. To perform and present business case analysis. Ability and willingness to think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs without negative impacts on quality or reliability

descriptionHtml:
AWS is looking for a Specialist Solution Architecture Manager to join our Industrial Manufacturing Industry Business Unit (IBU). This leader will be responsible for leading the specialist solution architecture team within AWS’s Industrial Manufacturing IBU, globally

AWS is looking for a hands-on Solutions Architect to join our Industrial Specialist & Solutions team. This leader will be responsible for leading the Manufacturing Technical Field Community (TFC) and running our Seattle based Physical AI Lab.

In this role, you'll build Physical AI prototypes and solutions working with our automotive and manufacturing customers, and lead the Manufacturing TFC working with the core team and TFC stakeholders. You'll own the lab's daily operations and manage project intake and builds, and publish reusable technical assets for the field and customers to adopt Physical AI solutions. As the Manufacturing TFC lead, you'll organize the community, asset development and enablement paths.

You'll work with Industry Specialists, Account Teams, Customers, and Partners.

Key job responsibilities
Physical AI Lab
- Carry out the lab build-out: set up hardware (robots, cobots, sensors, edge devices, PLCs), networking, and AWS cloud environments.
- Handle daily lab operations, including asset inventory, maintenance, access, safety, and security compliance.
- Act as the hands-on contact for hardware and software partners during setup and integration.
- Manage Project Intake & Prioritization, Keep the project backlog and roadmap up to date, and propose priorities for leadership to review.
- Track and report lab metrics such as engagements supported, assets published, and demos delivered.
- Build and deliver customer proofs of concept, demos, and lab sessions.

Manufacturing TFC Leadership
- Organize and run the Manufacturing TFC: plan meetings, enablement sessions, and the community content calendar.
- Manage builder projects, and solution development inline with priorities
- Collect field feedback, customers needs and ensure the technical asset backlog is prioritized.
- Work with the core team and stakeholders to ensure the TFC is meeting the needs of the community.
