title: Amazon Intern Program 2027 | Workplace Health & Safety (WHS)
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, every great operation starts with a deep commitment to the health and safety of the people behind it. We're looking for people who are passionate about safety, continuous improvement, and operational excellence, and who want to turn observations and data into safer environments for thousands of team members. If you want to start your career at a company that thinks big and believes that every employee deserves a safe and supportive workplace, this is the place for you.
We value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) and work to ensure that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the markets and customers we serve. That's why we have a DEI Committee with representatives from various areas and an engaged leadership, aware that "success and growth bring broad responsibilities." Our affinity groups are made up of volunteers who define DEI strategies and act as ambassadors, supporting you from Day 1, because "it's always Day 1."

The positions are for a start in the first quarter of 2027. We have openings in Cajamar, Osasco, and São Paulo - 5 days a week (please indicate your preferred location when you apply).

About the internship program
We're looking for students with a profile of proactive problem-solving, analytical thinking, and operational focus to work with Workplace Health & Safety across Amazon's fulfillment centers.

Key job responsibilities
Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance with all Local Regulations and Amazon Safety Policies
Measure performance against published safety policy requirements and, for any deficiencies, identify and implement corrective action plans
Deliver quality projects on time for Operations, including continuous improvement and WHSMS (Workplace Health & Safety Management System) initiatives
Analyze safety metrics and review daily, weekly, and monthly incidents to uncover trends and prioritize resource allocation to the highest-risk areas
Conduct frequent safety audits to identify non-compliant equipment and/or processes, implementing solutions to eliminate risk exposure and prevent injuries
Audit recordkeeping practices, workplace organization, and employee behaviors to ensure global safety standards and local regulations are met
Conduct and report incident investigations

Basic qualifications

- Students with an expected graduation date in line with the program rules (Jul 2028)
- Degrees in Logistics, Engineering, and related fields
- A proactive, detail-oriented profile with strong analytical and collaboration skills
- Attention to detail and a passion for safety, well-being, and continuous improvement
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, charts)
- Intermediate English required; advanced English will be considered a differentiator
- Availability to intern for 12 months, 6 hours per day (Monday to Friday, 30 hours per week) during business hours, working on-site 5x per week

Preferred qualifications

- Nice to have: prior experience or technical knowledge in Workplace Health & Safety (WHS)

descriptionHtml:
The ABM Solutions & Implementation team within the AWS Global ABM Practice is chartered to define, build, deploy, govern, and enable the solutions that empower 200+ ABM practitioners globally to operate efficiently and at scale. We create, manage, and support the end-to-end delivery of ABM capabilities — from AI-powered technologies to process automation to content management — ensuring our marketers spend less time on manual execution and more time on strategic customer impact.
We are seeking an ABM Program Manager to own and scale the AI, data, and operational solutions that support our ABM community. This role sits at the intersection of marketing and technology: you will take complex, ambiguous problems and deliver AI-based solutions end-to-end — from problem definition through design, build, testing, and global rollout. You will act as the key partner between ABM stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors, translating strategic ABM objectives into scalable solutions.
This role combines strategic thinking with a builder mindset. You will not simply route requirements to a cross-functional support team — you will assess ABM requirements, and where a solution can be built using out-of-the-box AI tools (such as Amazon Quick, MCP integrations, and Asana), you will build it and enable ABMers to use these solutions effectively. Success means ABM practitioners have an integrated, easy-to-use set of AI-powered tools embedded in their daily workflow that adapt as their accounts evolve — delivered with rigor, field-tested adoption, and measurable impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the business lead for ABM AI, data, and operational solutions end-to-end — define the vision, program strategy, requirements, and success criteria for AI-based ABM solutions with limited guidance, operating in problem spaces where the solution is not yet defined.
• Design and build AI-powered tools and automation flows from problem definition through production — including customer journey engines, Quick Skill automations, MCP integrations across enterprise platforms (CRM, Highspot, Asana), and reactive signal-monitoring layers that keep solutions current as accounts evolve.
• Drive delivery and support of complex, cross-functional solutions — including design, AppSec compliance, build, user acceptance testing with field practitioners, documentation (SOPs and training guides), product demonstrations, and global rollout.
• Serve as the key partner between marketing stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors — translating business requirements into technical specifications, and communicating technical constraints back to marketing stakeholders.
• Drive AI enablement and adoption across a globally distributed practitioner community — assess AI maturity, build leveling frameworks, deploy Quick Skills tooling, and coach practitioners (e.g., via a Champions program) to scale adoption across all Geos.
• Spot risks and drive appropriate trade-offs — understand design approaches within the ABM technology domain (AI/ML frameworks, MCP integrations, data sources, agent orchestration, UI/UX) and ask the right questions to ensure sound decisions.
• Define, track, and report on program KPIs (adoption, usage volume, practitioner impact, time savings, delivery quality). Use data to identify bottlenecks, drive improvements, and inform investment decisions.
• Create new processes and mechanisms — AI solution generation workflows, orchestration patterns, coaching methodologies, and global rollout mechanisms — and optimize cross-team delivery across engineering and marketing organizations.
• Facilitate cross-functional decision-making forums with leaders, technical program managers, and vendors to secure resources, align priorities, and drive timely decisions. Present decisions and program status to senior leadership.
• Partner with the Martech team on ABM solution lifecycle management — contributing requirements and field-informed input to platform builds such as buying-group identification services, account planning platforms, and ABM experience products.

- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is looking for an Operations Engineer II to join the Ops Integration Engineering (OIE) team. OIE is responsible for bridging the gap between engineering innovation and field operations by ensuring new automation technologies, equipment, and systems are successfully planned, piloted, launched, and adopted across the AMZL network. This role supports the full lifecycle of automation programs — from early-stage pilot planning through network-wide expansion — and requires a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where cross-functional coordination and field presence are critical to success.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating independently in the field, building relationships with site leadership and partner teams, and translating complex technical programs into clear operational standards. You will travel extensively (~80%) to Amazon sites across North America to support installations, testing, launches, and post-launch performance monitoring.

Pilot Planning

This includes building training curricula, defining success criteria and key performance indicators, supporting Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), providing inputs to site selection, and creating the operational standards that will govern how associates interact with new technology.

Operational Readiness & Expansion

Develop and deliver pre-launch training for site operations teams, provide on-site support during launch windows, track post-launch performance metrics against defined success criteria, and coordinate the handoff to ACES and site ownership once performance stabilizes. Identify and escalate operational risks, adoption gaps, and process deficiencies that could impact program success.

title: Sr. Technical Program Mgr., Robotics & Innovation - AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is on a mission to build the most advanced last-mile delivery network in the world. Our Central Engineering – Robotics & Innovation team is at the forefront of this transformation, developing and deploying automation and robotic systems that power delivery stations across North America and beyond. Our objective is to fully automate our Delivery Stations, achieving zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) operations end-to-end.
We are seeking an experienced, innovative, and customer-obsessed Technical Program Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of robotics and automation programs — from early ideation and concept validation through large-scale field deployment and performance ramp-up. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that combines strategic program leadership with deep technical engagement across robotics, mechatronics, controls, and software disciplines.
If you thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and want to make a measurable difference in how Amazon delivers to customers — come help us make history.


Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end program management for robotics and automation initiatives across the AMZL delivery station network - scope, schedule, cost, risk, and performance.
Lead cross-functional teams spanning hardware engineering, software development, controls, operations, RME, process engineering, and external vendors to deliver integrated robotic solutions at scale.
Drive the full technology lifecycle: ideation to concept design to prototyping to pilot validation to GA deployment to continuous performance improvement.
Define pilot criteria, success metrics, and GO/NO-GO frameworks for new automation technologies entering the AMZL network.
Develop and maintain detailed deployment plans, including critical path scheduling, resource planning, and sequencing, validated through simulation and modeling tools.
Author business cases and strategic narratives for introducing new automation to the delivery station network; present to Director- and VP-level audiences.
Capture voice-of-the-customer directly from field operations (Ops, Maintenance, ACES, Process Engineering, Associates) and translate insights into actionable engineering and roadmap improvements.
Partner with BI and Data Engineering teams to establish KPI frameworks and performance visibility dashboards for deployed robotic systems.
Drive continuous improvement across deployment cycle time, system reliability, and operational throughput, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable efficiency gains.
Lead technical design reviews; propose and influence solution architectures for robotic cells, autonomous vehicles, material handling, and sortation systems.
Manage contractor and vendor relationships; ensure delivery commitments are met to quality, timeline, and cost targets.
Lead value engineering initiatives to minimize CAPEX while maintaining performance standards.
Travel 25-50% to delivery stations and partner sites across North America for field validation, deployment support, and stakeholder engagement.


A day in the life
Your day could start with a technical design review for a robotic induction system being piloted at in delivery station, shift to a vendor alignment call on a mechatronics integration timeline, and end with drafting a VP-level narrative on program status for a quarterly business review. You are the connective tissue between the engineers building the future of AMZL and the operators running it today - making sure what we invent actually works at Amazon scale, safely and reliably.
It's always Day 1.



About the team
The Robotics and Innovation team within AMZL Central Engineering develops and deploys automation solutions that drive our objective of fully automated, zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) delivery-station operations, eliminating manual risk and unlocking throughput at scale. We are part of the Worldwide (WW) AMZL team, partnering closely with peer Robotics and Innovation organizations across geographies to share technology, standards, and best practices.
We are a set of diverse individuals who work coherently to solve customer problems with the most innovative solutions. We put heavy emphasis on empowering our employees to maintain work life harmony. The team works with innovative technologies in the market to bring into AMZL to solve complex technical problems. It is a fine balance between working on writing strategic business cases to understanding the deep human machine interfaces.

- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition end-to-end
- Experience working directly with engineering teams (hardware, software, controls) through the full product development lifecycle

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

title: Data Center Chief Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support AWS.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: PDX is an AWS GovCloud region. As required by our contracts with the federal government, effective February 24, 2026, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States).

NOTE: Relocation assistance will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Act as the primary escalation point for all facilities-related issues. Oversee operation and management of routine and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.

Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures and troubleshooting of facility within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).

Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and are responsible for working with Facility Manager (FM) to set team culture.

Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams

May assist in the building out of new facilities and assist in projects to increase current facility efficiency

Working outside of normal business hours for routine maintenance as required, including responding to out-of-hours emergency calls.

Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.

Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff

Establish building performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility of operations and maintenance.

Utilize Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and other basic administrative tools to perform day-to-day tasks



Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodation:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently

Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds

Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder

Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position

Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection



Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment that supports servers that must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. Equipment will include but is not limited to stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

The CE directs, trains and supports technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. They manage projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities.


About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
- 5+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel experience

title: Sr. Product manager-Technical , Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX)
descriptionHtml:
The FBA Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX) team is seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager (PMT) to lead product strategy and execution for a major product area within the seller fulfillment experience across Brazil, Mexico, and Australia. This role will own the product vision, define the strategic roadmap, and drive end-to-end delivery of seller-facing experiences that directly impact seller adoption, retention, and operational success across three of Amazon’s fastest-growing marketplaces. You will be responsible for some of the highest-judgment product decisions within FBA’s emerging markets portfolio — decisions that shape how hundreds of thousands of sellers experience fulfillment and how Amazon grows its third-party marketplace in these geographies.

Fulfillment by Amazon is one of Amazon’s most important seller-facing programs, enabling third-party sellers to leverage Amazon’s world-class fulfillment network to delight end customers. The Seller Fulfillment Experience (SFX) team owns the seller journey, workflows, and interfaces that power this program — from shipment creation and inventory planning through performance optimization and product removal. We operate at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, logistics complexity, and seller experience, solving problems that require deep understanding of local nuance, operational constraints, and seller behavioral economics across emerging markets at different stages of maturity.

This role sits within the SFX product team and will own strategic product leadership across interconnected charter areas: (1) product strategy and roadmap definition; translating seller pain points, country opportunity analysis, and business priorities into a cohesive product vision that balances seller experience with operational and economic sustainability; (2) cross-functional delivery leadership; driving alignment across engineering, UX, data science, operations, and business teams to deliver complex, multi-component product experiences on ambitious timelines; and (3) organizational influence and thought leadership; shaping the broader FBA product direction through compelling narratives, data-driven recommendations, and active participation in leadership forums (WBRs, planning cycles, investment reviews).

As an ideal candidate, you are a strategic product leader who combines vision with execution discipline. You thrive in ambiguity and can translate complex, multi-geo challenges into clear product strategies and crisp leadership recommendations. You bring strong analytical skills with the ability to build business cases, evaluate trade-offs across multiple dimensions (seller experience, operational cost, marketplace growth), and drive data-informed decisions at scale. You are comfortable navigating contentious prioritization decisions across organizations with competing perspectives and partnering with engineering, finance, operations, and senior leadership to drive alignment. You think big about how product experiences can accelerate FBA growth in emerging markets while ensuring long-term sustainability, and you mentor and elevate the product managers around you.


Key job responsibilities
• Define and drive the product strategy for a major product area or multiple related product areas within FBA seller experience, setting multi-quarter roadmaps aligned with org vision
• Own complex, ambiguous problem spaces; frame problems, generate innovative solutions, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders and partner teams
• Write and present high-quality product narratives (PRFAQs, strategy docs, business cases) to VP/Director-level leadership, securing buy-in for significant investments
• Lead cross-functional product development efforts spanning engineering, UX, data science, operations, finance, and business teams across multiple geographies
• Establish and monitor key business metrics, building mechanisms to track product performance and identify opportunities at scale
• Drive a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making; design experimentation frameworks that enable your team to validate assumptions rapidly
• Influence the broader organization’s product direction through thought leadership, best practices, and cross-pollination of ideas across teams
• Mentor and develop Product Managers; provide guidance on product strategy, stakeholder management, and career development
• Navigate geo-specific complexity (regulatory, operational, cultural) to ensure product strategies are adapted for emerging markets while maintaining global scalability
• Identify and drive operational improvements and automation opportunities that create leverage for the team and organization
• Represent your product area in leadership forums (WBRs, business reviews, planning cycles) and proactively escalate risks and trade-offs


A day in the life
As a Senior Product Manager on the SFX team, your morning might begin with reviewing a weekly business review (WBR) pack, identifying inflection points in seller adoption metrics across Brazil or Australia, and framing a narrative for leadership. You’ll lead a strategy session where you guide your team through a complex trade-off, balancing seller experience improvements against operational cost constraints, and land on a clear recommendation backed by data. Between meetings, you’re refining a PRFAQ for a net-new capability that could unlock seller growth in an underserved segment, incorporating feedback from the senior leader review earlier this week.

Afternoons include a cross-org design review where you challenge assumptions and elevate the quality of the proposed seller workflow, followed by coaching a junior PM through their first product narrative. You close the day with a quick sync with your engineering lead to unblock a critical launch dependency, ensuring your team maintains velocity. You thrive in ambiguity, connect dots across multiple workstreams, and consistently deliver products that move the needle for sellers and the business.

About the team

title: Electrical Assembly, Integration, & Testing Engineer, Cryogenic Hardware, Quantum Computing
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) team is looking to hire an Electrical Assembly & Testing Engineer. This role builds, tests, and calibrates delicate electronic components for cryogenic quantum computing systems. Candidates must have experience in precision electronics assembly, microelectronics integration, surface-mount (SMT) soldering and rework, and basic DC/RF measurements. The candidate will work with cryogenic RF/microwave systems, quantum processor electronics, and precision electrical test equipment. Responsibilities include precision soldering, rework, and assembly of PCBs populated with fine-pitch SMT components and RF connectors, as well as cable assemblies for cryogenic systems, following technical drawings while adhering to strict ESD and cleanliness protocols. The ideal candidate should have excellent fine motor skills, familiarity with basic electrical engineering principles, and strong problem solving and communication abilities. Working effectively within a team environment is critical.

Key job responsibilities
The primary responsibility of this role is precision electrical assembly and integration for cryogenic quantum computing operations. You will assemble, integrate, and package electro-mechanical components including PCB assemblies, cable assemblies, and quantum processors using specialized tools. You will perform high-quality hand soldering including connector attachment, SMT reflow, PCB rework, and assembly/routing of DC/RF harnesses/cables. Much of this work is done under a microscope: placing, reflowing, and reworking small SMT packages and miniature RF connectors, and inspecting the result against IPC workmanship standards. You will conduct electrical tests using multimeters, Vector Network Analyzers (VNAs), and automated test equipment to verify assembly performance through continuity, isolation, and transmission measurements. You will assemble components designed for high vacuum and cryogenic environments. You will follow detailed work instructions, update build logs, generate and update assembly procedures, inspect outside vendor assembly work, and maintain strict electrostatic discharge (ESD) safety protocols.

A day in the life
You will work across teams to assemble, integrate, test, and validate electrical systems for cryogenic quantum computing hardware. A typical week mixes bench work at the microscope, such as populating or reworking SMT components on cryogenic PCBs, with harness and cable fabrication, DC and RF testing, and documentation. You will read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical procedures to execute precision assembly tasks. You will coordinate with stakeholders on electrical integration requirements, documentation, and scheduling. You will wire up qubit control electronic racks and contribute to developing new electrical assembly procedures while maintaining rigorous quality standards. The ideal candidate should embrace a fast-paced startup environment: they must be able to learn quickly, operate independently, communicate clearly, and consistently demonstrate reliability.

About the team
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is a multi-disciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and technicians, on a mission to develop a fault-tolerant quantum computer.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- Knowledge of material and manufacturing methods

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems
- Experience with analog, digital, and high-speed circuit design
- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, physics, or equivalent

title: Principal Product Manager, Technical, Ads , APM
descriptionHtml:
Omni-channel advertising is reshaping how advertisers achieve their marketing objectives on Amazon and beyond. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded leader of a product, engineering, science, and business development team charged with bringing Amazon's omni-channel advertising vision to life. You and your team will work across partner teams — including the Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP), Supply-Side Platform (SSP), and go-to-market organizations — to define the product strategy, build the technology, and drive advertiser adoption. You will design advertiser-facing workflows powered by generative AI, partner with teams building creative transformation technology that converts a single advertiser asset into display, audio, and video formats, and identify and resolve gaps in ad-serving and bidding logic that limit omni-channel performance. If you are a technically curious product leader who thrives on turning ambiguous, high-impact opportunities into concrete results, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the 3–5 year product vision and strategic roadmap for omni-channel advertising, translating broad market opportunity into a sequenced plan of deliverables with clear trade-offs and measurable outcomes.
- Lead end-to-end product development across engineering, science, design, and business development teams, deconstructing complex technical challenges into straightforward solutions and driving alignment across multiple organizations.
- Define and coordinate experimentation strategies — including multi-phase testing programs — to validate hypotheses around ad-serving optimization, creative transformation, and advertiser adoption, using data and metrics to inform investment decisions.
- Partner as a technical peer with engineering and applied science teams to evaluate architecture proposals for extensibility, scalability, and performance, ensuring today's decisions do not constrain tomorrow's strategic options.
- Drive strategic communications through written narratives, business reviews, and executive forums, influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to secure resources and align priorities.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a deep-dive into experiment results from a new ad-format test, deciding whether the signal warrants scaling or pivoting. By mid-morning you are in an architecture review with engineering, weighing trade-offs in real-time bidding logic. After lunch you lead a cross-team alignment session to resolve a prioritization conflict between your roadmap and a partner team's deliverables. Later you draft a vision document for a whitespace opportunity you have been researching, pulling together advertiser feedback, usage data, and competitive signals. You close the day by reviewing a generative AI prototype your team built to streamline creative workflows, pressure-testing the output quality before greenlighting the next sprint.

About the team
Our team sits within Amazon Ads and is focused on making omni-channel advertising simple and effective for advertisers of every size. We build the products and technology that let advertisers reach customers across display, audio, and video through a unified experience. The team is a collaborative mix of product managers, software engineers, applied scientists, and business development professionals who work closely with partner teams across the DSP, SSP, and sales organizations. We are investing in generative AI, creative automation, and advanced bidding systems — and this role will be at the center of shaping what comes next.

- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are seeking a Principal Tech Operations Engineer to lead and scale regional manufacturing operations across a complex, multi vendor hardware production ecosystem. This role owns the end to end orchestration of external manufacturing partners, driving supplier onboarding, site enablement, technical roadmap development, and sustained performance management across Supply Chain, Quality, Technical Operations, and Procurement functions. You will shape operational planning inputs that determine how the region builds and delivers enterprise hardware at scale.

You will serve as the single threaded owner for manufacturing operations outcomes, aligning diverse stakeholders, setting strategic direction, and delivering results that meet business scaling targets. You will build consensus and drive decisions at velocity across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Risk Management, Public Policy, Finance, and Customer facing organizations while maintaining full accountability for production performance and customer delivery.

This is a senior role which requires 10+ years of technical program management experience. The role demands deep, tenured expertise in high mix, high complexity hardware manufacturing. You will have personally led organizations through product transitions, capacity ramps, supplier onboarding cycles, and operational transformations. You thrive in dynamic environments where shifting product mix, evolving customer demand, and technology transitions require rapid, high judgment decision making that balances quality, cost, throughput, and delivery reliability.

You will own complex integration programs from conception through design, validation, implementation, and scaling across manufacturing sites. The scope includes orchestrating a multi vendor ecosystem of manufacturing partners, managing the largest and most complex supplier engagements in the region, and delivering next generation technology programs. This includes enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production, supporting the industry transition from air cooled to liquid cooled infrastructure. In 2027, the role expands to lead the site setup, vendor selection, and operational ramp of a purpose built Manufacturing Center of Excellence, a greenfield facility that will double regional manufacturing capacity and set operational standards for global replication.

You will bring strong technical depth across server, storage, and network hardware architectures combined with expertise in program management, supply chain operations, capacity modeling, new product introduction, and manufacturing engineering. You will drive systemic root cause resolution using structured methodologies (5 Whys, 8D, Six Sigma) and own all site capacity planning across the region. You will maintain accountability for critical financial levers including direct and indirect labor optimization, cost per unit, and overall cost competitiveness.

You will champion the highest standards of safety, security, and operational excellence across every engagement. You will communicate with clarity through structured business reviews, establish the metrics that define success, and influence across engineering, supply chain, quality, and executive leadership to deliver customer commitments at a global scale.



Key job responsibilities
Strategic Planning and Transformation

1. Define and own the 3 to 5 year manufacturing operations strategy, anticipating future capacity needs, identifying critical capability gaps, and prioritizing technology investments that position the region for sustained growth
2. Lead transformational programs that fundamentally reshape manufacturing capability, including advanced automation deployment, robotics integration, and lights out manufacturing initiatives
3. Drive manufacturing agility through flexible line configurations, rapid changeover capabilities, and multi product qualification strategies that enable the network to respond to evolving customer demand and technology transitions
4. Own capital expenditure planning for manufacturing operations, developing rigorous business cases that quantify returns on equipment investments, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
5. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks across the manufacturing network, including single points of failure, capacity constraints, systemic quality issues, and workforce availability challenges before they impact delivery
6. Develop high quality strategic documents and investment proposals that influence manufacturing priorities at the executive level, articulating trade offs, quantifying risks, and presenting clear recommendations that drive action


Final Assembly and System Integration Excellence

1. Architect and continuously evolve production line design, material flow strategies, and workstation configurations across the manufacturing network to deliver step function improvements in throughput, cycle time, and ergonomic safety
2. Define the manufacturing execution system strategy for the region, establishing real time visibility into work in progress, station level yields, and production constraints that enable data driven decision making at every level
3. Lead a culture of relentless continuous improvement through lean manufacturing principles, kaizen programs, and value stream mapping, systematically eliminating waste and unlocking operational efficiency gains that set the benchmark for global operations

Data, Metrics, and Operational Excellence

1. Architect and own the manufacturing operations performance framework, defining the metrics that matter (overall equipment effectiveness, throughput, cycle time, first pass yield, on time delivery, cost per unit) and holding the organization accountable to world class targets
2. Build executive grade dashboards and reporting systems that provide real time visibility into production health, quality trends, and delivery performance, enabling leaders to make informed decisions at speed across all sites
3. Champion Industry 4.0 adoption including IoT enabled production monitoring, predictive maintenance, and AI driven quality inspection, positioning the manufacturing network at the forefront of smart factory innovation
4. Design scalable mechanisms and intelligent automation that eliminate manual effort in production reporting, defect tracking, and capacity planning, creating operational leverage as the network grows
5. Translate complex operational data into compelling strategic narratives for executive leadership, shaping investment priorities and manufacturing direction through clear, insight driven recommendations
6. Lead digital transformation across manufacturing operations, driving manufacturing execution system modernization, automated test equipment upgrades, and smart factory capabilities that deliver measurable competitive advantage


A day in the life
As the Principal Tech Ops Engineer, no two days look the same but the mission is constant: scale enterprise hardware manufacturing globally. You spend your time defining multi year capacity strategies, onboarding new manufacturing partners, and driving technology transitions such as enabling the region's first liquid cooled rack production. You lead manufacturing readiness reviews for new product introductions, build business cases for facility expansions, and architect digital transformation programs across the supplier ecosystem. You own the operational excellence framework, establishing metrics and scalable mechanisms that replicate across sites worldwide. You partner with hardware engineering, supply chain, and executive leadership to shape investment priorities, mitigate operational risks, and deliver next generation manufacturing capabilities. You develop future leaders, influence long term vendor strategies, and drive automation and Industry 4.0 adoption that positions the manufacturing network for sustained growth at scale.

descriptionHtml:

title: Data Center Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.
Data Center Technician position involves in-depth hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair as well as participating in an on-call rotation.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Physical Requirements:
• Lifting and moving material up to 40 pounds each
• Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
• Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
• Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
• Work in an industrial environment
• Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).
• This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
• Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



Key job responsibilities
• Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, and carrying out routine network, server hardware, and operating system repairs to contribute to the overall availability of AWS services
• Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors
• Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities
• Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues
• Helping to interview, train and onboard new team members


A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while they:
• Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
• Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
• Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
• Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
• Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
• Improve effectiveness through process innovation
You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- 1+ years of Linux operating systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in computer networking
- Experience working with Linux operating systems
- Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds
- Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair
- Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- 18+ months of computer/server hardware troubleshooting or related IT experience
- 18+ months of computer layer 1/2 networking experience (including troubleshooting and repair)

Preferred qualifications

- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)
- Experience in a data center or other critical environment
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience in an IT-related field (e.g. computer science, network engineering, etc.)
- Industry standard certifications (CompTIA, CCENT, Network+)
- Understanding of Linux or similar operating systems
- Behavioral interviewing and hiring experience
- Experience training and onboarding of new team members

title: SSL Production Lab Engineer, Space Simulation Lab
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We are seeking a Lab Engineer to run day-to-day lab operations and support production and hardware testing. You'll build and maintain test fixtures, manage lab resources and equipment, and make sure measurements are accurate and traceable. You'll work hands-on with hardware, electrical harnesses, and precision measurement tools, and you'll work closely with design, test, and production teams.

As a Lab Engineer, you will support test, readiness, and operation of SSL test systems infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to translate test needs into safe, reliable, and repeatable test setups.
You will improve current test setups, integrate instrumentation and equipment, perform equipment checkout and commissioning activities, execute complex testing, troubleshoot hardware and test system issues.
This is a highly hands-on engineering role that combines mechanical engineering, test system development, production operations, troubleshooting, and testing.

This role will work M-F 8-4:30

Key job responsibilities
• Set up, operate, and maintain lab equipment for production station and test hardware.
• Partner with Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to understand test requirements and determine equipment, instrumentation and fixture needs.
• Monitor complex tests, evaluate system behavior, identify abnormal conditions, and safely respond to test anomalies.
• Design, build, and modify custom test fixtures and tooling.
• Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot 3D printers.
• Perform basic machining operations to fabricate and modify fixtures and hardware.
• Read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, electrical drawings, and GD&T to build, assemble, and verify hardware.
• Develop, build, troubleshoot, repair, and rework electrical harnesses, working from schematics and electrical drawings.
• Manage lab resources, equipment, and supplies, including inventory, ordering, and scheduling.
• Develop and execute preventative maintenance plans for mechanical equipment.
• Organize and maintain the lab or shop space, and track equipment calibration to keep it current and compliant.
• Document test setups, procedures, and results.
• Enforce lab safety and housekeeping standards.
• Provide technical guidance to technicians and other personnel on equipment operation, test setup, troubleshooting, and safe test execution.

Basic qualifications

- -Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks
- -1 year + of experience in hardware development, industrial equipment maintenance, space/aerospace maintenance, or another hands-on engineering environment.
- -Knowledge of and experience with measurement and inspection devices (torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, multimeters, oscilloscopes, DAQ systems).
- Experience developing, troubleshooting, and operating thermal and vacuum chambers
- Associate's or Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
- -Experience operating, troubleshooting, and installing dynamics equipment. (vibration tables, shakers, shock testing)

Preferred qualifications

- -Experience with networking
- -Experience scoping, purchasing, validating, and commissioning equipment
- -Experience with using dynamics equipment to perform development testing
- -Experience troubleshooting daq systems, network switches, data cables, accelerometers and other components.

title: Recruiting Coordinator Manager, Recruiting Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Talent Acquisition team is looking for a talented and customer-focused manager to lead our Recruiting Coordination (RC) team. RCs are the backbone of recruiting at Amazon, and work to provide world class service as they support candidates through the interview process. They are highly customer-focused, have excellent attention to detail, and multi-task like pros.

We expect the Recruiting Coordinator Manager to be a dynamic and passionate leader with proven analytical capabilities, ability to track and measure results, and the ability to forge strong partnerships with partner teams. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a passion for recruiting, a high level of flexibility, commitment, and the ability to tackle ambiguity.

This Recruiting Coordinator Manager will lead successful operations for managing a team of RCs supporting multiple business lanes, in both the technical and non-technical recruiting space. This includes forecasting demand and RC capacity, managing all core scheduling and coordinating activities and results, and partnering with various stakeholders to improve the end-to-end scheduling process. They will develop staff members so each team member is trained, supported, and able to thrive.

Key job responsibilities
The successful Recruiting Coordinator Manager must:
• Build and manage a high performing team
• Conduct performance evaluations and prepare developmental plans for staff in a timely manner
• Develop and implement volume and capacity forecasts
• Manage multiple tasks, emerging priorities, and meet deadlines
• Be able to handle multiple problems simultaneously, and prioritize effectively
• Have excellent problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills
• Continuously improve processes and procedures


A day in the life
Your day begins with a review of regional performance metrics across your three RCM teams spanning North America. You're looking at trends—not just today's numbers, but patterns over the past few weeks that tell you where to focus your attention. You notice scheduling decline rates creeping up in one vertical and make a note to investigate root causes. You start your morning with a leadership sync with your peer managers and your senior leader, discussing capacity planning for Q2 hiring surges and aligning on strategic priorities. You're advocating for a process improvement initiative based on insights you've gathered from your RCMs, and you come prepared with data that makes the business case clear.

Mid-morning, you're in a working session with recruiting leadership and a business partner team to address a systemic challenge with interview scheduling for a high-volume hiring initiative. You're representing the operations perspective, asking clarifying questions, and proposing solutions that balance candidate experience with operational feasibility. You commit to piloting an approach with one of your teams and measuring the impact.

You have back-to-back 1-on-1s with your three RCMs after lunch. With your first manager, you're coaching through a performance issue on their team—helping them think through documentation, feedback delivery, and performance improvement plans. With your second, you're discussing their career development and identifying stretch opportunities. With your third, you're problem-solving a complex stakeholder relationship and helping them navigate organizational dynamics.

The afternoon includes a deep dive session where you're analyzing scheduling data to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency gains. You're building a proposal for your senior leader that outlines how reallocating work could improve throughput by 20% without adding headcount. You're thinking several steps ahead about implementation, change management, and how to bring your RCMs along as partners in the change.

You join a cross-functional project meeting focused on improving the candidate scheduling experience. You're contributing the operations lens, sharing pain points your teams have surfaced, and collaborating with product and tech partners on solutions. You volunteer to pilot a new tool feature with one of your teams and provide feedback.

Before wrapping your day, you review and approve several decisions your RCMs have escalated—a scheduling exception for an executive hire, a capacity reallocation between teams, and a process deviation request. You're empowering your managers to make decisions while ensuring consistency and alignment with broader strategy. You end your day preparing for tomorrow's business review with your senior leader, where you'll present your team's performance, highlight wins, address challenges transparently, and propose your roadmap for the next 30 days.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with recruiting tools and systems, including resume databases, internet sourcing tools, and spreadsheets
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 6+ years of team leadership and development experience
- Experience presenting data to stakeholders to drive results and meet SLAs

Preferred qualifications

- Experience creating, measuring and scaling workflow among candidates, hiring managers and the recruiting team
- Experience managing senior staff or staffing managers
- Experience with workforce planning
- Experience partnering with hiring teams to build effective sourcing, assessment, and closing approaches with an ability to manage customer/partner expectations

You will be a key player in driving customer success, providing technical expertise, migration best practices, and hands-on delivery leadership from initial assessment through production cutover.



With deep expertise in VMware environments and AWS migration services, you will lead enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You will assess VMware workloads through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, define migration strategies and target architectures, assign R-strategies across the portfolio, and design wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As a trusted advisor you will guide customers through risk mitigation, architecture decisions, and the organizational change that large-scale VMware exits require.



The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes on AWS. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives through a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to cloud adoption and migration at scale.


What Makes This Role Different

VMware estates are not just infrastructure. They are the operational core of enterprise businesses built over decades. You will not be running a lift and shift. You will be designing the path from a legacy platform to a modern, cloud-native foundation, and making that transition invisible to the business. The complexity is real, the stakes are high, and the outcomes are permanent.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement complex, scalable, and secure AWS target architectures for VMware workload migrations, covering compute, network, storage, and virtualization layers

Lead end-to-end VMware estate assessments using discovery tooling and application owner interviews, producing portfolio disposition recommendations with R-strategy assignments across rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, retain, and relocate

Define migration strategy and target architecture for VMware workloads, translating technical choices into business outcomes for executive audiences

Design and own wave plans including dependency grouping, capacity balancing, cutover sequencing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints

Apply AI-powered and agentic migration tools including AWS Transform, ModelizeIT, Kiro, and equivalent tooling to accelerate discovery, assessment, and migration execution at scale

Lead large delivery teams and matrix organizations, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders throughout the program lifecycle

Partner with AWS Migration Services including Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS), and Migration Hub to execute migrations with precision and repeatability

Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout delivery, ensuring adherence to AWS Well-Architected principles and optimizing wave sequencing to minimize risk and business disruption

Act as a trusted advisor to customers on VMware licensing optimization, infrastructure modernization, and emerging AWS capabilities relevant to their environment

Share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable migration artifacts, runbooks, and cutover playbooks that partners can execute at scale

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 10+ years of cloud architecture, solution implementation, or consulting experience with a focus on large-scale cloud migration and modernization programs
- Experience leading the delivery of large-scale, mission-critical enterprise IT and migration programmes including data center exits in a customer-facing role
- Deep hands-on experience with VMware environments including vSphere, vCenter, NSX, vSAN, and ESXi administration and migration
- Experience as the technical lead of large-scale migrations, defining migration strategy and target architecture, selecting the right approach for each workload, and translating technical choices into business outcomes for executive audiences
- Experience using AI-powered and agentic migration and modernization tools such as AWS Transform, ModelizeIT, Kiro, or equivalent to accelerate discovery, assessment, and migration execution at scale
- Hands-on experience with technology infrastructure including network, compute, storage, and virtualization
- Experience with wave planning including dependency grouping, capacity balancing, and multi-geography coordination under regulatory constraints
- Experience leading large teams and matrix organizations and driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders
- Experience with the software development lifecycle and agile and iterative delivery methods

Preferred qualifications

- Work experience in financial services including banking, capital markets, payments, or insurance, with regulated workloads and compliance and security standards
- Deep knowledge of AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and VPC, and AWS migration services including Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, and Migration Hub
- AWS Professional level certifications including Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
- VMware certification including VCP, VCAP, or equivalent
- Experience with two or more migration domains beyond VMware such as SAP, Windows and SQL Server, database migrations including Oracle licensing and PostgreSQL, or mainframe
- Experience with infrastructure as code, automation, and scripting including Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, and PowerShell
- Experience with public, hybrid, and multi-cloud platforms including VMware Cloud on AWS
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity in complex multi-vendor environments with incomplete documentation and conflicting data sources while prioritizing needs and delivering measurable results
- Spanish language skills, written and spoken, are highly valued

title: Account Assistant
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a talented, hands-on professional to help grow selection on Amazon.sa, Amazon’s marketplace in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Based in Egypt and working closely with our team in Saudi Arabia, you will help Saudi sellers bring their offline selection online, quickly and to a high quality standard.
The Amazon Marketplace organization runs the Selling on Amazon business and builds solutions that let millions of Selling Partners around the world sell on Amazon. In this role you will support the launch and listing of new sellers for an assigned set of categories: turning seller catalogs into accurate, high-quality, discoverable listings that generate new business for sellers and a world-class experience for customers. • Work remotely with Saudi sellers and with Riyadh-based account managers to remove listing blockers and shorten time to go live.
• Partner with business and technical teams to fix catalog defects and improve listing tools and processes.
• Identify selection gaps and new opportunities within your categories, and flag them to the team.
• Track and report your own productivity and quality metrics.

title: Sustainability Program Manager, EU Ops Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
EU Operations Sustainability drives the decarbonization of Amazon's operational footprint across Europe, focusing on reducing environmental impact from transportation, buildings, and energy consumption. The team develops and executes strategies spanning First Mile, Middle Mile, and Last Mile logistics — including energy efficiency, renewable energy, building material decarbonization and climate resiliency and adaptation, at fulfillment centers, sort centres and delivery stations. Working cross-functionally with EU Operations, WW Sustainability, engineering and procurement, the EU Ops Sustainability team translates Amazon's Climate Pledge commitments into actionable programs with measurable targets. The team navigates also the evolving European regulatory landscape to ensure compliance while identifying opportunities to accelerate decarbonization ahead of mandated timelines.

EU Ops Sustainability is looking for a Sustainability Program Manager to support energy efficiency programs across all miles. In this role, you will own strategic, tactical, and cross-functional projects and programs within the STEP organization to meet sustainability goals. You will be responsible for scoping and creating project plans, developing processes, coordinating and driving execution, and communicating progress to senior leadership. You will work day-to-day with cross-functional partners including RME, Finance, Real Estate, Design & Construction (D&C), and IT to deliver measurable energy and carbon reductions. You will also have the opportunity to work with selected start-ups through the Amazon Sustainability Accelerator (ASA) – Climate Tech programme, helping to evaluate, pilot, and scale innovative sustainability technologies across Amazon's European fulfillment network.

This role can be also based in other EU cities: Paris (CDG10), Barcelona (BCN10), Madrid (MAD12), Milan (LIN15), and Munich (MUC11).

The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Logistics, Delivery and Shipping Sector
The position is classified at level 1 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

Key job responsibilities
Manage full lifecycle complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across multiple organizations

Work closely with partner teams and stakeholders in and outside of your organization to source, allocate, and coordinate resources
Build and own financial models including business cases, Capital Appropriation Request (CAR) submissions, and discounted payback period (DPP) analysis to justify energy efficiency investments;

Own reporting on the state of initiatives, measuring improvements and impact of changes

Navigate the evolving European regulatory landscape — including EPBD (Energy Performance of Buildings Directive), Décret Tertiaire, and ISO 50001 to ensure compliance and identify opportunities to accelerate decarbonization ahead of mandated timelines

Work autonomously in an ambiguous environment, seeking to understand business problems, automation limitations, scaling factors, boundary conditions and reasons behind leadership decisions

Solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks)

Work with program managers, business leaders and executive team to communicate and impact critical business initiatives

Develop, implement, and govern Key Performance Metrics (KPI) reporting for a portfolio of programs, providing visibility to the milestones, and performance across all projects

Set-up mechanisms to audit and perform necessary course corrections where needed to meet business objectives


About the team
EU STEP brings together Supply Chain, Network Design, and Transportation Planning teams to improve end-to-end forecasting, network flow, planning, and execution. It also brings together our teams from across the business focused on our Operational Excellence pillars - Amazon Customer Excellence Systems (ACES), Learning, Quality, Service, Sustainability and Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) Field teams. This integration strengthens operations and execution while driving quality improvements and enhanced customer experience across the entire value chain.

- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

- Experience leading process improvements

title: Senior Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges? Do you thrive at the intersection of business strategy and technology? As a Solutions Architect at Amazon, you will partner directly with customers to design and deliver solutions that address their most pressing needs — from reducing costs and mitigating risk to launching new products and transforming legacy platforms. You will bring together technical depth, creative problem-solving, and strong communication skills to guide customers through their technology journey. This role offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of technical domains, influence long-term technology strategies, and make a measurable impact on customer outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Design end-to-end customer solutions that are extensible, secure, reliable, cost-optimized, and performant, shepherding those solutions through the full implementation lifecycle.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, building relationships with senior leaders and ensuring their short-term technology decisions align with long-term business goals.
- Lead technical solution discussions, diving into design choices, best practices, and use cases while proactively identifying and mitigating risks or overly complex approaches.
- Develop and deliver thought leadership content such as presentations, workshops, blog posts, and sample code that educates customers on technology strategy and best practices.
- Gather and translate customer feedback into clear business and technical requirements for product and engineering teams, helping to shape new products, features, and service improvements.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing customer architectures and preparing for solution design sessions. Much of your time is spent collaborating with customers to understand their business context, whiteboarding solution options, and evaluating trade-offs. You will also partner with internal teams across sales, engineering, and professional services to ensure the right expertise is brought to each engagement. Between customer interactions, you may be refining a workshop you are delivering next week or contributing a reusable reference design that helps fellow architects accelerate their work.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to helping customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through well-architected technology solutions. We operate in a collaborative, inclusive environment where curiosity is encouraged and knowledge-sharing is a daily practice. Whether mentoring teammates, contributing to strategic planning, or speaking at industry events, you will find opportunities to grow your skills and broaden your impact. If you are excited about working with customers to turn complex challenges into elegant solutions, we would love to hear from you.

title: Software Development Engineer, Ads AI Core Infra (ACI)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering AI-powered solutions that transform how advertisers make strategic decisions. We deliver billions of ad impressions and process massive volumes of advertiser data every single day. You'll work with us to pioneer breakthrough approaches in how AI agents access and reason over real-time advertiser data at scale.

The Campaign Management team is responsible for capturing inputs for advertisers to control their advertising efforts. You can think of our team as the brain and nervous system of all the advertisements you see on amazon.com. We build large scale, high velocity distributed systems to service 100’s of millions of API requests per day, steam data at PB scale, process business logic on tight latency budgets, all while streaming and the data at high fidelity to 20+ other services to perform other critical advertising functions. We stand up world class CI/CD pipelines to deploy our service automating infrastructure provisioning, high volume load testing and first-rate monitoring so our engineers can keep their heads down inventing for our advertisers. Our problem space covers concurrent workflows across distributed systems (linearizability, eventual consistency), big data problems (propagation delay, ordering and hygiene) and performance (search optimization). Our team uses the latest AWS products and services to solve our problems including but not limited to: ECS, Fargate, EC2, EMR, Lambda, Kafka, Elastic Search, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, Cloud watch, CDK, Cloud Formation and many more.

We are using generative AI and agentic systems to help advertising agents provide instant, strategic advice to millions of advertisers. You will need to invent new techniques for global ads experience, agent orchestration, and context optimization to ensure we're delivering accurate, trustworthy insights with minimal latency and token consumption. You'll create feedback loops to ensure our solutions are constantly evaluating themselves and improving.
